Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis, is one of the world's leading multi-disciplinary consultancies. Our Clean Water Networks team is one of the longest established specialist teams of its kind, providing consultancy and field support services to clients for the operation, performance and management of clean water networks in UK. Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for Lead Engineer for offshore executed projects from India.
The successful candidate will join a team of hydraullic modellers and civil engineers and play in its expansion and projects delivery. This is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to lead the project teams with a world renowned consultant.
Your role
Work as part of AtkinsRealis' Clean Water (CW) team.
Lead the delivery of a range of projects relating to network modelling, water infrastructure design and planning from Bangalore office.
Lead day to day liaison with our UK PMs and engineers to ensure project deliverables are developed in accordance with client scope, budget, timescales and quality requirements.
Drive innovation and digital delivery culture to the next level.
Carryout check and review of the projects, assuring quality delivery right first time.
Support the technical development of Engineers, Technicians and Graduates.
Support the Team Leader with resource and other management duties.
Provide support to business development activates like bid preparations, presentations to potential clients etc.
About you
Bachelor or Master's Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering from a recognized University.
Professional accreditation from ICE or CIWEM.
Minimum 10 years' experience, preferably based on delivering projects to the UK Water Industry.
Sufficient and appropriate experience of working within a technical environment (Water projects)
Able to independently work on data processing and analysis to a high standard.
The ability to develop innovative solutions to engineering problems.
Working knowledge of software such as InfoWorks, Epanet, SynerGee, Aquis and MapInfo.
Working knowledge of British Standards is desirable.
Computer literacy e.g. Word, Excel and Outlook.
Excellent English spoken and written skills within a business environment.
Working to defined timescales and following an approved methodology will be key features of the role.
Demonstrable track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the water industry.
Ability to apply technical knowledge in analysing problems and creating solutions.
Willingness to travel to the UK for short term assignments and training.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments.
Ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
Well-motivated and able to work as part of a team or on individual assignments when required.
Able to work and communicate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Flexible approach to work.
Ability to work on your own initiative.
Strong attention to detail and ability to make correct judgment.
Reward benefits
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You'll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
Your Role
Working within our Nuclear business sector in our Bangalore or Gurgaon office, you will lead the delivery of AtkinsRealis technical design and engineering projects or work directly for our key clients.
You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
About You
You'll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You'll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You'll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. You must also be able to successfully manage the commercial and quality performance of projects and proactively deploy a range of techniques to control delivery, cost, manage risk and change.
Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience
Direct and demonstrable experience of successfully managing one or more of the following types of projects to agreed time, cost and quality requirements:
Consultancy services supplying engineering advice, or
Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.
Your role
We are looking for a Principal Transport Planner (Strategic Modelling) to join our team. This role will be based at our AtkinsRalis office in Bangalore/Gurgaon, India.
Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning / economics).
Working experience (16+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, SATURN, DIADEM, EMME.
Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions.
Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets.
Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
Strong understanding of ArcGIS/QGIS, PowerBI and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project with no supervision.
Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery.
Good written communication skills.
Be able to delegate the tasks.

Description:
Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Overview
BDO is an international network of accounting, tax, and advisory firms which perform professional services to clients throughout the country and around the globe. The local knowledge of network member firms combined with the international expertise and strength of our network ensures effective and efficient service delivery to all our clients in every country where BDO is represented. The BDO story is an amazing one. At the end of 2018, our global organization has grown to include 80,000 people working out of 162 countries & territories who’ve generated revenues of US$9 billion. Our past achievements continue to be a strong foundation for us, but the world is changing, and we must focus now on defining our future and becoming the BDO of tomorrow – today. This year’s GLOBAL REVIEW aims to demonstrate and clarify how we’re going about achieving this. BDO India builds on foundations of quality and a business-focused & result-oriented approach to servicing clients. Our Partners are reputed to being subject & industry experts and take pride in a work culture that is both client-centric and knowledge-driven. Our expertise lies in developing innovative, business-oriented solutions delivered consistently to clients across industries and borders. As the Indian regulatory landscape has many complexities, we try to break down and prioritize requirements to propose business-friendly and dynamic solutions to clients. With integrity at the core, we bring together global best practices tailored to address local compliance needs through focused advisory & efficient execution.

Description:
Designation - Assistant Manager HR (Area HR) - Warehouse
Education - Diploma/Degree , MBA
Age - Up to 38 ( Only Male Candidate )
Experience - 10 to 15 years
Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

Job Location - Bangalore,Mumbai{Kalyan , Bhiwandi (padgha)} Maharashtra,Hyderabad

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Description:
You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing
End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working.
Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation.
Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year.
Location Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore Travel Percentage Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100%
Principal Roles And Responsibilities -
Seeking for candidates with strong and deep finance knowledge, process, and operational acumen in various aspects of finance coupled with strong consulting skills around problem identification, creative thinking, problem solving, strong and clear communication and presentation skills, stakeholder management, etc. Candidate will be operating in one of the above domains with opportunities to move across domains over the years. Working closely with our clients, consulting professionals and help in building and implementing strategies that can enhance business performance.
Opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives coupled with Accentures leading assets, are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape. Few day-to-day responsibilities include: Identifying, assessing, and solving complex business problems for area of responsibility, where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
Demonstrating strong finance process knowledge and understanding to work with client process owners across accounting, management and reporting, taxation, etc. Assisting clients in developing and building the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practices deep industry, functional and business process acumen to leverage our assets and capabilities for greatest strategic impact. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate and implement programs. Assisting leadership teams in developing offerings and assets

Qualifications - Chartered Accountant, only rank holders or first attempters in both group for both CA Final and PE II levels. Experience Minimum 3 years of experience in a reputed CA firm with strong experience around taxation, maintaining books of accounts, consolidation and close process, audits and internal controls, audits of financial institutions including risk analysis, client relationship management, etc. Key Competencies and Skills Must Have Strong analytical skills, with ability to analyze data, interpret the trends and produce results in presentable manner. Should possess advanced excel skills and PPT skills with minimum 2+ years of working experience. Ability to convert complex data into effective displays that are consumable by clients/end-users.
Well-versed in Finance processes with 2 to 3 years of basic experience. Required Soft Skills: Demonstrate analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity to solve non-standard analytics problems. Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. Strong communication and presentation skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Self-starter with strong organizational, time management and multi-tasking skills. Dear Candidate,


This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Total Overall Experience-10-15years
Skill AWS Data Engineer
Location Mumbai, Chennai, and Bangalore

Description:
About Us:
Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

Our Leaders:
Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.

Working Days : 6 days a week
Working Hours : 11:00 AM 8:00 PM
Location : Bangalore & Chennai

Summary of the Role:
We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

Responsibilities:
Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals


Required Skills and Qualifications:
Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)


Whats in it for You?
Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Description:
Job Description Learning Operations Manager

Role Purpose
The Learning Operations Manager is responsible for the efficient operational delivery of the organisation's learning portfolio. The role ensures that learning activities are planned, administered, delivered and reported accurately, providing an exceptional learner experience while producing high-quality management information to support business decision-making and regulatory compliance.
The role combines strong operational management with expertise in HR systems, learning technologies and data analytics to ensure learning is delivered to the right audiences, at the right time, with measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Learning Operations
Manage the end-to-end operational delivery of learning programmes across multiple business areas.
Coordinate learning schedules, enrolments, cancellations and communications.
Ensure learning activities are delivered efficiently, consistently and in accordance with agreed service levels.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate and streamline operational processes.
Maintain operational procedures, standards and documentation, as well as manage the learning team inbox.
Audience Management
Define and manage learning audiences using organisational structures, job roles, business rules and regulatory requirements.
Create and maintain learner populations within the Learning Management System (LMS).
Ensure mandatory and role-based learning is assigned accurately.
Manage audience changes resulting from organisational restructures, acquisitions, role changes and employee lifecycle events.
Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to validate audience accuracy.
Learning Invitations & Communications
Manage learner invitations, reminders and completion notifications.
Design and maintain communication schedules to maximise learner engagement and completion rates.
Ensure communications are timely, professional and aligned with organisational branding.
Support stakeholder communications for major learning deployments.
Reporting & Analytics
Produce regular dashboards and management reports covering learning activity, completion rates, overdue training, compliance status and learner engagement.
Analyse trends, identify risks and recommend actions to improve learning performance.
Develop meaningful KPIs and operational metrics.
Support audit requests by providing accurate learning records and evidence.
Present data insights to senior stakeholders in a clear and actionable format.
HR Systems & Learning Technology
Act as a subject matter expert for the Learning Management System and its integration with HR systems.
Manage system configuration relating to learning assignments, organisational hierarchies, user records and reporting.
Work with HRIS teams to ensure accurate employee data feeds.
Support testing and implementation of system enhancements and upgrades.
Troubleshoot operational issues relating to learner records and system functionality.
Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with HR, Technology, Compliance, Learning Partners and business stakeholders.
Provide operational advice and guidance on learning processes and system capabilities.
Support business areas in planning learning deployments and reporting outcomes.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, technology and process redesign.
Monitor operational performance against service levels.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Learning Operations.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Essential Experience
Significant experience in Learning Operations, Learning Administration or Learning Services.
Experience managing large-scale learning deployments across complex organisations.
Strong experience of audience management within Learning Management Systems.
Experience producing learning compliance reporting and operational dashboards.
Experience managing learner communications and invitations.
Working knowledge of HR systems and employee data structures.
Experience supporting regulatory or mandatory learning programmes.

Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of Learning Management Systems (e.g. Cornerstone, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Oracle Learning, Moodle).
Experience using HR systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or equivalent.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience using reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance and reporting principles.
Comfortable working with large datasets.

Core Competencies
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong customer and service orientation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Continuous improvement mindset.
High levels of accuracy and accountability.

Desirable
Experience supporting financial services, regulated industries or mandatory compliance learning, in particular Supplier Management /Third Party Risk Management.
Knowledge of xAPI, SCORM and learning technologies.
Understanding of data privacy and GDPR principles.
Experience working within Agile or transformation programmes.

Success Measures
The Learning Operations Manager will be successful when they consistently deliver:
Accurate audience assignments with minimal manual intervention.
High completion rates for mandatory and regulatory learning.
Timely learner communications and invitations.
Reliable, insightful reporting that supports business decision-making.
Excellent learner satisfaction with operational support.
High levels of HR and LMS data integrity.
Continuous improvement through automation and process optimisation.
Strong operational governance and audit readiness.

With a growing client portfolio comprising of over 100 global organizations, Capco operates at the intersection of business and technology by combining innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to deliver end-to-end data-driven solutions and fast-track digital initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, and the energy sector. SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

Description:
Tag Implementation Engineer
Implement the outstanding analytics events on web, iOS and Android inside the client's squads, validate them against the schema, and produce per-touchpoint readiness evidence so Adobe can be switched off before contract expiry.
Experience: 4-8 years, in the relevant platform, with analytics tracking in production.
Must-have
•        iOS developer:
o       Swift (Objective-C a plus), UIKit and SwiftUI, Xcode, XCTest, Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods
o       Integrated at least one analytics SDK in a production app: Amplitude iOS SDK, Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK or legacy Adobe Mobile SDK, Firebase
o       Screen, lifecycle and deep-link event handling; background and app-state edge cases
o       App Tracking Transparency and consent-driven tracking
•        Android developer:
o       Kotlin (Java a plus), Jetpack Compose and Views, Gradle, JUnit and Espresso
o       Integrated at least one analytics SDK in a production app: Amplitude Android SDK, Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK or Adobe Mobile SDK, Firebase
o       Activity/fragment lifecycle, configuration changes, backgrounding and process death without losing or duplicating events
o       Consent handling and device identifiers
•        Web / data-layer developer:
o       JavaScript and TypeScript, a modern framework (React or similar), single-page-app route and virtual page-view handling
o       Data-layer design and implementation (W3C or custom); Adobe Launch, Tealium, GTM or Segment
o       Amplitude Browser SDK and Adobe AppMeasurement or Web SDK; moving a data layer from an Adobe-shaped model to a vendor-neutral schema
o       Consent management platforms and tag firing rules
•        Validation and exit-readiness engineer:
o       Network-level inspection with Charles or Proxyman, browser dev tools, Adobe Assurance or Debugger, Amplitude Ingestion Debugger
o       Test cases written from event schemas, defect logging in Jira, regression checks each release
o       SQL to compare event volumes, nulls, duplicates and property completeness between legacy and new tables (Databricks/Spark a plus)
o       Building per-touchpoint readiness evidence: spec coverage, parity results, open defects and sign-off
•        Common to all:
o       Implementing to a written tracking spec and typed event wrappers, and flagging spec gaps rather than guessing
o       Running two analytics tools in parallel without double-counting
o       Working inside a client codebase and squad: pull requests, code review, CI, release trains and sprint ceremonies
o       Documenting what shipped, per touchpoint and release

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Your role

Embrace digital engineering and promoting innovative engineering design solutions.

Bachelor's degree/master's degree in engineering from an institute of repute.
5+ years of experience in the Water Wastewater Industry.

Good written and verbal English language communication skills.
Positive Attitude and eagerness to learn and use new water related design software's, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency as per the project and business requirement.

A team player and work in collaboration.
Chartered member or working towards chartership (ICE, CIWEM or equivalent).

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.

3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science

B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Service Desk Lead with a strong background in Retail IT Support, POS Systems, Store Support Operations, and Voice Service Desk Management. The ideal candidate should have experience leading support teams for US/UK retail clients, handling store operations, POS incidents, major incidents, and service delivery while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and SLA compliance.

Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard

Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience

Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks

Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.

Description:
About us
Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking5. 5.Pixel, Indias first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the USand more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
About the Role: 
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as  employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings. 

Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas. 
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions. 
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
5 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement). 
 Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Equal Opportunity
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success

Job Description- Territory Sales and Clinical Lead

About us

SigTuple builds intelligent screening solutions to aid diagnosis through AI-powered analysis of visual medical data from human and animal samples. Its flagship AI100 product is an in vitro diagnostic device that automates manual microscopy using robotics and AI, enabling biological samples on glass slides to be digitized for AI-aided remote reporting and analysis. Along the same lines, SigTuple is building a Point-of-Care (POC) screening device for veterinary use, expanding its technology and diagnostic solutions into the animal health space

As a Territory Sales and Clinical Lead,you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening SigTuplespresence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, and distributors. Your role will focus on building a strong customer base, key opinion leader relationships, executing sales cycle from lead generation till closure and post sales support.,

Responsibilities:
Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote SigTuple products and generate profitable sales.
Maintain a healthy pipeline and conduct demonstrations to close the sales as per targets assigned.
Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.
Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
Qualification & Experience:
0-2 years
Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science/ Science /Nursing/Biomedical /Diagnostics Medical Technician
Master's in related fields will be a plus.
Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge:
Strong understanding of the animal health market,
Experience working with clinics, hospitals & distributors.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.
Location:
Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Bangalore. Based in the city / should be a local permanent resident having full exposure to the territory field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.

DevOps Engineer | 3-5 Years | Bangalore

About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, cloud automation, and CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in building, automating, and managing scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms.
If you are passionate about automation, platform engineering, Kubernetes ecosystems, and modern DevOps practices, we would love to connect with you.

Primary Skills
Terraform
Kubernetes
Docker
Ansible

Good to Have
CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Linux Administration
Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
Scripting using Python/Shell

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using Terraform.
Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployments.
Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Ansible.
Collaborate with development, testing, and operations teams to improve deployment efficiency.
Ensure platform reliability, availability, security, and performance.
Monitor production environments and resolve deployment-related issues.
Implement DevOps best practices, automation frameworks, and operational standards.

Required Qualifications
BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA
3-5 years of relevant DevOps experience.
Hands-on expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and Ansible.
Strong understanding of Linux systems and networking concepts.
Experience in cloud-based infrastructure and automation.
Ability to troubleshoot complex deployment and infrastructure issues.

Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.

Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.

PUC or Graduation is mandatory.

Candidates with up to 1 years of Field Sales experience can apply.
Candidates should have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

About the Role:
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings.
Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas.
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions.
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
7 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement).
Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.
