Description:
Job Summary
Infrastructure Engineer
Job Location: India (Bangalore)
Maersk is achieving an unprecedented transformation in the growth of our business, rethinking the way we engage with customers and partners, and how the world's trade flows across our global network. From the farm to your refrigerator, or the factory to your wardrobe, we are developing solutions in-house that meet customer needs across the whole Supply Chain E2E. Joining Maersk you will join a global leader in Container Logistics as we embark on an industry-defining digital transformation that will revolutionize trade.
You'll play a vital part in our success, helping us re-think what technology can do by using the latest technologies, and building the experience to advance your career. If you are passionate about working in an entrepreneurial environment supporting an ambitious, culturally diverse team of 3000 People within Maersk Technology - on a great transformation journey - then apply today!
The role of the Infrastructure Engineer
As an Infrastructure Engineer within our Technology Services Engineering Team, you will be a key driver and doer in a fundamental shift in how we architect and host our application estate to ensure that we can take our platform operating model to the next level. You will be an advocate to enable a composable technology foundation which will enable our Product development teams in building our digital foundation of the future to help delivering for our global customer base.
Your focus will be on both assisting in the ideation and realisation of what our next generation platform will encompass, as well as then helping our Product teams in implementing products that are aligned to this long-term Platform vision.
To realise Maersk's "One Customer Journey", a consistent and resilient platform is essential. You will be key in helping promote 'the right way' in how we utilise technology in delivering on this promise.
To help to make our next generation platform successful, we are looking for key individuals to join our Technology Services Engineering team to help shape this vision and be pivotal in transforming how we do business with customers and vendors.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will demonstrate the following characteristics:
You have proven background in delivering complex, high performance, highly available solutions
You are creative and come up with innovative approaches to projects and any issues that arise.
You are a "do'er". You get things done.
Sharing expertise and insight with other engineers
Currently the tech stack is not 100% fixed but we have a strong preference for commercial experience of opensource plus cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a background that spans development, architecture, and operations. We are looking for full stack engineers with preference for staff that can provide expert coverage over three primary areas, plus some ability across all areas.
DevOps - Github, Terraform, Ansible
Cloud - AWS, Azure, GCP
Operational System - RHEL, Windows
Hypervisor - KVM, AHV, VMWare
Database - Oracle, Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL
Patch management - Redhat Satellite WSUS
Config management - AWX
Domain driven design experience and understand how to create composable microservices and API's
Opensource - Track record of community activity and contribution
Key Responsibilities
Execute technical, engineering practices, and engineering methodologies.
Work on our problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs and help drive our platform vision forward
Execute technology roadmap with the associated release goals. Participate in POCs for new and upcoming strategic technology solutions.
Handling and automating day to day administration tasks including systems reporting and system tuning
Good understanding of programming and scripting, with the ability to create targeted, ad-hoc custom solutions to specific problems the ability to design and write larger-scale applications able to function on a large server estate
Contribute to documentation and team routines
Works in collaboration with other engineers
Representation of Maersk in external technology events and conferences.
Key Skills
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering
5+ years of experience of engineering experience at scale
Experience with diverse operational systems both on prem (virtual and physical) and in Cloud (Azure and Google)
Develop and implement solutions using Python (or other programming language), CLI, PowerShell, GPOs
Experience in system performance analysis, tuning, and troubleshooting experience including network, system, and hardware optimization for low latency.
Experience with High Availability, clustering, failover, and load balancing
Red Hat and/or Microsoft Windows Server certification is a plus
Knowledge of programming languages, operating system principles, networking, and software development best practices.
Experience of working with offshore teams
Experience of Test-Driven Development approaches

Description:
Job Summary
Senior Engineering Manager - Technology Operational Excellence
Location: Pune/Bangalore
We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to lead a critical portfolio within Technology Operational Excellence. This role is accountable for driving the strategy, roadmap, governance and execution across Recovery Assurance, Technology Risk Audit, Standards Assurance, Operational Excellence, and the application of automation and AI to strengthen assurance and operational outcomes.
This is not a traditional governance or reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a strategic leader with end-to-end ownership, defining direction, building high-performing teams and influencing senior stakeholders and platform teams to deliver measurable improvements in resilience, reliability, availability, operational maturity and risk reduction. Success will be measured by the ability to drive accountability, use data to identify improvement opportunities and translate strategy into sustainable outcomes across the technology landscape.
Reporting to the Director, Technology Operational Excellence, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, setting the direction and leading delivery across your area. The Director will provide strategic alignment, guidance and challenge, while you will be accountable for developing the strategy, roadmap and operating model required to deliver the agreed outcomes.
Responsibilities Strategy Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Technology Operational Excellence capabilities.
Translate organizational objectives into measurable outcomes and improvement initiatives.
Drive prioritization across resilience, technology risk, audit, standards assurance and Operational Excellence, while working across adjacent capabilities such as Change Management to improve end-to-end operational outcomes.
Identify emerging operational risks and capability gaps and develop scalable solutions.
Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to senior technology leadership.
Recovery Assurance Resilience
Lead enterprise recovery assurance and resilience programs.
Improve recoverability of critical business and technology services by influencing platform teams to do the right testing, validation, and continuous improvement.
Drive failover, restore, and recovery exercises across cloud, SaaS, on-premise, and vendor-managed environments.
Ensure recovery risks are identified, tracked, and remediated effectively.
Technology Risk, Audit Assurance
Lead technology operational risk management, audit readiness and the sustainable remediation of audit findings.

Description:
Synopsis:

The incumbent would be a member of the Organisation Development & Effectiveness team, which oversees the organization's learning and development efforts. The role would entail overseeing the allocated location's location learning activities (behavioural and leadership). The individual will be responsible for ensuring that the organization's training programs align with its overall goals and objectives and are tailored to meet the needs of individual employees at all levels.

Criteria:
Experience: 5 - 10 yrs.
Location: Bangalore/Mumbai/Mysuru
Education: Full-Time MBA (HR) Or any certified trainer with UG/PG Qualification
Training Delivery: Should have conducted/delivered behavioural training sessions.
Job Description:
Program Management and Delivery of Behavioural/ Soft Skills Training Programs for Middle & Senior Management.
Location Operations Manage all operations related to the training programs from the stage of planning to vendor management to post-training effectiveness.
Plan Quarterly Training Calendars and execute training workshops as per the plan to ensure threshold Learning parameters are met.

Liaison with internal and external learning SMEs to ensure the successful delivery of the training workshops.
As an internal Learning Consultant, work with Business Leaders to roll out interventions to address specific business challenges.
Create post-training effectiveness reports which include diagnosis, business impact, and recommendations to leaders.
Work with the OD team to establish strong linkages for the leadership programs and Lead and Manage at least one OD Project independently.
Manage all internal / external / surveillance / client audit and ensure all the processes are adhered to without any Non-Conformity
Managing the learning and development budget: You will need to manage the budget for learning and development programs, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively and efficiently.
Building relationships with stakeholders: You will need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, including senior leaders, department heads, and employees, to ensure that training programs meet their needs.

Must have skills:
Fluent and assertive in Communicating.
Effective consultation& Facilitation (Training Delivery) skills.
Content Development skills.
Basic Knowledge of assessments.
Stakeholder Management & Strong Networking capability Internal & External
Branding & Driving Organization-wide Learning communication.
Process compliance, Data management and Analysis

Preferrable Points:
Exposure or experience with organizations of similar nature, scale, and size to LTTS.
Facilitation skills (not as a freelancer)
Hands-on Experience with LMS (SuccessFactors)
Experience in instructional design and content design is preferred

Description:
BACKEND ENGINEER PYTHON & AZURE INTEGRATIONS
Publicis Global Delivery | India (Mumbai / Bangalore / Pune / Hyderabad / Gurgaon) | 5–8 years
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and enterprise integrations. The candidate will be responsible for building robust APIs, integrating business applications such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365, and developing secure, event-driven backend workflows using Python and Azure services.
The role requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, experience with cloud-based application development, API integrations, authentication mechanisms and distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build and manage REST APIs for integrating enterprise applications and business systems.
Develop integrations with Salesforce, SharePoint, Outlook and Microsoft Teams using REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API.
Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and event-driven workflows.
Work with Azure services including Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, App Service, API Management and Service Bus/Event Grid.
Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 and managed identities.
Design and manage application state, data persistence and long-running workflows using Cosmos DB.
Implement error handling, retries, idempotency, timeouts and fault-tolerant mechanisms.
Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues and maintain structured logging and audit trails.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable backend solutions.
Required Skills

Expected Capability
Backend Development

REST APIs, API design, integrations, error handling

Application Development

Background jobs, retries, idempotency, logging and monitoring
Experience & Working Style
5–8 years of experience in backend software engineering.
Strong hands-on experience in Python backend development.
Experience building and deploying REST APIs and enterprise application integrations.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services.
Experience integrating Salesforce and/or Microsoft 365 applications in an enterprise environment.
Good understanding of authentication, authorization and secure API communication.
Ability to troubleshoot and independently handle production issues.
Additional Note
Frontend development, ML model training, data science and AI/LLM experience are not required for this position.

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations

Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Strong hands-on experience in BMC Remedy AR System / BMC Helix ITSM development.
Strong knowledge of Remedy workflow customization and automation.
Experience with Forms, Active Links, Filters, Escalations, Menus, Guides, and workflow objects.

Hands-on experience with BMC Digital Workplace and DWP Catalog.

Good to Have:

Experience with BMC Helix Dashboards, Business Workflows, and automation capabilities.

Scripting/automation knowledge and experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Job Description: Senior Technical Lead
Exp: 5-9yrs
Location: Bangalore and Hyderabad

Key Responsibilities
Independently designed and implemented complex agent workflows, integrating multiple frameworks such as LangChain, Langraph, or GoogleADK to address specific domain requirements.
Lead event-driven architecture development and enhancements for assigned domains.
Ensure code quality through advanced testing, code reviews, and mentoring junior engineers.

Drive improvements in deployment, monitoring, and incident response processes across hybrid and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).

Collaborate cross-functionally with other engineering, SRE, and product teams.

510 years of hands-on experience in designing, building, and deploying distributed or agentic systems.
Proficient in Python and familiar with at least one additional modern programming language (such as Java, Go, or C++).
Experience implementing event-driven, microservices, or multi-agent architectures at scale.
Solid experience with cloud-native development and operations on AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
Strong background in software testing, code reviews, and agile development methodologies.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and monitoring solutions.
Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical documentation.
Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills.

Key Skills:- Agentic AI, Agent Orchestration, A2A Protocol, Google ADK, LangGraph, Multi-Agent Workflows, Event-Driven Architecture, Cloud SRE, Runtime Engineering

About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions.
Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer a world-class, frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups, including well-known unicorns. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler to a driver of revenue and growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI, and this team is responsible for growing penetration of Paytms PA–PG business across Indian merchants.

About the Role
Handle merchant escalations and resolve them on a high-priority basis. Proactively assist merchants to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues. Deliver exceptional merchant satisfaction through ownership and accountability of cases.

Key Responsibilities / Expectations
Resolve merchant complaints received through RBI, nodal officers, social media channels, or senior management escalations.
Understand the nature of each query, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure resolution within defined TATs.
Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for escalations received.
Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.
Maintain high CSAT scores and ensure no repeat escalations for handled cases.
Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Description:
Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.

Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales
Education:
BE/B.Tech/MCA/BCA/BSC CS with 60%+

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager - Apartment Sales to drive end-to-end sales across gated apartment societies. This is a field-intensive role focused on managing the complete sales funnel-from lead generation to closures-while ensuring strong execution, customer experience, and revenue achievement.
Purpose of the Role: To drive closures in gated apartment societies by managing a full-cycle apartment sales funnel. The role involves lead generation, executing activation campaigns, maintaining sales hygiene, and achieving revenue targets aligned with operational excellence.
Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata / Noida / Gurgaon / India / Hyderabad. Reporting To: City Head. Working Days: 6 Days (Weekends Working). Weekly Off: Fixed Wednesday. Shift Timings: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Travel Requirement: High (Field Role).
Key Responsibilities
Apartment Onboarding: Identify and engage with gated societies for product/service onboarding
Drive end-to-end closures from initial pitch to installation activation
Build strong relationships with RWAs, facility managers, and key decision-makers
Sales Funnel Management: Maintain a strong and active sales pipeline with daily activity tracking
Generate leads through field visits, networking, and activation campaigns
Drive conversions through structured follow-ups and consistent engagement
Meeting CRM Hygiene: Ensure accurate and timely data entry in CRM tools
Maintain daily logs of meetings, follow-ups, and outcomes
Track funnel movement and performance metrics rigorously
Collections Recovery Management: Ensure timely collection of payments from clients
Coordinate with operations team post-installation
Track outstanding payments and proactively escalate delays
Client Experience: Ensure seamless onboarding and service delivery
Minimize escalations during installation and go-live
Act as a single point of contact for client satisfaction
Candidate Profile - Skills & Competencies
Strong field sales experience with proven relationship-building skills
Expertise in consultative and solution-based selling
High discipline in CRM usage and reporting hygiene
Strong stakeholder management (RWAs, societies, internal teams)
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally for closures
Target-driven with high ownership mindset
Mandatory Requirements
B2B Sales Background is mandatory
Must have handled end-to-end sales cycle (lead generation to deal closure)
Experience in full-cycle sales ownership is essential
Candidates from B2C sales backgrounds will not be considered
Preferred Qualifications
3-6 years of experience in B2B field sales / real estate / apartment or gated community sales
Familiarity with residential societies and local networks
Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Excel
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Willingness to travel extensively and meet daily activity benchmarks
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification: Graduate (Mandatory)
Age Limit: Up to 32 years

Description:
Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations relevant reports.
Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.
Core Skills:
Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
LEED Accredited Professional
6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results
Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases
Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, AutoCAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Desirable but not essential
Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, SketchUp, and Rhino
Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials
What We Offer:
Varied, interesting, and meaningful work.
A hybrid working environment with flexibility and opportunities for growth.
Access to training, with career progression or lateral moves as the team expands.
The chance to work with a large, global, multidisciplinary consultancy on a mission to transform business practices.
Meeting Your Needs:
We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer a 'Total Reward' package to help you thrive both in and out of the office. If you identify as having a disability, please inform us before your interview, and we will discuss any necessary adjustments.
Additional Information:
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can thrive. From day one, we offer family-friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and support networks for employees from all backgrounds. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we welcome applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Job Description
Overview
Be at the forefront of strategic transport planning and modelling. As a Senior Transport Planner, you will help deliver transformational projects worldwide, from strategic model development and local plan assessments to supporting major development and master planning initiatives, enabling sustainable and future-ready transport networks.
Your role
You will contribute to the delivery of strategic transport modelling projects across global markets, supporting the development of evidence-based solutions that inform planning and investment decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects, including strategic transport model development, local plan modelling, development impact assessments and concept master planning support. Working closely with strategic modelling teams across the world, you will help to develop, maintain, and enhance transport models that support sustainable growth, mobility planning, and infrastructure development.
About you
Essential Requirements
Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning / economics)
Working experience (7+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, SATURN, DIADEM, EMME.
Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions
Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets
Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
Strong understanding of ArcGIS/QGIS, PowerBI and Microsoft Office applications
Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project with minimal supervision.
Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery
Good written communication skills.
Desirable requirements
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious
Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
Experience in the use of analytical and research tools such as GIS and the use of databases
Appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context
Professional membership of a relevant institution.
Rewards benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description: RPGLE Production Support Engineer
Position: RPGLE Production Support Engineer
Experience: 4+ Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Noida
Work Mode: 5 Days Work from Office (Mandatory from Client Location)

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced RPGLE Production Support Engineer to support and maintain critical IBM i (AS/400) applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in RPGLE application support, incident management, troubleshooting, and production monitoring in a 24x7 support environment.

Key Responsibilities
Provide production support for RPGLE-based applications running on IBM i (AS/400) systems.
Monitor application performance and proactively address production issues.
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, and performance bottlenecks.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
Work closely with development, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve production issues.
Support batch job monitoring, job scheduling, and production deployments.
Handle service requests, incidents, and change management activities as per SLAs.
Maintain support documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
Participate in on-call and shift support activities.

Required Skills
4+ years of hands-on experience in RPGLE Production Support.
Strong knowledge of IBM i (AS/400) platform.
Experience with RPGLE, CLLE, DB2/400, SQL, Query/400.
Good understanding of batch processing, job scheduling, and production monitoring.
Experience in incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
Ability to perform log analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
Familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills
Knowledge of ITIL processes.
Exposure to banking, financial services, insurance, or retail applications.
Experience working in a 24x7 production support environment.

Shift & Work Requirements
5 Days Work from Office is mandatory from the client location.
Night Shift Requirement: 1 week every month, including weekends.
Shift Allowance: Applicable during the assigned night shift week.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity
Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement
Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
Improve:
Planning accuracy
Inventory turns
Supplier OTD
Material availability
Production plan adherence
Lead time
OTIF
Supply Chain cost
Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile
Education :
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.
Experience
10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage
Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.
Technical Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
S&OP / IBP
MPS / MRP
Production Planning & Control
Material Planning
Procurement
Inventory Management
Warehouse Management

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Description:
Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
AboutCompany:
Perks and Benefits

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in building and maintaining robust backend services that power our applications. This position requires a developer with strong experience in Golang and Python , along with hands-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure , containerization , and databases .

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go (Golang) and Python .
Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for efficient data storage and caching.
Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance and scalability issues.

Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM).
Understanding of RESTful API design principles.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. It's thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us, and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to join our team as a Senior Principal Ecology Consultant, supporting projects across the UK region.



Your Role
Lead a team of 30 ecologists.
The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of UK clients' requirements and be able to reach back into the business to get the support required to fulfil those requirements and develop relationships/work.
Leading on multi-million capex large projects or frameworks, inputting or overseeing project programmes and budgets.
Collaborating within multi-disciplinary teams and engaging with stakeholders/clients.
The candidate will engage with other areas of the business, seeking opportunities to cross sell and leverage AtkinsRalis' capabilities, preparing bids, supporting on strategic opportunities, building client relationships (internal and external) and driving work-winning in the region.
Undertaking technical checks and reviews of a range of ecological reports and licence applications.
Undertaking ecological assessment and habitat design for a variety of development and nature recovery projects.
Supporting the development of innovative and pragmatic approaches to ecological mitigation and compensation.
Delivering clear and concise, high-quality ecological deliverables in line with current guidance and good practice.
Candidate may coach, mentor and support other staff members in their development.
Task/project management.
About you
A minimum of 15 years of overall professional experience in ecology, including at least 8 years supporting projects in the UK, US, Australia and/or European markets.
An exemplary working knowledge of the UK natural environment and wildlife legislation.
Chartered through the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM), CEcol or CEnv, or actively working towards chartership.
Experience of working on Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects and familiarity with the Development Consent Order (DCO) process would be viewed favourably.
The ability to undertake and provide technical advice on Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Ecological Impact Assessment and Biodiversity Net Gain assessments.
Strong project management experience, including technical delivery, financial management and quality assurance.
Experience in protected species, mitigation and licensing.
Demonstrable experience of bidding and tendering, particularly in the UK region, including work winning and maintaining strong client relationships.



Reward benefits


This includes:

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
