Description:
Job Role: Safety & Security Supervisor
Job Title: Senior Officer / Executive Protection & Privacy
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Business: Godrej Living
Location: As per project requirements

About the Role:

This role is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of premises, employees, and visitors. The position involves implementing and maintaining safety protocols, monitoring security operations, conducting inspections, and responding effectively to emergencies to provide a safe and secure environment.

What Impact Will You Create?

Supervise security staff, assign tasks, provide training in daily procedures, first aid, and customer service.
Maintain and update security policies, checklists, and procedural manuals.
Monitor building security systems, fire alarms, and life safety equipment, ensuring compliance with regulations.
Manage manpower records, schedules, and training for on-roll and contract staff.
Conduct physical patrols, access control, and surveillance to safeguard premises and occupants.
Investigate incidents and prepare reports on security events.
Track material movement and manage lost-and-found items.
Communicate regularly with Property Manager, team members, and stakeholders on incidents, staffing, and recommendations.
Approve hiring and interview contract security personnel.
Provide briefings to staff on security and safety protocols.
Coordinate vendor meetings and share minutes of meetings with stakeholders.
Review after-hours reports and monitor performance of security personnel.
Respond promptly during emergencies, coordinating with tenants, medical personnel, and local authorities.
Draft and implement disaster management plans in coordination with management and security SMEs.
Participate in performance and behavior assessments of security staff.
Prepare and manage budgets related to security staffing and operations.

Qualification and Experience

Graduate in any discipline.
Relevant years of experience in security management, preferably within facility management.

Skills Required

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to lead, train, and manage a security team effectively.
Attention to detail and logical problem-solving skills for short- and long-term security planning.
High integrity and reliability in executing assigned responsibilities.

Whats in it for you?

Opportunity to manage safety and security across dynamic living and working environments.
Exposure to end-to-end security operations, emergency management, and compliance.
Collaborative work culture with learning and growth opportunities.
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity support.
No place for discrimination at Godrej Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
We are selfish about your wellness, hence we offer comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family.
Godrej Way Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business-level achievements Performance-based earning opportunities.

An inclusive Godrej

Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been over a century. Its not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse - especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities - helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognize merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, color, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.

If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you !!

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 5to11 yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.

Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship and International Business

Embedded within a multidisciplinary, research focused and student centric Institution of Eminence (IoE), our academic areas play a pivotal role in shaping curricula, mentoring diverse student cohorts, and contributing to scholarly and professional communities worldwide.

We invite applications from dynamic and committed Academic Associates who are eager to shape the next generation of professionals and thought leaders. Job Description Sales Intern
Company: Muthoot Finance
Department: Loan Against Property (LAP)
Position: Sales Intern
Job Role
We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates to join our Sales Internship Program. The selected candidates will receive structured training and practical exposure to sales, customer handling, and financial products.
Roles & Responsibilities
Generate business leads through various sourcing channels.
Assist the sales team in identifying potential customers.
Understand customer requirements and explain relevant financial products.
Support the team in lead generation, follow-ups, and customer relationship management.
Coordinate with Sales Managers for business development activities.
Maintain daily sales activity and lead records.
Participate in training sessions and field activities as per company guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria
Graduate in any stream (Final-year students may also apply, subject to eligibility).
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to learn and build a career in sales.
Positive attitude and target-oriented approach.
Basic knowledge of MS Office is an added advantage.
What We Offer
Structured training and mentorship.
Hands-on exposure to the financial services industry.
Opportunity to learn from experienced Sales Managers.
Performance-based incentives.
Career growth opportunities based on performance.
Department: Loan Against Property (LAP)
Company: Muthoot Finance

The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.

We are currently hiring for the positions of Interior Designers and Senior Interior Designers. Immediate joiners only.

Description:
We're Hiring | Forward Deployed AI Engineer | Damco

What if your job wasn't just writing code, but solving real business problems with AI?

At Damco, we're looking for an AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) who can work directly with customers, understand complex business challenges, and turn ideas into production-ready AI solutions.

This is more than a traditional engineering role. You'll own the entire journey from understanding the problem and designing the architecture to building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade AI systems.

What we're looking for:
4+ years of software engineering experience
Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based solutions in production
Strong understanding of system architecture and engineering fundamentals
Experience with AI agents, RAG, context engineering, evaluations, and guardrails
Ability to work with coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor
End-to-end ownership of deployment, security, monitoring, and operations
Strong communication and customer-facing problem-solving skills

Why Damco?
Be part of our journey as we transform enterprise software delivery with AI. Work on real-world business challenges, modern AI technologies, and complex enterprise systems while having a direct impact on how solutions are built.

Locations: Faridabad / Noida
Work Mode: Hybrid

If you're someone who loves building, experimenting, solving complex problems, and taking ownership beyond just writing code, we'd love to hear from you!

Interested candidates can share their profiles to explore this opportunity along with below mandatory details @ lovelya@damcogroup.com.
A. Experience & Technical Skills
Total experience in software engineering/full-stack development?
Experience in AI/ML and Generative AI/Agentic AI?
Which backend and frontend technologies have you worked on?
Which AI models, frameworks and tools have you used?
Which databases and cloud platforms have you worked with?

B. AI Project Experience
6. Tell me about a recent AI/GenAI project you personally worked on.
7. What business problem was the project solving?
8. What AI-based solution did you develop, and which industry and end users was it designed for?
9. What was the business impact or measurable result of the project?
10. What was the project duration and team size?
11. What exactly was your individual contribution? Which components did you personally develop frontend, backend, AI/LLM integration, database or deployment?
12. Was the application deployed in production or was it a POC/demo? Were you involved in deployment, production support and direct customer/stakeholder interaction?

C. AI Coding Tools
13. Have you used AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot? Which ones have you used?

D. Other Screening Details
14. GitHub, LinkedIn or relevant project links (if available)?
15. Current location and willingness to work in hybrid mode at Faridabad, Noida or Bangalore?
16. Current CTC?
17. Expected CTC?
18. Notice period, earliest joining date and offers in hand?
19. Reason for job change?

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.

Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role type- IC
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Core Responsibilities:
Perform in-depth industry, market and competitor research
Perform valuation analysis on a wide range of companies using all accepted and relevant asset valuation approaches and theories
Design valuation models for asset valuation
Independently gather data pertinent to the engagement through direct client interaction and on site collection of data relating to client assets
Inspect various assets including Residential, Commercial and Industrial properties / assets etc.
Identify develop new streams for revenue growth and maintain relationships with builders to achieve repeat business and chalk out ways to generate revenue.
Liaison with valuation agencies, real estate developers and local government bodies for market analysis and market updations.
Build and strengthen relationships with key builders/ developers and get project approvals on technical aspects and thereafter help monitor constructions status on periodic intervals. Organize and maintain such project database and provide periodic reports to management on activities and trends.
Segment markets based on property types and identify properties with high risks or in negative areas (e. g. low-line, very low chance of resale, poor quality construction, old constructions areas etc. )
Guide and develop "technical policy" and monitor the portfolio/ delinquencies related to technical aspects of respective geography.
Develop checks and process to control fraud, built database and deduce for multiple funding or excess funding on properties e. g. circle rates, reference rates to credit team, database of properties under dispute as per securitization notices by different banks as public notices, properties under public notice/ court notice/ in tech agencies data base under dispute etc. )
Scrutinize project approvals for the organization, timely monitoring and ensuring compliance on legal and technical aspects and their timely updations.
Analyze new upcoming residential projects in the zone and facilitate its fast approval for advanced processing and funding.
Conduct property audits to analyze collateral risk and manage quality real estate portfolio of the organization.
Keep track of the development in real estate market and its impact upon lending parameters, property valuations and other financial implications.
Monitor market feasibility of project for industrial, residential, commercial or institutional project, periodically checking property documents and presenting bylaws violation as per plot size.
Manage the vendors involved in the technical evaluation process.
Train and evaluate the proficiency levels of the team on a regular basis while maintaining TAT targets for the technical evaluation process.
Work closely with the legal counterpart on the technical evaluation front.
Carry out spot checks on a frequent basis and maintain an MIS related to the technical evaluation.
Help collections tie-up with brokers and negotiate rates for resale of properties surrendered, takeover through legal process, or any other property bought rented by business.
Help maintain a healthy portfolio through the preparation of feasibility reports, valuation reports, project monitoring reports and market surveys to gather data on the real estate market.
Understand and analyze risks associated with property / project / market / developer and analyze exposure that can be taken.
Graduate : Yes (Diploma/ Degree in Civil/ Architecture)

Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique RD and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.

Role Name: Platform + Middleware engineer
Experience: 8 to 10 Years


We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Middleware Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), AWS, Oracle WebLogic, Akamai, NGINX, Terraform, Splunk, and New Relic, along with working knowledge of GitHub Copilot (GHCP), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agentic AI.
Tools: AWS, Nginx, Akamai, Weblogic, Tomcat, Apache, Splunk, New Relic, Shell scripting, Service Now, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, UDeploy, Jira, Nessus ,Qualys and SonarQube
Key Responsibilities:
Support, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) environments.
Manage AWS infrastructure including EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services.
Administer and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic application environments.
Configure and support Akamai for CDN, traffic management, caching, and application delivery.
Configure and manage NGINX as a reverse proxy and load-balancing layer.
Provision and automate infrastructure using Terraform.
Monitor applications and infrastructure using Splunk and New Relic.
Troubleshoot application, middleware, network, performance, and production issues.
Perform incident resolution, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and platform health checks.
Work with applications, cloud, network, security, and DevOps teams to support reliable production environments.
Middleware & Application Platform Management
Manage deployments, rollbacks, and environment synchronization across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production.
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache, and Nginx servers. Perform JVM tuning, thread pool optimization, connection pool management, and performance tuning.
Troubleshoot middleware issues related to memory leaks, thread contention, SSL, certificates, and clustering.
Cloud Engineering (AWS /PCF)
Architect and manages AWS services: EC2, VPC ,IAM, CloudWatch ,ALB/ELB, Lamda, S3
Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and enforce cloud governance
Drive Secure, cost- optimized and resilient cloud deployments
Manage PCF foundations, tiles, build packs, org/space and platform upgrades
Troubleshoot PCF platform issues including networking, container life cycle and app run time
Vulnerability Management
Identify vulnerabilities across cloud, PCF, middleware, OS, and network layers.
Lead remediation efforts: patching, configuration hardening, dependency upgrades, and secure coding guidelines.
Implement security frameworks, WAF policies, and threatmitigation strategies.
Collaborate with security teams to enforce compliance, risk reduction, and proactive defense. (Aligned with Lead Security Architect responsibilities)
Incident, Problem & Change Management
Lead major incident bridges, coordinate cross functional teams, and provide timely updates.
Manage problem tickets, root cause analysis, and preventive action plans.
Ensure compliance with ITIL processes for change, release, and incident management.
Monitoring, Logging & Observability
Configure dashboards, alerts, and performance insights using New Relic and Splunk.
Develop logbased monitoring strategies and anomaly detection.
Implement proactive monitoring to reduce downtime and improve reliability.
Behavioral Competencies
Communication: Clear, structured communication with customers and internal teams.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Collaboration: Works effectively across engineering, QA, product, and business teams.

Job Title: Databricks Developer
Experience: 2-5 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated Databricks Developer with 23 years of experience in data engineering and big data technologies. The role involves building scalable data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, and supporting analytics and business intelligence initiatives.

Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks/AWS Databricks.

Implement and manage Delta Lake architecture for reliable data processing.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts, and engineering teams to understand data requirements.
Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Participate in code reviews and adhere to development standards.
Create and maintain technical documentation for solutions and processes.
Required Skills
2-5 years of experience in Databricks development.
Strong proficiency in PySpark and Python.
Hands-on experience with Databricks Workspace, Jobs, Notebooks, and Workflows.
Strong knowledge of Spark SQL, DataFrames, and distributed computing concepts.
Experience with Delta Lake and data lake architectures.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases.
Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.
Experience with version control tools such as Git.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Description:
Job Description: Qualys Platform Engineer

Core Responsibilities

Architecture & Deployment Management:

Design, deploy, and manage Qualys infrastructure, including Virtual Scanner Appliances (vSAs) across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments.
Architect, test, and deploy the Qualys Cloud Agent across Enterprise Networks (Windows, Linux, macOS) ensuring zero business disruption.
Optimize scanning schedules, asset tagging, and network discovery rules to maintain an accurate, real-time asset inventory.

Integration & Automation:

Build and maintain custom scripts and automation workflows using the Qualys API to automate scan scheduling, asset tagging, and report generation.
Develop robust data pipelines to ingest Qualys vulnerability data into corporate SIEMs (Splunk, Sentinel), ticketing platforms (ServiceNow VR), and CMDBs.
Embed automated vulnerability scanning directly into DevOps CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions) to achieve "shift-left" security.

Platform Health, Scaling & Support:

Monitor the health, connectivity, and capacity of all Qualys scanner appliances and cloud agents globally.
Act as the SME engineering point of contact for troubleshooting Qualys platform issues, authentication failures, and scanning bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education & Experience:
BS in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of dedicated experience managing, configuring, and engineering the Qualys Guard / Qualys Cloud Platform at an enterprise scale.

Qualys Suite Mastery:
Deep technical expertise in core Qualys modules: VMDR (Vulnerability Management, Detection, and Response), CAR Module, PC (Policy Compliance), WAS (Web Application Scanning), CAR and AssetView/Global ITAM.
Strong understanding of authenticated vs. unauthenticated scanning, scanning engine behavior, and credential management.

Automation & Scripting:
Proficient in scripting with Python, PowerShell, or Bash to interact directly with the Qualys API (REST/XML).

Systems & Cloud Infrastructure:
Strong foundational knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems.
Solid understanding of enterprise networking concepts (firewalls, routing, NAT, load balancing) necessary to debug scanning obstacles.
Experience supporting cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and  GCP).

Preferred Qualifications
Certified Qualys Specialist (e.g., Vulnerability Management, Cloud Agent, or API certifications).
Proven experience building the Qualys Connector
Familiarity with container security scanning (Docker, Kubernetes) via Qualys Container Security.

Job Summary
We are seeking skilled IICS (Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services) / Informatica Developers with 2-8 years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting data integration solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ETL development, cloud data integration, data migration, and data warehousing projects using Informatica technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL/ELT workflows using Informatica IICS and Informatica PowerCenter.

Develop mappings, mapplets, workflows, taskflows, and reusable components.
Implement data validation, cleansing, transformation, and migration processes.
Integrate data from multiple sources such as databases, APIs, flat files, and cloud platforms.
Perform performance tuning and optimization of ETL workflows.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, and stakeholders to gather requirements.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and quality standards.
Participate in code reviews, deployment activities, and documentation.

Description:
About the Opportunity

Ericsson is looking for a Telecom Billing L2 Production Support Specialist to support billing and invoicing operations. The role involves 24x7 production support, billing-cycle monitoring, incident resolution, application troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Provide L2 production and operational support for telecom billing and invoicing systems.
Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly billing cycles, including bill generation, final billing, invoice generation, validation, archival, and downstream processing.

Troubleshoot job failures, processing delays, invoice issues, data discrepancies, and integration failures.

Analyze application logs, database records, input/output files, and job execution status to identify root cause and recovery actions.

Perform approved job restarts, reprocessing, reconciliation, recovery, and data-validation activities.

Monitor batch jobs, schedulers, FTP/SFTP transfers, and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Use SQL, application logs, files, and operational tools for issue analysis and billing-data validation.

Handle incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs and participate in critical incident support.

Coordinate with L3/L4 application, database, infrastructure, vendor, business, and other stakeholder teams.

Support approved changes, releases, and post-deployment validation.

Prepare RCA documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.

Description:
STARTEK is looking for Executive - Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Executive - Operations is responsible for overseeing the day - to - day operations of a company to ensure efficiency, profitability, and growth. Some of the key responsibilities for this role include : 1. Developing and implementing operational strategies. 2. Monitoring and analyzing operational metrics to identify areas for improvement and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 3. Express their operations strategies & objectives to make sure that the company which they are working for reaches its target and operates effectively. 4. Strong leadership and problem - solving skills, as well as the ability to analyze data and make informed decisions, are essential for success in this role.

Description:
About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)
Job Description:-
The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:
Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To
Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies

Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.
Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning
Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.
Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile
Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, ‘can-do’ attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.
AboutCompany: NoBroker is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, transforming the real estate ecosystem with cutting-edge, tech-driven, and capital-efficient solutions. Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Description:
ROLE - Manager, Brand Partnerships & Alliances ( Regional)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)
Job Description:-
The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:


Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To


Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies







Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.




Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning

Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.


Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile






Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, can-do attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.
What we have to offer!



Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world
Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Benefits




Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Rewards & Recognition
Travel Allowance

Description:
Job Description: MS Power Platform Developer

Experience: 4-6 years || Preferred Domain: BFSI / Banking

Primary Skills:
Power Apps, Power Automate (Desktop/Cloud), Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Connectors, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Integration, AI Builder, Generative Answers, Solution Packaging, ALM, Security Roles, DLP Policies and Deployment Support
We are looking for an MS Power Platform Developer at B2 level with hands-on experience in building low-code business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio. The resource should be able to translate business requirements into scalable apps, automated workflows, chatbot experiences, and Microsoft 365 integrated solutions.
The role will involve working with solution architects, business SMEs and project teams to design, configure, test, and deploy Power Platform solutions. BFSI / Banking experience is preferred, while exposure to shared services, operations, HR, IT support, finance, procurement, or enterprise support functions will also be relevant.

Required Expertise
Hands-on experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 integrations.
Ability to build canvas/model-driven apps, cloud flows, approval workflows, notifications, data lookups, and system integrations.
Experience configuring Copilot Studio topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and fallback handling.
Working knowledge of SharePoint, standard/custom connectors, environments, solutions, security roles, and deployment practices.
Good understanding of data privacy, access control, DLP policies, responsible AI, and enterprise governance expectations.

Key Responsibilities
Understand business requirements and convert them into Power Platform solution designs.
Develop Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Dataverse-based solution components.
Configure Copilot Studio bots using approved knowledge sources, topics, and workflow actions.
Integrate solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, APIs, and business systems using connectors.
Perform testing, defect fixes, deployment support, UAT assistance and post-go-live stabilization.
Prepare concise configuration notes, test evidence, handover inputs, and support documentation.

Required Experience & Skills
46 years of IT experience with Power Platform delivery.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 services.
Exposure to Copilot Studio, virtual agents, generative answers, or conversational AI use cases.
Ability to troubleshoot flow failures, connector issues, access restrictions, and deployment challenges.
Good communication skills to work with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

Good to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-100, PL-200, PL-400, or AI-900.
Exposure to AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, chatbot analytics, Power BI or enterprise reporting use cases.
Understanding of ALM, solution packaging, audit requirements, and Power Platform governance.

Purpose:
To deliver high-quality technical support, on-site maintenance, installation, and troubleshooting of multi-function copiers, production printers, and advanced digital imaging systems to maximize machine uptime and customer satisfaction.
Qualifications:
Graduate or Diploma holder in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
Specialized OEM certification in digital imaging equipment or copier repair will be an added advantage.
Experience:
4-6 years of core hands-on experience in the installation, servicing, and repair of multi-functional printers (MFPs), photocopiers, or heavy-duty production printing machines.
Proven experience in technical troubleshooting, handling breakdown calls, and maintaining Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
Key Responsibilities:
Attend standard printer service calls, emergency breakdown calls, and routine preventative maintenance (PM) requests at client sites.
Install and configure multi-function copiers, office systems, and production printers at customer locations.

Maintain machine performance and track overall equipment uptime targets across assigned corporate accounts.
Document and submit accurate service reports, customer visit logs, and machine installation clearance certificates.
Follow up systematically on Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and spare parts replacements to maximize account retention.
Coordinate closely with the internal sales and core technical helpdesk teams to manage customer requirements efficiently.
Ensure swift closure of pending customer complaints within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Key Competencies:
Deep technical knowledge of modern photocopying machines, office printers, interactive boards, and production printers.
Strong diagnosis skills involving mechanical assemblies, electronic circuit boards, and digital imaging solutions.
Proficiency in communication with professional email/letter typing skills, and utilizing MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) for service reporting.
Problem-solving capabilities to handle on-site customer friction, print quality complaints, and technical escalation systems.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Narayana Health, one of Indias largest and Worlds most economical healthcare service providers is set to emerge as a global industry model for its ability to reconcile quality, affordability, scale, transparency, credibility and sustainable profitability. From 300 beds hospital in 2001, Narayana Health has grown to a 6900 beds healthcare conglomerate in 2014 with 26 hospitals present in 16 Cities within the country and also has International Presence in Cayman.
NH has been known for its cost- cutting approach and ranked 36th among Worlds 50 Most Innovative Companies by Fast Companies in 2012. NH has also been a proud recipient of Frost & Sullivan India Healthcare Excellence Awards 2012 in the category Healthcare Service Provider Company of the Year and FICCI Health Care Excellence Award 2012 for Addressing Industry Issues.
Job Purpose:
The primary role of the Patient Care Coordinator is to support the Care Team (Doctor, Nurse, Dietician, Physiotherapist, etc) by coordinating care to patients on the provider s daily schedule and by proactive interventions.
- Will act as a conduit for the transmission of information between providers and patients.
- Will coordinate Medical and Support services for all patients.
- Will facilitate information flow and referral services for patients to address their medical and psychosocial needs.
Job Responsibilities:
Facilitate the care team in coordinating care for visits and for future healthcare needs and ensure that proper care has been provided to each patient as per plan.
Handle calls from patients if needed. Resolve the reason for the call or route to the appropriate party.
Provide an effective communication link between patient and medical staff, including relaying messages from providers, gathering information from patients for providers, etc.
Support in the medication refill process. Ensure that information goes when and where it is needed.
Coordination with clinical and non-clinical support services (Laboratory, OT, Admission, Billing, F&B, House Keeping, Pharmacy, and Maintece) to facilitate the IP Care.
Ensure that all patients are tracked and data entered into systems for follow-up and reporting.
Coordinate with the medical staff to ensure that case management services are provided to patients with complex medical and/or psychosocial problems.
Work with the medical staff to develop, implement and carry out improvement programs
Ensure that disease and other registry data entry is up to date and use registry
Use and update the directory of resources in the service area to meet basic health and human needs. Be facile at using the resources available within the Center.
Act as a back-up to other Patient Care Coordinator or to other Care Team members as needed.
Facilitate the admission and discharge process as per policy.
Act proactively in quality improvement program.
Perform other duties as assigned by relevant authorities.
Candidate Requirements:
Proficiency in verbal communication in English and understanding of basic written English.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Demonstrated problem solving skills in a complex environment.
Demonstrated effective interpersonal relationships and customer service skills.
Good organizational and time management skills
Good working knowledge of local social service resources or skills to acquire and use this knowledge and information expeditiously.
Ability to work effectively with people from diverse cultures and diverse socioeconomic situations.
Basic level of skill with Microsoft Word, Excel and ability to use other computer programs and applications in ways that facilitate panel management.
Behavioral Competencies:
Accountability: For the relevant processes
Customer-Focus: Listen to the voice of the customer and strive to delight them by exceeding their expectations
Teamwork: If someone needs help, help them
Initiative: Be innovative, apply fresh ideas, and continuously improve how you do your work
Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality and respect the privacy of others
Ethical: Demonstrate integrity, honesty, and stewardship in all encounters at work
Respect: Demonstrate consideration and appreciation for co-workers and patients
Communication: Demonstrate the ability to convey thoughts and ideas as well as understand perspective of others

Job Introduction:
Job Description of Lady Security Guard
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergency situations, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.

Reporting daily to Supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorized person
Write appropriate reports as required

Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves

Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from employer and 12% from Employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women

Physically and Medically fit and look like mature

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
We are looking for an HR Recruiter with 1 year of experience to manage end-to-end recruitment, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, and onboarding activities.

AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Digital drive and self-service adoption

Description:
Job Title: Showroom Manager
Department: Retail Sales
Company: TBZ LTD.
Type: Permanent
Location: Raipur

Job Description:
Assist in the planning process
Adhere to the budget guidelines for store.
Implement short-term operating plans and adhere to budgets provided.
Ensure control over operating expenses in the store.
Achieve the store sales and operating expenses targets while maintaining focus on quality of customer service in stores.
Coordinate with merchandizing team to ensure the supply of merchandise to store as per the demand.
Deliver store sales and operating expenses targets on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis.
Ensure high level of customer service and customer delight.
Ensure the creation of right shopping ambience in the stores.
Adhere to reverse logistics (for old gold) guidelines as per the defined SOPs.
Support in execution of any activities aimed at increasing sales.
Provide inputs for the merchandize requirements at the store based on store specific sales patterns and consumer preferences and provide proactive feedback on aspects of inventory levels, pricing, promotions, shelf space utilization.
Responsible for conducting daily security checks in the store.
Oversee the forecasting of demand basis the sales each day and transfer the knowledge around the fast moving designs and latest trends.
Implement the loss prevention activities in the store as per the guidelines.
Monitor processes to minimize losses due to shop lifting or pilferage.
Generate all the required reports (Daily sales and collections, monthly and quarterly MIS, market intelligence reports etc.).
Support business process re-engineering team in conducting audits in the store and take corrective actions for the processes which come out as improvement areas in audit results.
Provide inputs for support and execution of facility management activities.
Support Regional Marketing Manager in executing all the marketing related activities.
Execute the advertisement and promotions plans in the store.
Support marketing team for executing visual merchandising activities in the store.
Ensure adherence to the stores standard operating procedures to drive efficiency and utilize communication channels to provide upward feedback from time to time.
Follow all store operations SOPs and work towards continuous improvement of the same.
Conduct self audits in the store on regular basis.
Oversee all point of sales activities in the store which includes - sales transactions, tracking customer orders and payments, registering sale and maintaining inventory updates, providing service, handling old gold and after sales service, gathering consumer data for feedback.
Oversee the inventory management process in the store.
Oversee that the store staff is presentable and well groomed.
Guide the staff to increase sales as well as profitability.
Monitor the overall training and development needs of staff in the store.
Impart training regarding product knowledge, promotion offers and schemes etc.
Support Regional Retail Operations Manager in identifying processes and trainings on aspects which will facilitate maximizing the conversion ratio in the stores.
Nominate staff at regular intervals for the relevant training programs.
Perform the role of a people manager.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, customer focus, entrepreneurship and team work for all the employees in the store.
Manage and support recruitment, set KRA's for direct reports, monitor overall store KRA's, conduct performance appraisal.

Interested candidates kindly share the profiles on sandip.shaw@tbzoriginal.com

Thanks & Regards
Sandip Shaw

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Job Summary:
Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Performs activities under a moderate degree of supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Assists with data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Assists with associate functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Responds to, or redirects, routine inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately. Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees. Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures. Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed. Performs other routine administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.
To drive secondary sales through distributors and DSRs and engage directly with retailers, rebuilders, OEM dealers, independent workshops, institutional customers, and fleet customers. The resource will also focus on educating customers about company policies, schemes, and product benefits, maintaining accurate sales data, and ensuring timely communication of all required information to channel partners.
Competencies:
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

Project Schedule Management - Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc. ) in such a way that the target audience (e. g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc. ) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Essential Services : Role & Location Fungibility
At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the program
The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals with "Seva Bhav" - values of humility, adaptability, and a zeal to learn. Focused on relationship management, it emphasizes empathy, professionalism, and providing banking solutions to customers. The program includes extensive residential training, followed by nationwide placements in relationship management (sales) roles.
The Probationary Officer Program will prepare selected applicants for Relationship Manager (RM) job, which is a sales role. This role will involve client interactions and will require travel within and around the assigned location/city.
Selected applicants shall be placed in any location based on the requirements of the Bank and will undergo a rigorous training by ICICI Bank.

Eligibility
Education: Graduates, Engineers, Post-Graduate
Qualification: 60% and above in 10th and Graduation
Role and Location Fungibility: Applicant should be locationally mobile and willing to do sales

Program Structure
Program Duration: 2 Months Classroom Training


Selection Process
Online Aptitude Test: Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
Interview (Face-to-Face): Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in-person interview. Interview details will be shared on your registered email ID.

Job Summary
Responsible for doing village surveys, getting new customers, do CGT, house verification and income assessment, do quality sourcing, ensure collections and recoveries are done as per the group/centre meeting schedule. Maintain Healthy Customer Relationships on ground in the location.
Responsibilities
Conduct village surveys and do prospecting in selected villages, explain BFL MFI JLG product offerings to all who attend prospecting briefing.
Source New Customers in the locations allocated, form JLG groups and promote financial literacy amongst potential borrowers.
Collect all information needed for sourcing, data entry / upload and/or validate documents on LOS, follow entire sourcing process as defined in SOP.

Ensure recovery disposition reconciliation is done with Credit and Ops Officer as per schedule.
Ensuring critical parameters like lead to login are executed as per matrix.
Maintain centre meeting discipline, follow SOPs and code of conduct.
Major Challenges
Quality sourcing and achieving targets as defined.
Regular collections and maintaining customers in current bucket, regularizing and normalizing delinquent customers.
Compliance on all business parameters, zero audit findings on his / her sourced customer segment / portfolio.
