Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead
AboutCompany:
The foundation of Shoppers' Stop was laid on October 27, 1991 by the K. Raheja Corp. group of companies. Being amongst India's biggest hospitality and real estate players, the Group crossed yet another milestone with its lifestyle venture - Shoppers' Stop.

From its inception, Shoppers' Stop has progressed from being a single brand shop to becoming a Fashion & Lifestyle store for the family. Today, Shoppers' Stop is a household name, known for its superior quality products, services and above all, for providing a complete shopping experience. We have 20 company owned stores scattered across 9 nine cities in India.

With an immense amount of expertise and credibility, Shoppers' Stop has become the highest benchmark for the Indian retail industry. In fact, the company's continious expansion plans aim to help Shoppers' Stop meet the challenges of the retail industry in an even better manner than it does today.

Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
Job Description: Senior GCP Lead
HGS is a global provider of technology, AI, and business services that helps organizations transform with confidence. At HGS, we combine technology, AI, and human expertise to deliver Intelligent Experiences that drive growth and transformation. Our strong foundation in CX enables us to create impactful solutions across industries. Through our Realized AI approach, we deliver practical innovation with measurable outcomes. Part of the multi-billion-dollar Hinduja Group, HGS takes a globally local approach with 17,000+ employees across 10 countries and 23 delivery centers.”

Position Summary:
As a Senior GCP Lead, you are the primary technical architect and strategic advisor for our most complex Google Cloud data engagements. You will own the high-level design of the data ecosystem, lead large-scale digital transformations, and ensure that technical solutions translate into tangible business ROI. This role requires a balance of architectural mastery, commercial awareness, and technical mentorship.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Architecture: Design end-to-end data ecosystems using Data Mesh or Medallion patterns.
Technical Authority: Hands on knowledge in BigQuery and Dataflow/Dataproc ETL design and automation using workflows or Airflow, Should be able to efficiently do RCA using logging and monitoring tools.
Performance & Cost Governance: Conduct deep-dive audits of BigQuery usage.
FinOps Strategy: Own the BigQuery Reservation strategy and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.
Governance Frameworks: Architect organization-wide standards for Dataplex, security, and PII compliance.
Platform Security: Establish advanced security perimeters using VPC Service Controls and CMEK.
Team Leadership: Mentor Senior Engineers and define the technical standard for the entire practice. Participate in design discussions, code review, production deployment planning/cutover, data discovery sessions
Modernization Lead: Drive large-scale migrations from legacy on-prem systems to GCP Native solutions. Experience with third party data ingestion to GCP BQ/GCS

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field;

Experience and Requirements:
Experience: 12+ years in Data Engineering, with 5+ years of specialized experience in Google Cloud.
Expertise: Deep, internal-level knowledge of BigQuery, BigLake, Dataflow, Dataproc, GCS, Data transfer services, Pubsub, cloud DLP.
AI/ML: Familiarity with operationalizing ML models via BigQuery ML and Vertex AI Pipelines (optional).
Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and proficiency in Terraform/Cloudbuild/docker, CI/CD pipelines.
Certification: Professional Data Engineer (GCP) is mandatory.
Tools: Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines building for automated code deployments.
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

Job Title: Senior Winshuttle Developer
Location: Hyderabad \ Indore
Duration : Full time.

Responsibilities:
5-9Years experience with solution scoping, development and delivery with Precisely (Winshuttle) Foundation, Evolve, Studio, Composer and SAP
Development and enhancement of Evolve forms, workflows and scripts for data creation and data modification as per business needs
Execute Winshuttle scripts ,Data extract, transform and load using Evolve
Automate SAP steps into Evolve workflow and Integrate with SAP and other systems
Data extraction for analytics and reporting purposes
Should have experience in SAP implementation with Winshuttle as data load tool with SAP ECC or S/4HANA
Should have extensively worked on Winshuttle Transaction, Winshuttle Query and Winshuttle Direct.
Responsible for design, development, testing, loading and reconciliation while using Winshuttle.
Experience with SAP Data Migration tools, ETL and other Data migration tools is an advantage.
Should be hands-on with development techniques as well.
Knowledge of master data structures in SAP FI/SD/PP/MM/BP modules and dependencies is a must.
ABAP Programming (Module Pool , BAPI/RFC ,BADI,API,ALE/EDI IDOC , SOAP,BDC) and Functional (SD,PP,MM,QM)
Troubleshooting and Support.
Knowledge of MDM solutions to create and maintain master data
Knowledge on SAP S/4 and other SAP models that would require converted data in a transformation program
Able to assist in cut-over planning.
Experience with leading a team across different process areas, geographies, work forces and technical expertise.
Coordination with Project team stakeholders – Business / Data Owners, SAP Functional teams, SAP ABAP / Basis teams, ETL teams, Legacy data team etc.
Should have rich experience in Data transformation Procedures, Post migration data validation procedures, Data retention, Data security procedures.
Required Skills and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities
Excellent written and oral communication as well as interpersonal skills
Experience working directly with various levels of client or internal team members including management
Highly motivated and able to perform in a remote work environment, independently as well as in team settings
Self-starter approach to work with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives

Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Description:
Job Description

Project Role :Test Automation Engineer


Project Role Description :Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end-to-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
Must have skills :DevOps

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps/SRE Engineer with advanced experience in AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and reliability engineering. The role involves leading large-scale cloud initiatives, designing resilient architectures, improving system performance, and driving DevOps/SRE best practices across teams. Roles Responsibilities:1 Cloud Architecture AWS Expertise Design, implement, and optimize scalable, high-availability, and secure infrastructure on AWS. Architect network topologies including VPCs, subnets, route tables, NAT/IGW, Transit Gateway. Lead deployments for AWS services:EC2, ASG, ALB/NLB, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, EKS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudFront. Implement enterprise-grade security practices:IAM fine-grained policies, KMS encryption, WAF, GuardDuty, SCP policies. Drive cost optimization strategies:rightsizing, RI/Savings Plans, storage optimization. 2 Infrastructure as Code Automation Define IaC standards and build reusable modules using Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK. Automate provisioning of compute, networking, databases, and cluster components. Build advanced automation for deployments, scaling, patching, and configuration workflows. Mentor team members on IaC structures, environment segregation, and GitOps workflows. 3 CI/CD Release Engineering Architect and maintain complex CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline. Implement progressive delivery (blue/green, canary deployments) on Kubernetes or ECS/EKS. Introduce automated testing, security scanning, and deployment quality gates. Optimize release cycles and improve deployment frequency and stability. 4 Kubernetes Container Platforms Lead design and operations of EKS, ECS, or hybrid Kubernetes environments. Define cluster standards:node pools, networking, storage classes, ingress, autoscaling (HPA/Cluster Autoscaler). Manage Helm charts, GitOps operators (ArgoCD / Flux), and multi-cluster workloads. Enforce security controls (RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, secrets management). 5 Observability Reliability Engineering Build organization-wide observability using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK, OpenTelemetry. Implement distributed tracing, SLO/SLA monitoring, performance baselines, and anomaly detection. Lead major incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and reliability improvements. Build automated alerting strategies to reduce noise and improve MTTR. 6 Security, Compliance Governance Implement DevSecOps practices including vulnerability scanning, secret rotation, and policy enforcement. Use AWS security tools (Config, Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty) for governance. Establish environment separation, audit compliance, and SOC2/ISO-ready controls. 7 Leadership Collaboration Lead technical discussions, system architecture reviews, and cross-team DevOps adoption. Mentor junior and mid-level DevOps/SREs and build documentation/playbooks. Work closely with developers, architects, and product teams to improve reliability and performance. Professional
Technical Experience 6+ years DevOps/SRE experience in production-grade environments. Expert-level AWS skills:compute, networking, databases, storage, scaling, managed services. Strong hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS preferred). Expertise in Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. Strong CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions/Jenkins/Azure DevOps). Deep understanding of Linux, shell scripting, Python/Bash, debugging, and system internals. Strong knowledge of networking (DNS, load balancers, firewalls, VPC networking). Experience with monitoring/logging tools:Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK. Hands-on experience with distributed systems, microservices, and performance tuning. Nice to Have AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer Professional). Experience with Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd). Exposure to zero-downtime upgrades and multi-region active-active architectures. Knowledge of SSO, OAuth2, Cognito, Okta. Additional informationBachelor degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
Qualification15 years full time education

We are seeking a dynamic Mid-Level Application Architects / Senior Developers with a strong focus on hands-on development and practical solution design. The ideal candidate will have robust experience in .NET Core, MVC, and Python, with working knowledge of front-end technologies like React or Angular, and a foundational understanding of AI integration. This role emphasizes active coding, solution implementation, and collaboration across application development, infrastructure, and integration in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to deliver scalable, secure enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities:
Hands-On Coding:Actively develop, test, and deploy application-heavy solutions, write clean, efficient code in any of the programming languages like .NET Core (C#, ASP.NET), and Python for backend systems, and contributing to front-end development using React or Angular.
Solution Design:Partner with senior architects to design scalable, cloud-native application architectures, focusing on performance, maintainability, and integration in multi-cloud environments.
Integration Development:Build and maintain integrations using APIs, microservices, and event-driven patterns (e.g., REST, GraphQL, Kafka, or message queues).
Multi-Cloud Implementation:Develop and deploy applications across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring portability and optimization for cost and performance.
AI Integration:Implement practical AI features (e.g., automation, basic analytics) using cloud-based AI services or frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Infrastructure Support:Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement containerized solutions (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on use of IaC tools like Terraform or BiCep.
Performance & Security Optimization:Ensure applications meet performance and security standards through code reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices.
Team Collaboration:Work closely with developers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into technical implementations, providing hands-on support and mentorship.
Continuous Learning:Stay updated on full-stack development trends, cloud technologies, and AI advancements to contribute to innovative solutions.
Qualifications & Skills:
Experience:5 to 12 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development, with at least 2 years in a lead developer or junior architect role focusing on application-heavy systems.
Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Strong proficiency in .NET, and Python for backend development.
Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or similar.
Basic exposure to AI/ML integration, such as using cloud AI services (e.g., Azure Open AI, Azure Foundry, AWS SageMaker,) or simple ML frameworks.
Practical experience with integration patterns (e.g., REST APIs, message queues) and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC (e.g., Terraform, BiCep).
Experience with cloud-native services (e.g., Azure Functions, LogicApps, ServiceBus etc.).
Working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools.
Understanding of secure coding practices and basic enterprise security standards (e.g., IAM, encryption). Soft Skills:
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with a hands-on mindset.
Clear communication to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to juggle hands-on coding with architectural design contributions.
Eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and cloud technologies.Education:
Bachelor??s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications like Azure Developer Associate, Azure AI Fundamentals or similar are a plus.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Entry level management position that leads the banquet staff while personally assisting in executing events based on requirements and standards.
Develops and directs team to provide consistent, high quality service.
Communicates performance expectations and trains staff in processes.
Responsible for managing ficial and administrative duties.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Department Operations and Inventories
- Manages departmental inventories and assets including par levels and maintece of equipment.
- Conducts monthly department meetings with the Banquet captains and employees.
- Maintains attendance log for banquet employees.
- Maintains and enforces established sanitation levels.
- Adheres to and reinforces all standards, policies, and procedures (SOPs, LSOPs, etc).
- Ensures employee awareness of the event phase portion of the Meeting Planner Survey and Guest Satisfaction Scores.
- Orders supplies for the department (eg, china, glass, silver, buffet presentations, props, and other service equipment needs).
- Uses banquet beverage Use records to guide banquet beverage supervisor in controlling liquor costs, managing the banquet beverage perpetual inventory and requisitioning liquor.
- Understands the impact Banquet operations has on the overall success of an event and manages activities to maximize customer satisfaction.
- Schedules banquet service staff to forecast and service standards, while maximizing profits.
Participating in and Leading Banquet Teams
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
- Leads shifts and actively participates in the servicing of events.
- Applies and continually broadens knowledge of food and wine pairings and cutting edge cuisine, and overall event presentation.
Providing and Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Reviews quarterly Meeting Planner Survey and participates in the development and implementation of corrective action to address service challenges; focuses on continuous improvement of guest satisfaction.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Interviews and hires Banquet captains and employees with appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Communicates and executes departmental and property emergency procedures and ensures staff are trained in safety procedures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Job Summary
The Front Office Executive is responsible for managing patient registration, appointments, billing, queries, and report dispatch while ensuring a seamless patient experience and efficient front office operations. The role acts as the first point of contact for patients, doctors, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities
Manage front office operations, patient registration, appointments, and billing activities.
Welcome patients and visitors, address enquiries, and provide prompt support for patient-related concerns.
Coordinate with doctors, technicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure smooth patient flow and service delivery.
Handle incoming calls, emails, messages, and appointment requests professionally while maintaining confidentiality.
Maintain accurate records of patient registrations, appointments, billing information, and report dispatch in the designated systems.
Ensure timely collection of payments, documentation of corporate cases, and daily cash reconciliation.
Assist patients with test appointments, doctor consultations, report collection, and emergency requirements.
Ensure compliance with company policies, operational SOPs, and patient data confidentiality standards.
Maintain a professional, customer-centric environment at the reception and waiting area.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
2-4 years of experience in front office, patient relations, customer service, or healthcare operations.
Strong understanding of healthcare processes, medical terminology, and patient handling practices.
Good knowledge of billing, appointment management, and hospital/diagnostic centre operations.
Proficient in MS Office and hospital/diagnostic management systems.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Ability to multitask, resolve patient concerns, and work effectively under pressure with attention to detail.

Key Competencies
Customer Service Excellence
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Patient Relationship Management
Attention to Detail
Multitasking & Time Management
Problem Solving
Professionalism & Confidentiality
Team Collaboration
AboutCompany: Established in 1992 as Suraksha Diagnostics Private Ltd. in Kolkata, we started as one of the first diagnostic centers in Kolkata to provide all pathology and radiology services under one roof. This convenience, along with our unwavering commitment to accuracy and service, resulted in steady growth and popularity. Within 3 years we could confidently open a second Center at Siliguri, in North Bengal, which remains the largest such facility in the region, and today serves not only to patients from North Bengal, but also neighbouring States and countries. Since then, we have grown steadily across West Bengal, Bihar, Assam and Shillong.

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura
Join Us & Be the Digital Face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers!

1. Position Details
Designation: Sales Officer
Location: South Tripura
Department: Trade Sales
Reporting To: ASM/TSM
Salary Range: As per market standards
Experience: 23 years in Sales / Channel Management
Qualification: Graduation (MBA / Marketing preferred)
2. Role Purpose
The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
About Bleep Education :

Bleep Education is a growing EdTech organization committed to providing quality educational services and professional development opportunities. We focus on nurturing young professionals and helping them gain valuable industry experience through practical exposure.

Job Overview:

As a Business Development Associate, you will be responsible for driving growth and expanding Bleep Education's reach. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent communication and sales skills to identify new business opportunities, build relationships, and contribute to revenue generation.

Key Responsibilities:

Identify and generate leads for training and internship programs.
Build relationships with potential clients, students, and educational institutions.
Conduct market research to understand customer needs and industry trends.
Bleep Educations offerings effectively and convert prospects into customers.
Work closely with the marketing team to align business development strategies.
Handle inquiries, follow up on leads, and ensure a smooth sales process.
Maintain records of sales performance and report progress to management.
Travel as needed for business development activities (expenses reimbursed as per policy).

Requirement:

Presentation Skills and Communication.
Lead Generation and Market Research.
Experience in creating effective presentations.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to conduct market research and generate leads.
Strong organizational and time-management skills

Eligibility Criteria:

All freshers and final-year students are eligible.
No prior experience is required.
Strong willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

Description:
Job Title: R&D Executive Seasonings (Product Development)
Company: Pran Beverages India Limited (PBIL)
Location: Agartala, Tripura
Experience: 4 years
Role Summary
Develop and improve seasonings and spice blends for snacks and food products, from lab trials to plant scale-up.
Key Responsibilities
Develop new seasoning formulations and improve existing ones for taste, cost and shelf life
Benchmark competitor products and match target flavour profiles
Run sensory evaluations, stability tests and plant trials
Coordinate with vendors and flavour houses for samples and ingredients
Maintain formulation sheets, trial reports and specifications
Ensure FSSAI, allergen and HACCP compliance
Requirements
B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science or Chemistry
2-6 years in seasoning/NPD in FMCG, snacks, spices or a flavour house
Knowledge of spices, flavour enhancers and flavour chemistry
Good coordination skills with QA, production, procurement and marketing
Proficiency in MS Excel
Keywords: seasoning, spice blends, savoury flavours, snack seasoning, NPD, food technology, sensory evaluation, scale-up

Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based in Tripura and will report to the Program Lead.


Responsibilities
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the Block professionals.
Manage Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and cont. feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge's financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the SRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support TRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the extremely vulnerable families through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the DAY-NRLM
Support TRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in extreme poverty.
Support TRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Tripura such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the extremely vulnerable


What's in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.
.

the founder mindset
Data Management Reporting
Documentation Skills
Operations Management
solutions at population scale
better, together
purpose at the center
field operations

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications & Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.
