Description:
Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.
Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation plans, and deployment strategies to ensure timely project completion.
Supervise site execution activities, including civil, structural, electrical, module mounting, inverter installation, cabling, and earthing works.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, vendors, contractors, and site teams to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Manage project costs, control expenses, and ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, quality procedures, and project specifications.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government authorities, DISCOMs, and other stakeholders for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and project-related clearances.
Monitor installation, testing, commissioning, and performance verification of solar PV systems.
Identify project risks, resolve site-level technical and operational issues, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and cost overruns.
Conduct regular site visits and review contractor performance, work progress, safety practices, and quality of execution.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, MIS, budget updates, and management review reports.
Ensure proper documentation of drawings, material records, inspection reports, commissioning certificates, and project handover documents.
Coordinate with the operations and maintenance team for smooth project handover and resolution of pending issues.
Lead and manage project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors to achieve project delivery targets.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of solar PV systems, solar EPC execution, and project management.
Experience in project planning, site execution, commissioning, and contractor management.
Knowledge of electrical systems, solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, and grid connectivity.
Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling, cost estimation, and project reporting.
Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.
AboutCompany:
Company Profile:
Surya International Enterprise Pvt Ltd, the CRISIL BBB rated flagship company of Surya Group, is a multifaceted conglomerate operating in diverse fields such as Solar Energy, Manufacturing, Water Industry, Plastic Recycling, and Fintech. Our core mission is to provide sustainable and affordable green energy and water solutions through cutting-edge technology.
Surya Group has been on an exceptional growth trajectory for over a decade, achieving remarkable operational and financial milestones. With a net worth exceeding 125 Crores and an annual turnover of 325 Crores in the last financial year, our growth story is a testament to our unwavering commitment to excellence.
Over the past 10 years, we have successfully installed more than 100MW of on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar power plants, solidifying our position as a leader in the renewable energy sector. Additionally, we have made significant strides in improving access to clean water by installing over 40,000 solar streetlights, 5,000 solar-powered water pumping systems, and 300 MLD of iron, fluoride, and arsenic water treatment plants, benefiting more than 10 lakh rural households.
Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Gurgaon, Coimbatore, Katihar, and Gaya produce high-quality products such as Lithium-Ion batteries, HDPE Tanks, HDPE & PVC Pipes, FRP vessels, Recycled Plastic Granules, and LLDP powder, among others. Furthermore, we have established a Mega Factory in the heart of Infovalley-2 EMC Park in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to the production of high-quality solar modules. Additionally, we have another mega factory in the Ghiloth Industrial Area, Rajasthan, further expanding our manufacturing capabilities.
At Surya Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment that encourages innovation and growth. As an equal opportunity employer, we value the diverse perspectives and experiences of our skilled workforce, which spans around 500 employees across India, with 170 employees based at our Head Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Our geographical presence extends to various states, including Odisha, Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam, Tripura, Mizoram, Kolkata, and Kerala, among others.
We invite talented individuals to join our dynamic and purpose-driven team, where they can contribute to our mission of creating a sustainable future while advancing their careers in a supportive and inclusive environment.
For more information, please visit www.groupsurya.co.in and www.solar2roof.com.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.


Required Skills
Academic Counselling
Admission Guidance
Admission Counselling
Student Counselling
Higher Education
College Admissions
University Admissions
Student Support
Educational Consultancy
Client Handling
Communication Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Documentation
Application Processing
Online Research
MS Office
Email Communication
CRM
Follow-Up Management
Record Keeping


Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.
Agartala
This is a Full-Time, Office-Based position .

Field Coordination

Documentation and Reporting

Submit reports to the Project Coordinator or designated authority.
Essential Qualification

Education
Human Resources
Psychology
A related field

Experience in student assessment, counselling, education, career guidance, or school-based projects.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work with school students sensitively and professionally.
Basic computer proficiency, including MS Excel, online forms, and digital reporting.
Ability to organise field activities independently.
Knowledge of Bengali is compulsory.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned block.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research,design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iteratethe design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM, Agartala, to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) & Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based at the concerned blocks of Tripura, work closely with block officials of TRLM and will report to the Program Lead.

What will you do
Understand and practice the values and spirit of The/Nudge Institute and the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
Identify and select vulnerable women in the designated project geographies across the state.
Mobilize vulnerable women into hamlet-level groups and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Support the selection, placement, and capacity building of community cadres from local villages/Gram Panchayats to provide intensive handholding and facilitation support to targeted vulnerable women and their households.
Facilitate vulnerable households access to eligible government entitlements and social security schemes by leveraging convergence platforms, including community cadres, community institutions, social capital, block-level line departments, and internal convergence mechanisms within the SRLM.
Facilitate livelihood planning for targeted households and support them in accessing formal credit and loans through community institutions to establish and strengthen livelihood activities.
Strengthen the capacities of community institutions and community cadres to ensure the long-term well-being of vulnerable women by fostering community ownership through the communitization process.
Ensure that all project activities are implemented on time and with the highest quality, in accordance with the approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Package of Practices (PoPs), and Community Operational Manual (COM).
Ensure the timely collection, entry, processing, analysis, and reporting of program data.
Develop case studies and contribute contextualized content to strengthen the programs knowledge management initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with grassroots stakeholders to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration.
What s in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
Contact 639865 2832
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3 Lakhs - 3.5 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

We are looking for an Assistant Project Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations and management of the Mobile Medical Unit (MMU) project. Coordinate and monitor the day-to-day operations of Mobile Medical Units (MMUs).
Coordinate with Doctors, Nurses, Pharmacists, Drivers, and other field staff.

Track daily MMU visits, patient services, medical camps, and other project activities.

Coordinate with government officials, project authorities, and other stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications-


Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG qualification will be an added advantage.
24 years of relevant experience in project coordination, healthcare operations, MMU/ambulance operations, government projects, or a similar field.
Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and MIS reporting.
Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Good team management and organizational abilities.
Ability to coordinate with field teams and government/client representatives.
Strong problem-solving and time-management skills.
Willingness to travel for field visits as required.
Candidates with experience in MMU, 108 Ambulance, healthcare, emergency services, or government projects will be preferred.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Job Summary
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.
Eight hours per day

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development . The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers .
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Description:
We are looking for an Associate Business Head to lead our ed-tech firm's growth and profitability. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business, including sales, marketing, product development, and operations, and driving the P&L of the designated branch.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability for the business.
Build and lead a high-performing team to execute the company's goals and objectives.
Identify new market opportunities and develop plans to expand the company's customer base.
Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the company's products and services.
Manage product development initiatives, including ideation, design, and launch.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of products and services to customers.
Develop and manage the P&L for the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Identify and manage key business risks, including competitive threats, regulatory changes, and market fluctuations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including investors, partners, and customers.
Represent the company at industry events and conferences.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA preferred.
At least 3+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, with a track record of driving business growth and profitability.
Experience in the ed-tech industry is highly preferred.
Strong business acumen and financial management skills, with experience managing P&L for a business unit.
Excellent leadership and management skills, with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to develop and execute complex business plans.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias towards action and a willingness to take risks.

Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.

Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.

Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.

Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.

Key Responsibilities:
Process vendor invoices accurately, validate supporting documents, and resolve discrepancies promptly.

2-8 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable and Employee Claims processes, preferably in a shared services environment.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) in English.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and accountability.
Strong interpersonal and vendor management skills.
Proactive, dependable, and a collaborative team player.
Ability to work independently with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise clients and manage day-to-day client relationships.
Handle client escalations and ensure timely resolution while maintaining SLA commitments.
Coordinate with internal operations, warehouse, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
Monitor account performance, identify process improvement opportunities, and drive operational excellence.
Prepare and maintain MIS reports using Microsoft Excel.
Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and service quality.
Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve operational issues and improve customer experience.

What we're looking for
2+ years of experience in Client Servicing, Key Account Management, Customer Success, or Operations.
Strong experience in client relationship management and escalation handling.
Experience working with enterprise/B2B clients.
Good understanding of SLA management and operational coordination.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting.
Excellent communication skills in English; Hindi is an added advantage.
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and multitasking abilities.
Experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, e-commerce, mobility, or operations-driven environments is preferred

Description:
Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP FICO with strong integration skills across MM and SD modules.
Proven expertise in process flows like Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, and Availability to Produce.
Hands-on configuration experience in Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Product Costing, FSCM, and COPA.
Ability to independently write Functional Specifications and work on custom object development and deployment.
Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project.
Exposure to Concur, Travel & Expense (T&E), industry-specific solutions, and customer-facing roles is a strong advantage.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to work with clients to identify business challenges and contribute to client deliverables by refining, analyzing, and structuring relevant data
Awareness of latest technologies and trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge

We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Jaipur, Mysore, Hubli, Vizag.

While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.
Educational RequirementBachelor of Engineering
Preferred SkillsTechnology->SAP Functional->SAP Controlling,Technology->SAP Functional->SAP Finance
Service LineEnterprise Package Application Services

Description:
Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to lead the engagement effort of providing high-quality and value-adding consulting solutions to customers at different stages- from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design, development and deployment.

You will review the proposals prepared by consultants, provide guidance, and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues.

You will identify change Management requirements and propose a structured approach to client for managing the change using multiple communication mechanisms.

You will also coach and create a vision for the team, provide subject matter training for your focus areas, motivate and inspire team members through effective and timely feedback and recognition for high performance.

You would be a key contributor in unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high-quality, value-adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
9 + years of work experience (certification is preference) in Callidus Cloud (SAP) Commissions.
Experience in Callidus Cloud Advanced Workflows is added advantage. Knowledge of Crystal reports is also a plus.
Should have experience of working in at least 1 end to end implementations in Callidus Cloud Commissions.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to develop value-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge
Client Interfacing skills
Project and Team management

Location of posting - Infosys Ltd. is committed to ensuring you have the best experience throughout your journey with us. We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Mumbai, Jaipur, Mysore and Hubli. While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.
Educational RequirementBachelor of Engineering
Preferred SkillsTechnology->SAP Functional->SAP Commissions
Service LineEnterprise Package Application Services

Description:
Job Title : 9 - Ind & Func AI Decision Science Associate Manager
Management Level : 8 - Associate Manager
Location: Bangalore/ Hyderabad
Must have skills: Gen AI
Good to have skills: Python, SQL

Job Summary:
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.
In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.
Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency.
Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.
Professional & Technical Skills:
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.
Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.

Additional Information:
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.


Qualification
Experience: 4+ years
Educational Qualification: Btech/ BE

Title: Store Operations Professional
Skills: Store operations, About the company, Starbucks, 4.1, 996 employee reviews, Hotels & RestaurantsFood ProcessingJV, Follow, 122.0k followers, Overview, Every day, we go to work hoping to do two things: share great coffee with our friends and help make the world a little better. It was true when the first Starbucks opened in 1971, and it’s just as true today.
Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions

HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Senior Analyst (5-8 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts

Oracle HCM Cloud certification

5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator

Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking Apprentice to join our Bangalore Gurugram office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and nuclear domains.
Your Role
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
About you
Essential:
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Desirable:
Exposure to international engineering standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC)
Understanding of 3D modelling concepts and BIM maturity levels
Familiarity with:
BIM Execution Plan (BEP)
Xrefs / model linking
Common Data Environments (CDEs)
Interest or exposure to Scan-to-BIM workflows

Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.

We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Administration Manager (Corporate)
Oversees daily office operations, facility management, vendor contracts, budgets, and administrative staff to ensure seamless business continuity.
Core Responsibilities
Office & Facility Management:
F Oversee corporate workspace allocation, building maintenance, housekeeping, utilities, security systems, and meeting room infrastructure.
