Vendor & Procurement Management:
F Negotiate vendor contracts (security, travel, catering, maintenance, high-end office suppliers, facilities engineering), while tracking operational spend against strict corporate budgets. Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and manage office supply inventory.
Budget & Cost Control:
F Prepare and manage departmental operating budgets, track expenses, and identify cost-saving efficiencies.
Travel & Event Logistics:
F Oversee seamless, high-touch support for senior partners and visiting clients, including boardroom hospitality, local fine-dining coordination, and rapid response requests.
F Coordinate end-to-end logistics for high-profile client workshops, corporate retreats, case study events, and internal networking seminars.
F Supervise the travel desk handling highly fluid, last-minute global itineraries, visa processing, premium hotel partnerships, and corporate card reconciliations.
Compliance & Policy Execution:
F Enforce internal corporate policies, health and safety regulations, fire safety drills, and statutory/legal compliance.
Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting:
F Maintain digital/physical record systems, asset registers, and generate regular operational reports for senior leadership.
Confidentiality & Information Security:
F Enforce strict physical data protection protocols (e.g., clean-desk policies, secure disposal, guest access controls) to safeguard sensitive client project data.
Team Supervision:
F Hire, train, schedule, and evaluate administrative support staff, receptionists, and facilities coordinators.

3. Strong leadership and people management.
4. Vendor negotiation and contract lifecycle management.
5. Problem-solving under pressure and crisis management.
6. Flawless executive communication and stakeholder management.
7. Extreme discretion, emotional intelligence, and professional etiquette.
8. Agility to handle fast-changing schedules and urgent, last-minute requests.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 2-5 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.

Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.

Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled PLM Teamcenter Support Engineer with 3-8 years of relevant experience in PLM, Teamcenter Support, ITK, BMIDE, and Active Workspace (AWC) Customization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting, configuring, customizing, and maintaining Teamcenter environments while collaborating with business users, development teams, and stakeholders to ensure smooth PLM operations.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 support for Siemens Teamcenter PLM applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve Teamcenter production issues and user-reported incidents.
Develop and maintain customizations using ITK (Integration Toolkit).
Configure and customize Teamcenter using BMIDE (Business Modeler IDE).
Perform Active Workspace (AWC) Customization and enhancements.
Develop workflows, handlers, business rules, and validations in Teamcenter.
Support Teamcenter upgrades, patches, deployments, and migrations.
Analyze business requirements and implement PLM solutions.
Monitor application performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with business users, product engineering teams, and IT stakeholders.
Create technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management activities.
Required Skills
3-8 years of experience in PLM Teamcenter Support.
Strong experience in Siemens Teamcenter.
Hands-on experience in ITK Development.
Expertise in BMIDE Customization and Configuration.
Experience with Active Workspace (AWC) Customization.
Knowledge of Teamcenter Architecture and Data Model.
Experience in Workflow Development and Customization.
Understanding of Teamcenter Access Manager and Security.
Experience in Teamcenter deployment and support activities.
Strong SQL and database knowledge.
Experience with Unix/Linux and Windows environments.
Good debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter SOA and Web Services.
Teamcenter RAC Customization.
Java and JavaScript development experience.
Teamcenter Integration with CAD tools (NX, CATIA, Creo, SolidWorks).
Knowledge of T4S/T4EA integrations.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience with Jenkins, Git, and DevOps practices.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Job Description:
Core Finance Change Delivery
Key Responsibilities
Avaloq - Monthly Goca Maintenance
Support the maintenance and updates of the Chart of Accounts of the Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System - Swiss, Luxembourg, Guernsey, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore - by ensuring this is following the Groups FTP Chart of Account
Analyse demands regarding Grca, FTP and Goca changes, and provide clear guidance and conclusion in the usage of these figures for each Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System.
Avaloq Changes
Support in designing solutions and in implementing each demand (Jira's), by analysing the technical requirements, by liaising with concerned stakeholders (Finance and IT), and by performing needed tests in the change workflow (DEV, SIT, UAT) into Avaloq.
Avaloq Implementations
Perform all testing regarding latest implementation of Avaloq, as per accounting perspective
=>Testing Balancing Rules lifecycle for each Product
=>Testing Booking rules lifecycle for each Product - analysing the usage of the Bookind in Avaloq

Data Controls
Organize and perform controls on important amount of data, highlight the inconsistencies that might appear, understand the reasons of these, and liaise with concerned stakeholders to implement needed changes.

Product Owner Administration
Follow up on Product Owner subjects (jiras).

Customers / Stakeholders
Build strong relationships within GPB Finance teams, and IT teams
Be accountable to present clear solutions within changes and implementation for new requirements

Leadership & Teamwork
Collaborative behaviours, actively share ideas / approaches with the rest of the GPB Finance teams
Utilise fully the onshore / offshore operating model

Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with appropriate Group Standard and practices
Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Major Challenges
Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Observation of Internal Controls
Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
Understands, follows and demonstrates compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved, specifically Internal Controls and any Compliance policy including, inter alia, the Group Compliance policy

Requirements
Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts
Strong working knowledge in MS Office tools
Being able to handle simple source systems with no guidance and complex source systems with limited guidance
Proven evidence of strong communication skills used to successfully lead, coordinate and conclude business discussion sessions
Ability to initiate and drive discussions with key stakeholders to effective conclusion
Capable of organizing and managing day to day activities/initiatives for self & team independently
Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team
Ability to multi-task on activities within & outside of the immediate functional area/team
Demonstrate capability to learn and improve self & team's performance on an on-going basis
Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. CRM Solution Architecture
Design and architect end-to-end Veeva CRM solutions aligned with client business objectives
Develop technical specifications and system blueprints for complex CRM implementations
Lead architectural reviews and ensure solutions meet scalability, security, and performance requirements
Evaluate emerging Veeva technologies and recommend adoption strategies
2. Commercial Operating Model Design
Collaborate with clients to design and optimize commercial operating models
Map business processes to Veeva CRM capabilities and identify improvement opportunities
Define user journeys, workflows, and process automation strategies
Ensure alignment between commercial strategy and technology implementation
3. Release and Change Governance
Establish and maintain release management frameworks and governance processes
Lead change control boards and manage release planning activities
Implement best practices for configuration management and deployment procedures
Oversee testing strategies, including UAT coordination and validation processes
4. Alignment and Territory Design Strategy
Design and implement territory management strategies within Veeva CRM
Optimize sales force alignment and territory assignments based on business rules
Configure territory hierarchies, assignment rules, and performance tracking mechanisms
Support territory planning cycles and realignment initiatives
5. Integration Architecture Across the Veeva Suite
Design integration strategies connecting Veeva CRM with other Veeva applications (Vault, Network, etc.)
Architect data flows and synchronization processes across the Veeva ecosystem
Manage API integrations and data mapping requirements
Ensure data integrity and consistency across integrated systems
6. Requirements Facilitation and Business Rule Arbitration
Lead requirements gathering sessions with diverse stakeholder groups
Facilitate workshops to define and validate business rules and system configurations
Resolve conflicting requirements and provide expert recommendations
Document functional specifications and translate business needs into technical solutions
7. Client Stakeholder Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for client CRM initiatives
Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision makers
Manage client expectations and communicate project status, risks, and recommendations
Lead client presentations and solution demonstrations

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking a CANDU Quality Specialist to support the delivery of world-class nuclear projects across the global CANDU portfolio.
Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.
Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies.
Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities.
Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams.
Engineering Quality
Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes.
Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.
Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records.
Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns.
Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments.
Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections.
Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure.
Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities.
Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders.
Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
About You
The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures.
They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements.
The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery.
Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects.
Essential Qualifications and Experience
Degree in Engineering and Quality Management
Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Nuclear Quality, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance Programs.
Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities.
Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Essential Technical Knowledge
Working knowledge of
CSA N299 Series
CSA N286
ASME NQA-1
ISO 9001 and ISO 19443
Nuclear Safety Culture principles
Supplier Quality Assurance
Audit and Surveillance Techniques
Design Control and Verification
Configuration Management
Quality Records and Traceability
Non-Conformance and Corrective Action Management
Working knowledge of Hexagon, AVEVA Smart 3D / E3D, and Siemens NX and domain knowledge of nuclear sector
Desirable
CQI/IRCA Lead Auditor qualification.
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent.
Experience supporting CANDU, nuclear new build, refurbishment, or life extension projects.
Experience as a QA Specialist, QA Engineer, PQAR, CQAR, or equivalent quality role.
Lean Six Sigma certification.
Experience with digital quality management and reporting tools.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team supporting Middle East projects based out of India
The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.
The role is based in India and support projects in Dubai and across the UAE, KSA and the wider Middle East.
Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
Urban and Spatial Economics
Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.
Real Estate Economics
Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.
Development and Infrastructure Planning
Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.
Project Delivery
Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.
Business and Practice Development
Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRalis business.
Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.
About You
Qualifications Skills
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
Master's degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.
Professional Experience / Qualifications
Typically +8 years of relevant experience;
Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous.
Behavioral Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Prior experience in leading a client facing team
Advanced expertise with DIgSILENT PowerFactory, including transmission network modelling, Load flow analysis, Contingency analysis, short circuit/fault level studies and RMS studies.
Experience with UK transmission planning processes and documents, such as ETYS, NOA, Scheme Requirement Forms, System Design Specifications and Project Listing Documents.

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.

Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.

Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.

Professional & Technical

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations

Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning

A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities

Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Project Role : AI / ML Engineer

Project Role Description : Develops applications and systems that utilize AI tools, Cloud AI services, with proper cloud or on-prem application pipeline with production ready quality. Summary:
We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist with strong experience in traditional machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, and statistical modeling. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in Python and SQL, strong analytical thinking, and hands-on experience in building and validating predictive models.
This role is not focused on GenAI/NLP, and candidates with heavy LLM-focused profiles without strong core Data Science fundamentals may not be suitable.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Lead the design and implementation of AI-driven solutions ensuring alignment with business objectives.
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team to foster professional growth.
- Coordinate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
- Monitor project progress and implement improvements to optimize workflows and deliverables.

- Develop, train, and deploy machine learning models for classification, regression, and predictive analytics use cases
- Perform data exploration, preprocessing, and feature engineering on large and complex datasets
- Apply statistical techniques (hypothesis testing, distributions, variance analysis) to derive meaningful insights
- Design and execute robust model validation frameworks (cross-validation, A/B testing, performance tuning)
- Conduct hyperparameter tuning to improve model accuracy and efficiency
- Write optimized and scalable SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis
- Build reusable and scalable Python-based data science pipelines
- Collaborate with data engineers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
- Ensure model performance monitoring, documentation, and reproducibility
- Communicate findings, insights, and model outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Shift B Support: Availability to provide support until 11 AM PST.
- Return to Office: Mandatory 5-day RTO from 4 strategic office locations. (Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Bangalore

Professional & Technical Skills: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.)
- SQL (advanced querying, optimization, transformations)
- Solid understanding of statistics and probability: Distributions, hypothesis testing, variance, confidence intervals
- Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms: Logistic Regression, Linear Regression & Tree-based models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost)
- Model validation techniques (cross-validation, train-test strategies)
- Hyperparameter tuning approaches (grid search, random search, Bayesian optimization)
- Data cleansing, transformation, and feature engineering
- Good understanding of algorithms and data structures fundamentals: Sorting, searching, and basic graph concepts
- Ability to work independently and handle end-to-end problem-solving
- Hands-on experience with: Databricks / Apache Spark / PySpark
- Exposure to Healthcare Analytics domain: Claims data, CMS reimbursement, population health, Medicare Advantage
- Experience in: Building and deploying inference/prediction pipelines
- Familiarity with: ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, Azure ML, etc.)
- Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in Data Science.
- This position is based at our CDC2F - SEZ location.
- Shift B Support: Availability to provide support until 11 AM PST.
- Return to Office: Mandatory 5-day RTO from 4 strategic office locations. (Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Bangalore).
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)
Location:
Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.
Shift Timings: 
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements. Role & responsibilities

Job Description
Senior Embedded C Engineer (RTOS)
Location: Coimbatore (1st Preference) / Bangalore (2nd Preference)
Experience: 4 - 10 Years
Grade: B2 / C1
Your Role
Develop and maintain embedded firmware using Embedded C for STM32 and ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers.
Design, implement, and optimize firmware for RTOS-based applications (FreeRTOS or equivalent).
Work closely with hardware teams for board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and product validation.
Develop and debug low-level drivers and interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, PWM, DMA, Timers, and Interrupts.
Perform firmware debugging, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
Execute and support validation, verification, system testing, integration testing, and regression testing activities.
Utilize debugging and test tools such as Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, JTAG, and SWD.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality embedded solutions.
Your Profile
4 to 10 years of hands-on experience in Embedded C Programming (Firmware Development).
Strong expertise in STM32 / ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers.
Proven experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS or equivalent).
Strong knowledge of embedded peripherals including SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, PWM, DMA, Timers, and Interrupts.
Hands-on experience in board bring-up, firmware debugging, root cause analysis, and hardware-software integration.
Expertise in validation, verification, system testing, integration testing, and regression testing.
Proficiency in using Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, JTAG/SWD debugging tools.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Good to Have
C++
DSP / Signal Processing
IoT Protocols Connectivity
BLE Wi-Fi Development
Preferred Location
Coimbatore
Bangalore

Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Python Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based test automation and SAP business process automation.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing and maintaining automated test cases using an existing Python automation framework. The role involves automating SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows, developing reusable automation components, and supporting end-to-end automation across various SAP business processes.
The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python programming, SAP S/4HANA automation, SAP GUI and Fiori, along with a strong understanding of automation frameworks and software testing methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and automate new SAP business test cases using the existing Python automation framework.
Enhance and maintain reusable Python components, transaction classes, workflows, subflows and automation utilities.
Automate SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows wherever applicable.
Develop end-to-end automation solutions across Procurement, Sales, Inventory, Finance and other SAP business processes.
Maintain and enhance regression, smoke and integration automation test suites.
Identify, debug and resolve automation failures to improve test stability and execution efficiency.
Improve synchronization, logging, reporting and error-handling mechanisms within the automation framework.
Follow coding standards and best practices, conduct code reviews and validate changes to prevent regressions.
Collaborate with SAP functional consultants, QA teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into reliable automation solutions.
Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks, utilities and testing processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming and automation development.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA automation and SAP business process testing.
Hands-on experience automating SAP GUI transactions.
Experience with SAP Fiori-based workflow automation.
Good understanding of Python automation frameworks and reusable component development.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts and workflows.
Knowledge of regression testing, smoke testing and integration testing.
Ability to debug automation scripts and troubleshoot execution failures.
Understanding of SAP business processes such as Procurement, Sales, Inventory and Finance.
Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Pytest, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar automation tools.
Knowledge of SAP GUI Scripting API.
Exposure to PyAutoGUI or other desktop automation libraries.
Experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Gateway.
Knowledge of API automation and integration testing.
Experience working with reusable automation frameworks and test utilities.
Exposure to Agile development and testing methodologies.

Interested candidates can share their Cvs to namrata.dutta@mindseek.net.

Thanks & Regards
Namrata Dutta

About the Role:
We are looking for a seasoned delivery leader to head large-scale content and learning solution projects across global EdTech clients. The AVP will own end-to-end program delivery, drive operational excellence, ensure client success, and scale delivery teams for high-quality, on-time, and profitable execution. Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability and outcomes
Drive capability development in instructional design, digital content, and learning technologies
Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams

Define and enforce delivery standards, quality frameworks, and review mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and automation
Implement tools and best practices in project tracking, collaboration, and reporting
Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

6. Financial & Operational Ownership
Own delivery P&L levers: effort estimation, cost control, margin optimization
Improve productivity through process optimization and AI-enabled workflows where applicable
Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization

Bachelors degree
15–20 years of experience in Project / Program / Delivery Management
Digital learning / eLearning development
Curriculum and content production workflows
Proven experience managing large teams (30–100+) and multi-million-dollar portfolios
Experience working with global clients

Executive stakeholder management
Program & portfolio governance
Risk & escalation management
People, leadership, and talent development

Operational excellence mindset

Description:
SAP RAR Consultant - Operations Support (Offshore)

Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Pune / Chennai/Hyderabad/ Bangalore
Role Type: AMS / Production Support


Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting (RAR).
Handle incident management, problem resolution, and service requests.
Support end-to-end revenue recognition processes aligned with ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
Monitor and resolve issues related to:
Revenue Contracts
Performance Obligations (POBs)
SSP Allocation
Contract Modifications
Revenue Postings
Perform month-end, quarter-end, and year-end revenue close activities.
Reconcile and validate revenue accounting results.
Support integration between SAP RAR and SAP S/4HANA modules (FI, CO, AR, GL).
Troubleshoot data, posting, and reconciliation issues.
Maintain RAR configurations including business rules, account determination, and revenue recognition settings.
Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, Business, and IT teams.
Support SIT, UAT, enhancements, defect fixes, and release activities.
Prepare operational documents, RCA reports, and knowledge articles.
Drive process improvements and automation initiatives.

Must-Have Skills
SAP S/4HANA RAR (Revenue Accounting & Reporting)
SAP FI Integration (GL, AR)
Revenue Recognition & Revenue Reconciliation
AMS / Production Support experience
L2/L3 Support expertise
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Stakeholder management and communication skills

Preferred Skills
ASC 606 and IFRS 15 knowledge
SAP BRIM integration experience
Subscription Billing / SaaS business exposure

Ideal Candidate Profile
5-10 years of SAP experience with strong SAP RAR support expertise.
Hands-on experience supporting revenue accounting processes in production environments.
Good understanding of finance accounting concepts and revenue recognition standards.
Experience working with global stakeholders and managing critical support incidents.
Ability to independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex RAR issues.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter.
Guidewire implementation, migration, transformation, or upgrade experience.
Guidewire certification is an added advantage.
