Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).
Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.

API Testing

Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.

Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.

Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.

Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.

Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.

Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst
Location- Bangalore/ Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune
Exp- 8+ Yrs
Mandatory Skills- Oracle Payroll, E-Business Suite (EBS), SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formualas
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst to support, maintain and enhance Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll within a complex, multi-country payroll environment.
Working as part of a specialist team of analysts and developers, this role combines deep Oracle Payroll functional knowledge with strong technical expertise to deliver payroll system enhancements, support legislative compliance, maintain platform stability and ensure the successful delivery of business-critical change.
The successful candidate will possess advanced technical skills in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formula, Oracle E-Business Suite architecture, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), integrations and application lifecycle management. They will also have practical and demonstrable experience supporting payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions, translating country-specific legislative and regulatory requirements into compliant system configurations, calculations, controls and technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Payroll Support & Administration
Support, maintain and enhance Oracle EBS Payroll and associated HRMS modules.
Investigate and resolve complex payroll, application and integration issues.
Ensure system reliability, availability, performance and security.
Support payroll operations across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local payroll legislation, statutory requirements, regulatory controls and reporting obligations.
Provide technical and functional expertise in payroll processing, balancing, reconciliation and issue resolution.
Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.
Technical Development
Develop, maintain and support:
SQL and PL/SQL solutions
Oracle Fast Formulas
Payroll configurations
Custom developments
Interfaces and integrations
Reports and data extracts
Analyse business requirements and translate them into scalable, supportable technical solutions.
Ensure developments comply with established development standards, security requirements and best practices.
Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
Support data migration and transformation activities where required.
Solution Delivery & Change Management
Manage the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for payroll enhancements and projects.
Support requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing and deployment activities.
Ensure technical solutions are documented, supportable and aligned with business and architectural standards.
Collaborate with Payroll, HR, Finance and project teams to deliver business-critical change.
Support release management, deployment planning and environment management activities.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and system optimisation opportunities.
Architecture & Technical Support
Maintain a strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and supporting technologies.
Support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
Work with infrastructure teams and third-party support providers to resolve technical issues and implement system changes.
Support resilience, performance optimisation and capacity planning activities.
Contribute to technical roadmaps and platform improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of Oracle product strategy, security recommendations and industry best practices.
Upgrades, Patching & Release Management
Support the planning and execution of:
Oracle application upgrades
Security patching
Legislative updates
Environment refreshes
Release deployments
Participate in testing, validation and deployment activities.
Conduct impact assessments, support regression testing activities and deployment planning.
Ensure upgrades and patches are implemented in accordance with governance and operational requirements.
Assess Oracle legislative updates and country-specific regulatory changes and determine their impact on payroll configurations, calculations, interfaces and reporting.
Coordinate testing and implementation activities with Payroll and relevant subject matter experts.
Stakeholder Engagement
Communicate complex technical concepts and solution options clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and Compliance teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Work with in-country Payroll specialists to ensure local legislative requirements are accurately reflected within Oracle Payroll.
Support business stakeholders in understanding system capabilities, risks, limitations and solution options.
Build effective relationships across all levels of the organisation.
Provide clear and practical technical recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Vendor & Partner Management
Work closely with third-party infrastructure and application support providers.
Manage supplier performance against agreed service levels and operational standards.
Collaborate with vendors to resolve incidents, implement enhancements and deliver technical improvements.
Support supplier governance processes and periodic service reviews.
Escalate risks and service concerns appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
Audit, Controls & Compliance
Support and maintain a robust controls framework across the Oracle Payroll landscape.
Ensure payroll system processes, configurations and integrations operate in accordance with internal controls, audit standards and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Security and Compliance teams to support periodic reviews and audits.
Provide system expertise and evidence for audit requests, including documentation of system controls, processes, workflows and technical configurations.
Identify and mitigate operational, security and compliance risks relating to payroll systems and processes.
Support the design and ongoing monitoring of application controls, segregation of duties and access management processes.
Ensure development, change management and release management activities comply with governance standards.
Lead or support remediation activities arising from audit findings, control assessments and compliance reviews.
Maintain accurate technical and functional documentation to support compliance, operational effectiveness and knowledge management.
Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience testing activities.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll within multi-country environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience assessing, configuring, testing and implementing country-specific legislative and regulatory payroll changes.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements and translate them into effective Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of payroll balancing, reconciliation and validation processes.
Experience supporting complex payroll operations within large corporate environments.
Technical Expertise
Advanced SQL skills.
Strong PL/SQL development experience.
Extensive Oracle Fast Formula experience.
Strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and underlying technologies.
Experience supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Experience with:
Integrations and interfaces
Data migration activities
Troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Batch processing and concurrent programmes
Payroll calculations and reconciliation
Security and access controls
Enterprise Command Centre (ECC)
Oracle workflow technologies
Oracle development standards and best practices
Experience managing application upgrades, patching and environment management activities.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGCs), application controls and audit requirements.
Experience supporting internal and external audits.
Knowledge of segregation of duties, access governance and security controls.
Experience working within regulated and compliance-driven environments.
Ability to assess technical and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation actions.
Understanding of change management, release governance and compliance frameworks.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll across multiple countries or jurisdictions, including the assessment, configuration, testing and implementation of country-specific legislative and regulatory changes.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience supporting large-scale, multi-country payroll environments.

15+ years of experience in Electrical Engineering and Project Engineering Management within the Oil & Gas industry.
Must have significant experience in handling Electrical Engineering for Oil & Gas projects.
Strong understanding of electrical systems, including substations, power distribution, electrical equipment, protection systems, and control systems.
Experience in managing multidisciplinary engineering teams and coordinating with clients, consultants, and vendors.

AboutCompany:
L&T is a 27-billion-dollar Indian multinational company engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-tech Manufacturing and services operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focused approach and constant quest for top class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for over eighty decades. L&T is growing at 15% YOY with 61 Billion dollar consolidated orders in hand out of which 38% are international orders. L&T Construction itself owns around 66% of these total order book value. L&T operates in various Sectors like infrastructure projects, Energy Projects, Hi Tech Manufacturing, IT & Technology services, financial services, other business comprises of (a) Realty (b) Industrial valves (c) Construction equipment & mining machinery (d) Rubber processing machinery. Our company has ventured into many new age businesses like green energy, Semiconductor design, Data Centre, Ecommerce & Digital Technology.

L&T has completed many landmark projects such as the statue of Unity which is taller than statue of Liberty, The Narendra Modi Stadium, Mumbai Trans Harbor Link (MTHL)-Indias longest Sea bridge project, Bullet Train (Ahmedabad to Mumbai) the biggest contract value project, Lotus temple at Delhi and many more. We believe in nurturing and caring for our employees.

We emphasize on wellness, trust, and collaboration to foster Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and to enable employees to realize their full potential. We provide challenging assignments and continuous learning opportunities through online, offline and in house digital platforms. L&T has been rated as the Best Place to Work for the last two consecutive years.

We believe that employees mental health is very important for individual and organizational growth so more emphasis is given for better mental health of employees through customized counselling services by mental health experts. We also conduct financial planning workshops for our employees by Industry experts to manage their finance for a better retirement life. Furthermore, we encourage the open-door policy so each employee can approach his/her Superior for any kind of assistance or support at any time. Team-building activities, cultural events, and sports events are conducted at Project sites to keep the morale of the employees always high. L&T as an organization invests lots of money, time & efforts on people development so offers various developmental programs on Technical, behavioral and leadership skills

Job Description: Java Developer

Job Title: Java Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Java Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Core Java, object-oriented programming, database technologies, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications and services.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable, and secure applications.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with external systems.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and Product Owners.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Core Java (Java 8/11/17).
Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs) concepts and Design Patterns.
Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA.
Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Collections Framework, Multithreading, Exception Handling, and Java Streams.
Familiarity with Maven/Gradle build tools.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices Architecture.
Knowledge of Spring Security, JWT, and OAuth.
Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or messaging systems.
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
Knowledge of performance tuning and application monitoring.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Domain experience in Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, or Telecom.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Keywords
Java, Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, JPA, REST API, SQL, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microservices, Maven, Gradle, Git, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, AWS, Azure, Agile, OOPs, Design Patterns.

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Possessing BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
- Demonstrating proficiency in API, SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, and XML
- Leading large-scale digital transformation programs in finance operations
- Excelling in client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement

Description:
SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer Job Description and Summary We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 9+ years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 9 years in Generative AI (GenAI). The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks. The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases. Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
47 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.

To lead the Maintenance function of the Optical Fiber Cable Plant by ensuring maximum machine availability, improving equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, managing utilities, and driving continuous improvement through preventive and predictive maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utility, and Automation maintenance activities.
Ensure maximum uptime of OFC manufacturing machines through effective preventive and predictive maintenance.
Handle breakdown analysis and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Plan and execute annual shutdowns and major maintenance activities.
Maintain critical utilities including Compressors, Chillers, HVAC, DG Sets, Transformers, HT/LT Systems, Air Dryers, Water Systems, and Power Distribution.
Maintain and troubleshoot OFC manufacturing equipment including:
Fiber Coloring Lines
Ribbonizing Lines
SZ Stranding Machines
Buffering Lines
Sheathing/Jacketing Extrusion Lines
Armouring Lines
Rewinding & Take-up Systems
Spark Testers and Online Testing Equipment
Lead TPM, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Monitor machine performance through MTBF, MTTR, OEE, and downtime analysis.
Ensure availability of critical spare parts and optimize maintenance inventory.
Manage maintenance budgets, AMCs, vendor development, and contractor activities.
Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, and implementation of EHS standards.
Maintain SAP PM/CMMS records, maintenance history, and technical documentation.
Develop and mentor maintenance engineers, supervisors, and technicians.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, PLC, SCADA, Servo Drives, VFDs, and Industrial Automation.
Hands-on experience in OFC manufacturing equipment maintenance.
Expertise in Preventive, Predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance.
Knowledge of SAP PM/CMMS.
Strong leadership, planning, vendor management, and problem-solving skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Machine Availability
Team Handling
OEE Improvement
Breakdown Reduction
Preventive Maintenance Compliance
MTBF & MTTR
Utility Availability
Maintenance Cost Control
Spare Inventory Optimization
Safety & Statutory Compliance

Mandatory Screening Criteria

Latest 10 years of experience must be in Optical Fiber Cable Manufacturing only.
Hands-on maintenance experience on OFC production machinery.
Experience in managing maintenance teams in a manufacturing plant.
Willing to work at Urse, Pune.

Interested candidate can also share their CV on Rutuja.Mohite@Finolex.com

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will develop and implement hygiene protocols and procedures to ensure all areas of the hotel meet the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene and comply with health and safety regulations. As a Hygiene Manager, you re not just ensuring cleanliness and hygiene - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft).
Manager: Minimum of 3 years in a hygiene management role, preferably in the hospitality industry.
Assistant Manager: Minimum of 2-3 years in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry, with a preference for supervisory or management positions
Supervisor: 2-3 years of experience in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry.
Excellent reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Strategic Planning Compliance: Develop hygiene policies and ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards.
Team Leadership Training: Lead the hygiene team and provide ongoing training to maintain performance and standards.
Cleaning Expertise: Apply knowledge of cleaning procedures, chemicals, and equipment to ensure effective practices.
Quality Assurance: Monitor cleanliness and hygiene levels, implementing quality control measures across all areas.
Budget Resource Management: Oversee hygiene supply budgets and ensure efficient use of resources.
Issue Resolution: Address hygiene-related concerns promptly to maintain a safe and sanitary environment.

campaigns/events for these strategic accounts.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)
1. Identify Premium High-Potential Outlets
Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets.
Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull.
Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance.
Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands.
2. Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets
Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout.
Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage.
Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities.

Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors.
Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships.
Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding.
Long-Term Scope of the Team
The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic
premium accounts.

Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them.
Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners.
Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding.
Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution.
2. Drive GOV Growth Market Share

Increase Dineouts market share within premium restaurant segments.
Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution.
3. Exclusive Campaigns Events

Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners.
Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineouts proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners.

Strong business development and sales orientation.

Description:
Location: North Goa

Job Description: The Customer Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers and rider partners, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries.
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options.
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements.
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels.
Handling customer and rider partner escalations-preparing RCA and providing the solution.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts.
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements and providing best solutions to the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Required Skills:
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and rider partners and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment - this is applicable for our rider partners as well
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer and rider partner issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer and rider related issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Video Producer who is passionate about shooting and editing films, advertisements and digital video content.
The role involves creating engaging visual content for Delhivery's brand and marketing initiatives, from shooting on-ground stories and brand films to producing advertisements, social media videos and campaign content.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling the entire video production process independently, from setting up the camera and lighting to shooting, editing and delivering the final film.
Key Responsibilities
1. Video Shooting & Production
Independently shoot advertisements, brand films, corporate videos, social media content and documentary-style stories.
Operate professional cameras, mirrorless cameras and other video equipment.
Manage camera settings, framing, composition, camera movements and lighting.
Handle on-location shoots across offices, warehouses, operational facilities and outdoor locations.
Record quality audio and manage basic sound equipment.
Plan and execute shoots with minimal supervision.
2. Video Editing & Post-Production
Edit videos for different platforms and formats, including YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and digital advertising.
Create engaging edits with strong storytelling, pacing, transitions and visual flow.
Perform basic colour correction, colour grading, sound mixing and audio enhancement.
Create titles, subtitles, graphics and basic motion graphics.
Adapt long-form footage into short-form videos, reels and advertisements.
Deliver final videos in the required aspect ratios, resolutions and formats.
3. Creative Collaboration
Work with the Brand and Marketing teams to translate creative briefs into effective video content.
Contribute ideas on visual storytelling, camera treatments and editing styles.
Collaborate with internal teams, employees and external production partners during shoots.
Stay updated on emerging video production techniques, equipment and editing trends.
Skills & Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in videography, video production and editing.
Strong hands-on experience in shooting and editing videos independently.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
Working knowledge of After Effects is an advantage.
Good understanding of cameras, lenses, lighting, audio recording and composition.

What We Are Looking For
Someone who loves being behind the camera as much as being in the editing room.
A strong visual sense and an eye for detail.
Someone who can independently take ownership of a video assignment from shoot to final edit.
A practical, resourceful individual who can produce quality content without always depending on large production crews.
A portfolio demonstrating actual shooting and editing work is essential.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Develops and/or uses analytical tools and systems to maximize revenues and profit.
Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.

- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc

- Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.
- Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.
- Understands and accurately represents individual property needs.
- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue analysis processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Promotes and protects brand equity.
- Prepares sales strategy critique.
Building Successful Relationships
- Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.
- Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives and the peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.

Description:

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will develop and implement hygiene protocols and procedures to ensure all areas of the hotel meet the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene and comply with health and safety regulations. As an Assistant Manager Hygiene, you re not just ensuring cleanliness and hygiene - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

Manager: Minimum of 3 years in a hygiene management role, preferably in the hospitality industry.
Assistant Manager: Minimum of 2-3 years in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry, with a preference for supervisory or management positions
Supervisor: 2-3 years of experience in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry.
Excellent reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Strategic Planning Compliance: Develop hygiene policies and ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards.
Team Leadership Training: Lead the hygiene team and provide ongoing training to maintain performance and standards.
Cleaning Expertise: Apply knowledge of cleaning procedures, chemicals, and equipment to ensure effective practices.
Quality Assurance: Monitor cleanliness and hygiene levels, implementing quality control measures across all areas.
Budget Resource Management: Oversee hygiene supply budgets and ensure efficient use of resources.
Issue Resolution: Address hygiene-related concerns promptly to maintain a safe and sanitary environment.

Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets 
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options 
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring 
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels 
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution 
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts 
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Responsible for all project deliverables with end-to-end total responsibility. Handling projects across India. Completing each project with 100% safety and QA/QC compliances and ensuring that all projects are completed in time and achieve the committed profit margin.
Have to ensure the smooth functioning of every Project with strict adherence to companys policies and procedures
Mobilization & Demobilization of required resources in a timely manner
Developing project team members to achieve project needs
Maintain minimum working capital as per budget commitments by ensuring the timely submission of bills and collection of amount from clients.
Implement the overall strategy of project and work under deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
To evaluate / review and report monthly on the performance of all departments, covering cost control, achievements, compliance, evaluation towards KPIs and other key parameters.
Direct interaction with top management for feasibility study, planning, concept design and budget approvals for any project.
Handle Customers and all other stake holders effectively and manage the project teams to achieve the project objectives.
Responsible for providing user experience feedback from customers and troubleshooting where necessary to protect existing and develop new business.
Achieving End deliverables (Timely completion, Committed margin, Quality and Zero accidents)
Smooth networking with vendors (suppliers and sub-contractors)
Research and build relationship with new clients.

Preferred candidate profile
Technical: Result Orientation and Delivery focus, Strategic planning and decision making.
Functional: Project Execution Manual (PEM) guidelines.
Behavioural: Project Planning and Execution, Site Coordination, Supervision and planning.
AboutCompany:
About RPG Enterprises:
Mumbai head-quartered RPG Enterprises is one of India's largest industrial conglomerates. With over 15 companies in its fold, the group has a strong presence across core business sectors such as Infrastructure, Tyres, IT, Healthcare, Energy and Plantation to name a few. Established in 1979, RPG Enterprises is one of Indias fastest growing business groups with a turnover of $4 billion.
About KEC International:
KEC International Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, India, is the flagship company of the RPG Group. A USD 2.1 billion Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) major, we deliver projects in key infrastructure sectors such as Power Transmission & Distribution, Railways, Civil, Urban Infrastructure, Solar, Smart Infrastructure, Oil & Gas Pipelines, and Cables.
Our robust and integrated capabilities span the entire EPC value chain from concept to commissioning. We have successfully executed complex projects across some of the world’s most difficult terrains and conditions, aided by robust engineering, procurement, execution and project management capabilities. We have vast manufacturing footprint extending across India, Dubai, Brazil and Mexico. Our global presence has enabled a robust and agile supply chain that extends across six continents in over 105 countries.
For over 75 years, we have prided ourselves for our unmatched expertise in EPC, backed by a strong customer-centric approach, quest for world-class quality, and ‘safety-first’ attitude. Integrity in our actions and respect for people, environment and our stakeholders are the cornerstones of our corporate responsibility. Empowered by a mindset driven to outperform and excel, we build infrastructure for the world of tomorrow.
About Civil & Urban Infrastructure Business:
KEC’s Civil business focuses on the construction of factories, warehouses, residential buildings, railway stations, metros, and sewage & water treatment plants, and comprises of four verticals –

A. Infrastructure

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Fix minor plumbing problems such as unclogging drains, plunging toilets, and repairing leaky spigots and faucets. Perform miscellaneous minor repairs such as tightening loose toilet seats, changing light bulbs, and patching holes in walls. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Role: Inside Sales
Designation: Manager
Location: Goa

1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Team handling experience is a must.

Description:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Customer-first mindset with focus on scalability and automation

Product Range: Smartphones, laptops, consumer electronics, and accessories.

Operational Excellence: Maintaining product availability, merchandising standards, and compliance with company processes.

Description:
Entry level management position that focuses on supporting the day-to-day activities in Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and Laundry, if applicable.
Position works with employees to clean and maintain guestrooms and public space.
Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action.
Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the housekeeping or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
- Ensures knowledge and understanding of OSHA regulations are up to date.
- Oversees all lost and found procedures.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to ensure adequate supplies.
- Ensures guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Works effectively with the Engineering department on guest room maintece needs.
- Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Assists in supervising an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Manages linen inventory and guest supplies and assists in the ordering of supplies as necessary.
- Supervises Housekeeping and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Services or Housekeeping Manager.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals; continuously strives to improve service performance.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be the star of your station, crafting delicious dishes and wowing our guests. With your passion for cooking and your attention to detail, youll be a valuable member of our culinary team. As a Demi Chef de Partie, you re not just overseeing the preparation of high-quality dishes - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Technical education in hospitality or culinary school.
At least 3 years as a Cook in Chinese / Banquet / Main / Pastry Kitchen in a 5-star category hotel or individual restaurant with high standards.
At least 1 year as a Commis I in an international brand hotel or individual restaurant with high standards.
Possess good leadership and training skills.
Up to date with sanitation classes.
Knowledgeable in HACCP.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Prepare great-tasting dishes: Season, cook, and test dishes according to standard recipes, ensuring consistency in taste and presentation
Supervise the kitchen team: Oversee line cooks to ensure and provide support as needed in the absence of senior chefs to ensure smooth and efficient operations
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: Keep all work areas clean, tidy, and free of cross-contamination
Ensure food quality and storage compliance: Monitor ingredient quality, ensuring proper storage and stock rotation
Assist with cost management: Contribute to controlling food costs, improving gross profit margins, and meeting departmental financial targets
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will assist in food preparation and cooking under the supervision of senior chefs. As a Commis II, you re not just preparing great tasting food items - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Minimum 1 year of experience as a Cook or Trainee in a 5-star hotel or high-standard restaurant.
Basic knowledge of Western or Chinese cuisine.
Ability to remain calm and problem-solve under pressure.
Comfortable working in hot, humid, and noisy kitchen environments.
Strong teamwork and communication skills.
Willingness to learn and follow kitchen procedures and hygiene standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Prepare high-quality dishes: Prepare menu items according to designated recipes and quality standards
Delight our guests: Manage guest orders efficiently while ensuring a positive dining experience
Execute complex recipes: Maintain a strong knowledge of menu offerings, handle complex recipes, and oversee stations, execution, quality control, and inventory checks
Inspect and finalize plates: Inspect all preparations and dishes ahead of serving to ensure they meet quality and presentation standards
Maintain a clean and organized workspace: Keep food service stations stocked and sanitary while following proper food handling, storage, and safety protocols
Manage inventory needs: Prepare requisitions for supplies and food items as needed
Comply with regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member well-being
