Description:
We don't just deliver packages. We deliver careers.
India's largest logistics company. 30,000+ customers. Billions in shipments. And we're hiring CLOSERS for our Goa HQ.
The Role:
You dial. You pitch. You close. Repeat
Own the entire sales cycle - Every deal you crack - plays a direct role in growing Delhivery's shipper base. Think of yourself as a growth partner, not just a sales representative
You'll work with businesses of all sizes, understand their logistics pain points, and show them why Delhivery is the answer. Every deal you close moves real products to real people across India
What You'll Own:
> Connect with inbound & outbound clients to identify sales opportunities
> Lead consultative sales conversations that uncover customer needs
> Conduct compelling dashboard demos that convert
> Drive deals from first touchpoint to signed contract
> Own your numbersmeet and exceed monthly and quarterly goals
> Coordinate with operations and support teams to deliver seamless experiences
Must-Have:
> Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
> Excellent communication and presentation abilities
> Data-driven mindset-you analyze what's working and double down
Good-to-Have:
Experience in logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce
Familiarity with SMB and mid-market sales cycles
Based in Goa or ready to make the move
Why Join us:
Impact at scale - Your work directly fuels India's commerce engine
Uncapped growth - Clear career paths and performance-based advancement
Competitive compensation - Base + incentives that reward results
Location perks - Build your career in Goa (yes, really)
Ownership culture — We hire people who lead with initiative and act with accountability
Ready to deliver impact?
If you're someone who thrives on targets, loves the art of the pitch, and wants to be part of India's logistics revolution—we want to hear from you

Description:
Role Summary
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! As a Kitchen Porter, you re not just keeping our kitchen and dining areas sparkling clean - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Keep serviceware spotless: Clean all chinaware, silverware, and cooking utensils, scrub pots and pans, and polish silver
Monitor stock levels: Ensure supplies and equipment are always well stocked and organized for seamless service
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: Perform essential cleaning tasks, including mopping and waste removal
Support events delivery: Prepare and set up clean serviceware for banquets and functions
Follow health and safety protocols: Handle hazardous substances safely and comply with all hygiene and safety regulations
Report hazards and maintenance needs: Promptly alert the supervisor on duty to any safety concerns or equipment issues
Train and mentor team members: Share your expertise with new team members to help strengthen team performance

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing purchasing strategies, including supplier selection, negotiation, and contract management, to ensure supply chain stability and cost-effectiveness. As a Purchasing Manager / Assistant Purchasing Manager, you re not just overseeing the purchasing process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment
Proven ability to source, negotiate, and manage supplier relationships to ensure quality and cost-efficiency
Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control, and procurement systems
Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and tracking purchasing performance
Familiarity with local procurement regulations, health and safety standards, and sustainability practices
Highly organized with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
Ensure that purchasing activities comply with relevant laws, regulations and company policies and uphold the hotels ethical standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee procurement operations: Manage purchasing and inventory of general merchandise to ensure adequate stock levels
Align with internal stakeholders: Collaborate with the Chef and hotel management to align purchases with hotel needs and specifications
Manage supplier relationships: Secure competitive pricing, place orders, and ensure timely delivery of goods
Ensure quality control: Review shipments to confirm products meet order specifications, grade, and quality standards
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Risk Management: To identify and manage supply chain risks, including supply disruptions, price volatility, and compliance issues.
Market Analysis: A comprehensive grasp of market trends and the capacity to anticipate price shifts and supply dynamics to inform prudent purchasing decisions.

Description:
Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

We are Nestl, the largest food and beverage company. We are 308,000 employees strong driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Our values are rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for our future. With more than CHF 91.4 billion sales in 2018, we have an expansive presence with 413 factories in more than 85 countries. We believe our people are our most important asset, so we'll offer you a dynamic inclusive international working environment with many opportunities across different businesses, functions and geographies, working with diverse teams and cultures.

Want to learn more? Visit us at www.nestle.com.Nestl is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please talk to your recruiter so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Customer Support Associate for the Cross Border. The role involves shipment tracking, customer coordination, issue resolution, SLA monitoring, and operational support for international shipments across Saver and Express services. The candidate will work closely with operations, carriers, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth shipment movement and enhanced customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Track and monitor cross-border shipments from pickup to delivery.
Coordinate with operations, hubs, carriers, and last-mile teams for shipment updates.
Handle customer queries related to shipment status, delays, exceptions, and delivery concerns.
Ensure timely resolution of escalations and customer complaints.
Monitor SLA adherence and highlight ageing or delayed shipments.
Maintain accurate records of shipment activities and customer interactions.
Verify shipment documentation and support compliance requirements.
Share daily operational reports and exception trackers with stakeholders.
Coordinate with internal teams for reattempts, appointment deliveries, and shipment recovery.
Support newly onboarded clients with process coordination and issue handling.
Identify process gaps and suggest operational improvements.
Required Skills:
Good communication and coordination skills.
Basic understanding of logistics and supply chain operations.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting.
Customer-centric approach with attention to detail.
Eligibility:
Graduate in any discipline.
03 years of experience in logistics, e-commerce, courier, or customer support operations.
Experience in cross-border logistics will be preferred.
Preferred Qualities:
Ownership mindset and proactive follow-ups.
Team player with good stakeholder management skills.
Ability to handle escalations effectively.
Flexible to work in rotational shifts if required.
KPI / Performance Metrics:
SLA adherence
Shipment ageing control
Escalation resolution TAT
Customer satisfaction
Exception handling efficiency
Reporting accuracy and timeliness

Delhivery provides an array of products and services for online businesses - including online channel integration services, sourcing, catalogue management, inventory management, multi-city fulfillment, express shipping, same day delivery services, reverse logistics, offline payment collection and processing, customer support, social media engagement and channel analytics.5 years into the industry, Delhivery handles over 250,000 shipments per day for over 100,000+ merchants, 25000 clients and 1800+ retailers across 450+ cities. Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be developing strategic marketing plans for the hotel and then overseeing the implementation and execution of the various efforts associated with the marketing plan. This might include evaluating the results of different marketing campaigns, spearheading market research efforts, or coordinating initiatives across a variety of channels. As a Marcom Manager / Assistant Marcom Manager, you re not just executing marketing campaigns to drive revenue growth - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably in hospitality
Proven expertise in digital marketing (SEO, SEM, email, social media)
Strong content creation and brand management skills
Experience in campaign planning, execution, and performance analysis
Proficiency in marketing tools and hotel systems (e.g., Salesforce, OnQ)
Excellent communication, project management, and analytical skills
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Execute hotel marketing strategies: Support the design and rollout of property-specific campaigns across digital channels, social media, and branded platforms to drive visibility and revenue.
Stay up to date on industry trends: Monitor emerging marketing tools, technologies, and consumer behaviors relevant to the hotel industry and target audiences
Report on campaign performance: Prepare and deliver monthly performance updates and marketing analyses to Sales and Revenue Management teams
Support cross-functional initiatives: Partner with department leaders to execute targeted campaigns that drive revenue and guest engagement

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures

About the job
Role - Program Manager (Sales Strategy)
This is an IC role
This is a 6day working role (5days - WFO ; Saturdays - WFH)

Job Overview:
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Program Manager with a strong focus on business development to drive growth within a Segment of our SME Express parcel division. This role involves strategizing, planning, and managing programs aimed at expanding our market share, strengthening customer relationships, and enhancing our service offerings. The Program Manager will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, fostering partnerships, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to achieve revenue and growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Market Expansion
Develop and implement strategic programs to drive business growth in key logistics & SME markets.
Identify and assess new business opportunities, including partnerships, contracts, and expansion into new regions or service lines.
Conduct market research to stay current with industry trends, competitor activity, and customer needs.
Program Strategy & Execution:
Lead cross-functional initiatives to create, launch, and optimize programs that enhance customer acquisition and retention.
Define clear program goals, KPIs, and timelines to ensure successful execution of business development initiatives.
Manage programs from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with the company's revenue and growth goals.
Client Relationship Management:
Collaborate closely with the sales and customer service teams to develop tailored solutions that meet client needs.
Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews to gather feedback and identify potential areas for additional services.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination:
Partner with internal teams (operations, marketing, and finance) to design, promote, and deliver value-added solutions.
Data Analysis & Performance Tracking:
Use data and analytics to track program effectiveness, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations.
Prepare reports on program outcomes, revenue impact, and market expansion, presenting insights to senior leadership.
Leverage CRM tools to maintain a detailed pipeline of business opportunities and track progress against revenue targets.
Budget Management & ROI Analysis:
Oversee program budgets, managing costs to ensure maximum return on investment.
Regularly assess the ROI of business development initiatives and recommend adjustments as needed to maximize profitability.
Identify cost-saving opportunities that do not compromise service quality or hinder growth objectives.
Skills:
Strong strategic planning and decision-making abilities.
Min 1-2yrs exp in program management, driving projects, cross-functional collaboration
Data-driven with strong analytical and reporting skills.
Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA).
Highly organized, with strong multitasking skills and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Description:
The Front Office Associate is responsible for delivering exceptional guest service by ensuring smooth check-in and check-out processes, handling guest requests efficiently, maintaining accurate records, and creating a welcoming experience in line with hotel brand standards.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome guests warmly and provide a professional first impression.
Perform check-in and check-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
Handle room reservations, modifications, and cancellations.
Respond promptly to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring timely resolution.
Process payments, maintain guest accounts, and prepare accurate billing.
Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments to ensure guest satisfaction.
Promote hotel facilities, services, loyalty programmes, and special offers.
Maintain the confidentiality of guest information and adhere to data security policies.
Ensure the front desk, lobby, and reception area remain clean and presentable.
Follow hotel SOPs, brand standards, and safety, security, and emergency procedures.
Prepare daily reports and complete shift handovers accurately.
Qualification Skills
Diploma or bachelors degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality.
0 2 years of experience in Front Office operations (freshers may also apply).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer service orientation with a professional appearance.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with PMS (Opera/Fidelio or similar) is preferred.
Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Good problem-solving, multitasking, and teamwork skills.
This role is responsible for ensuring every guest receives a warm welcome, personalized service, and a memorable stay while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality and operational excellence.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! As a Guest Services Coordinator, you re not just supporting guest services operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Support guest services operations: Coordinate department activities and support lobby and bell team members as needed to ensure consistent, high-quality guest service
Provide exceptional service: Respond promptly and professionally to phone, email, and in-person inquiries from clients, guests, and team members
Delight our guests: Greet guests warmly and assist with directions, local recommendations, and general information as needed to enhance the guest experience
Prepare group documentation: Organize and verify all paperwork, rooming lists, and necessary details to ensure accurate and timely delivery of guest amenities and group luggage
Support special projects: Assist with coordinating departmental initiatives or ad-hoc assignments
Provide administrative support: Assist department managers with clerical work such as word processing, data entry, filing, and copying

Description:
Role & responsibilities
New Product Development & Introduction: Lead Packaging projects & trials at Factory level with focus on line performance, cost efficiency on time delivery and product quality. Provide packaging input within the AGs proposing and evaluating best packaging alternatives for new products and improvements to existing products. Organise and document factory trials including machinability, shelf-life, storage handling, laboratory and transport tests for validation of new packaging and changes in specifications.
Nestle Continuous Excellence: Conduct value analysis; identify and recommend cost improvements and source reduction opportunities. Initiate (or participate in) DMAIC exercises. Guardian of packaging quality going out of the factory lines.
Safety, Quality & Compliance: Implement packaging related quality and compliance directives. Drive quality improvements in our packaging. Assist Factory QA to review packaging related on-line/off-line controls - to implement packaging monitoring plans. Participate in supplier audits.
Packaging Specifications: Manage GLOBE database of packaging materials. Supplier development: Support Packaging Head Office and Procurement in the selection, assessment and development of new suppliers/converters. Raise packaging material complaints with suppliers & collaborate to resolve them.
People & Know How: Ensure development of competencies of packaging assistants & disseminate packaging best practices and knowledge at the shop floor (e.g. "One Point Lessons"). Source & utilise training materials available within the Group (or develop training materials as appropriate) Packaging Material and Packaging Lines Efficiency in line with the goals of NCE Zero waste, Zero loss: Accountable for efficiency in Packaging Lines and Materials usage. Support to Procurement on local & zone level. Consumer Complaints: Analyze consumer complaints related to packaging, propose & implement corrective actions.

Preferred candidate profile
Academic Experience:
Graduate in Engineering, preferably in Packaging, Mechanics, Industrial, Chemistry or Automation or equivalent (Materials Science, Printing).

Operational Experience: Packaging development in FMCG Packaging development and packing operation in FMCG.
Problem solving approach.
Project management.
Supplier & converter auditing.

Knowledge
1. Nestl Corporate Business and Nestl Management & Leadership Principles, Nestl on the Move, Nestl Leadership Framework.

2. Competent in Packaging Safety, Quality and Compliance.

3. Basic knowledge in production planning.

4. Aware of customer and consumer understanding.

5. Aware of relevant technology platforms, people management tools & practices in the Nestle context.

6. Good understanding of NPDI process.

7. Good understanding of NCE methodologies in particular TPM & LEAN.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd


Primary Responsibilities:

Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered.
Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately.
Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal. Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure.
Managing cash (system & physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures.
Create new CUID in system &modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments & LoanClosure.
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents.
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.

Job Description
Position: Receptionist / Front Office Executive
Department: Front Office
Industry: Hotel / Resort / Hospitality
Reporting To: General Manager
Location: Shimla


Job Purpose
The Hotel Receptionist Is Responsible For Providing A Warm And Professional Welcome To Guests, Managing Check-in And Check-out Procedures, Handling Guest Enquiries, Coordinating With Hotel Departments, And Ensuring A Smooth And Pleasant Guest Experience Throughout The Stay.


Key Responsibilities

A. Guest Reception Welcome
Welcome And Greet Guests Professionally And Courteously.
Create A Positive First Impression Of The Hotel.
Assist Guests With Their Requirements And Provide Accurate Information.
Maintain Professional Communication And Grooming Standards At All Times.


B. Check-In Check-Out
andle Guest Check-in And Check-out Procedures Efficiently.
Verify Guest Identification And Required Documents.
Allocate Rooms According To Reservations And Hotel Policies.
Provide Room Keys/cards And Explain Basic Hotel Facilities And Services.
Process Departures And Coordinate With The Relevant Departments.


C. Reservation Booking Coordination
Handle Room Reservation Enquiries Through Phone, Email, Online Platforms, And Walk-ins.
Verify Room Availability And Booking Details.
Update Reservation Information Accurately In The Hotel System.
Coordinate With The Reservations And Housekeeping Teams Regarding Room Status.


D. Guest Service
Handle Guest Requests, Questions, And Complaints Professionally.
Resolve Routine Guest Issues Or Escalate Them To The Appropriate Manager.
Provide Information About Hotel Facilities, Restaurants, Nearby Attractions, Transportation, And Local Destinations.
Maintain Excellent Guest Relations And Customer Service Standards.


E. Telephone Communication
Answer And Transfer Telephone Calls Professionally.
Respond To Guest Emails And Messages Promptly.
Maintain Proper Communication With Front Office, Housekeeping, FB, Accounts, Maintenance, And Management.
Take And Communicate Guest Messages Accurately.


F. Cash Billing Support
Handle Guest Payments And Basic Billing Procedures As Assigned.
Maintain Proper Records Of Cash And Transactions.
Coordinate With The Accounts Department Regarding Billing Or Payment-related Matters.
Follow Hotel Procedures For Cash Handling And Financial Documentation.


G. Front Office Administration
Maintain Guest Records And Registration Documents.
Maintain Accurate Shift Handover Records.
Prepare Daily Front-office Reports As Required.
Maintain Confidentiality Of Guest And Hotel Information.
Follow All Hotel Policies, SOPs, And Security Procedures.


Required Skills
Excellent Communication And Interpersonal Skills.
Good English And Hindi Communication Skills.
Pleasant Personality And Professional Appearance.
Good Customer-service And Problem-solving Skills.
Ability To Handle Guests Calmly And Professionally.
Basic Computer And MS Office Knowledge.
Knowledge Of Hotel PMS/software Will Be An Advantage.
Good Telephone Etiquette.
Ability To Work Effectively In A Team.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: 10+2 / Graduate / Diploma In Hotel Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Or A Related Field.
Experience: 0-3 Years Of Experience In Hotel, Resort, Hospitality, Front Office, Or Customer Service.
Freshers With Good Communication Skills And A Positive Attitude May Also Be Considered.


Personal Attributes
Well-groomed And Professional.
Polite, Friendly, And Customer-oriented.
Punctual And Disciplined.
Honest And Responsible.
Positive Attitude.
Able To Work Under Pressure.
Strong Attention To Detail.
Willingness To Learn And Improve.


Working Requirements
Willingness To Work In Rotational Shifts.
Willingness To Work On Weekends And Public Holidays As Per Hotel Requirements.
Maintain Proper Uniform And Grooming Standards.
Follow Hotel Attendance, Leave, Safety, Security, And Operational Policies.
Perform Additional Front-office Duties Assigned By Management.


Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Guest Satisfaction And Feedback.
Accuracy Of Check-in/check-out Procedures.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Manage plant costing and accounting activities.

AboutCompany:
Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Job Description: Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: AVP Commercial

Department: Stores & Inventory Management

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores to lead inward storekeeping, engineering spares custody, consumable inventory, and yard storage operations at our Paonta Sahib manufacturing facility.

The AGM Stores will hold full operational ownership of inventory custody, storage optimization, material issuance, scrap segregation, and system stock reconciliation. The role requires close coordination with Plant Production, Maintenance, Quality, and Central/Local Procurement to eliminate production downtime caused by material shortages, maintain 100% stock accuracy in the ERP system, and implement robust material handling, preservation, and internal audit controls.


Key Responsibilities
1. Inward Logistics & Material Receipt
Direct gate entry verification, weighbridge reconciliation, unloading, and staging for all incoming consignments:


Raw Materials: Stainless steel melting scrap, ingots, billets, HR/CR master coils, and raw pipe shells.

Consumables & Spares: Refractories, mill rolls, lubricants/cutting oils, electrical/mechanical spares, pickling acids/chemicals, grinding wheels, and packaging materials.

Manage the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) workflow in ERP, ensuring physical inspection, chemical/physical test clearance from Quality Control (QC), and vendor delivery challan reconciliations are completed within defined turnaround times.

Coordinate rejected material handling, debits, vendor return gate passes, and replacement follow-ups in close coordination with Local and Corporate Procurement.

2. Inventory Control & ERP Reconciliation
Maintain real-time stock ledger accuracy across all plant sub-stores (Raw Material Yard, Engineering Spares Store, Consumables Store, Scrap Yard).

Enforce Min-Max levels, Reorder Points (ROP), and Safety Stock levels for critical plant operational spares and consumables to prevent stockouts while optimizing working capital.

Conduct continuous cycle counts, monthly reconciliations, and bi-annual/annual full physical stock verifications alongside Internal and Statutory Audit teams; investigate and resolve book-to-physical variances.

Categorize and review inventory using ABC, VED, and FSN analyses; identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete (SLOB) items with concrete salvage or liquidation plans.

3. Material Storage, Preservation & Issuance
Design and implement scientific warehouse layouts, 5S standards, racking systems, bin allocation, and barcode/QR identification tags across all storage bays.

Ensure proper preservation of critical spares, sensitive instrumentation, and materials against weather, rust, acid fumes, or physical handling damage.

Supervise disciplined material issuance against approved Material Requisitions / Job Orders on a FIFO (First-In, First-Out) basis.

Manage hazardous material storage (pickling acids, industrial gases, furnace oils) ensuring mandatory safety measures, MSDS adherence, and spillage containment protocols.

4. Scrap Yard Management & Returnable Material Tracking
Oversee collection, segregation, and weighment of production process scrap (shearing scrap, end-cuttings, rolling scale, rejected mother pipes) and maintain heat-wise/grade-wise scrap accounting for furnace remelting or disposal.

Track Returnable Gate Passes (RGP) and Non-Returnable Gate Passes (NRGP) for plant equipment, rolls, and spares sent out for machining, calibration, or motor rewinding, ensuring strict adherence to return timelines.

5. Team Leadership & System Audits
Lead and supervise storekeepers, yard supervisors, crane operators, forklift drivers, and material handlers.

Enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, ensuring zero safety incidents during heavy lifting and yard handling.

Provide routine Management Information System (MIS) reporting on stock valuation, non-moving inventories, pending GRNs, and consumption trends to the GM Commercial and Corporate Management.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Science (B.Sc), Commerce (B.Com), or Engineering (Diploma/B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy).

Post-Graduate Diploma / MBA in Materials Management or Supply Chain Management is preferred.

Experience:


1216 years of hands-on stores and warehouse management experience in heavy manufacturing, with at least 35 years at a Senior Manager / Manager level.

Essential industry background: Steel Melting Shops (SMS), Stainless Steel Rolling Mills, Tube/Pipe Mills, or Heavy Engineering Fabrication.

Technical & System Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP MM module, Oracle SCM, or TallyPrime).

In-depth knowledge of inventory management methodologies (ABC/VED/FSN, FIFO, 5S, Kaizen).

Solid understanding of weighbridge operations, metallurgical grade differentiation, and traceability marking systems.

Key Competencies:


High personal integrity and strict adherence to internal audit controls.

Strong team supervision and contractor-labor management skills.

Detail-oriented tracking of incoming consignments and rigorous stock reconciliation discipline.

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Job Description: AVP Commercial
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.
AboutCompany: Bharat Green Recycling Renewables Limited (formerly known as Bindal Stainless Limited) is a significant player in the Indian stainless-steel industry, primarily operating out of its extensive manufacturing base in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

Description:
Analytical Assurance

1. To review analytical specifications, standard and general test procedures, test data sheet of raw material, packing material, finished product, stability and micro analysis.
2. To review the data submitted by QC for its completeness.
3. To ensure management of working/ reference/ impurity standard and column management.
4. To ensure contemporaneous documentation.
5. To check raw data /audit trail / software (as applicable) at a given frequency to ensure regulatory guidance compliance.
6. Responsible for finish product, stability, Raw material, packaging materials, micro results and in process sample batch release in LIMS.
7. To review of stability protocols in coordination with stability group and review the stability report
8. To review predictive stability analysis on data generated for stability study
9. Review of analytical method transfer and method validation documents.
10. To coordinate with CQA/ PTC department for implementation related to the official monographs/ General chapters/ corporate quality policy.
11. Reviews of documents i.e. risk assessment, change control, deviation and routine documents of testing area associated to the function.
12. To ensure retrieval of QC data and support for its presentation during audit.
13. Responsible for implementing company quality ethics policy for data integrity and inform management and responsible data integrity compliance head on any data integrity issues as per corporate data governance policy.
14. Responsible for release of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products.
15. Responsible for Review of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products analytical report before release.
16. Responsible for Stability chambers management (Withdrawal/charging of stability samples, Monitoring of Stability chambers temperature and humidity, preventive maintenance of stability Chambers, Calibration of stability calibration). To charge and withdraw stability samples as per scheduler. To maintain and monitor storage conditions of stability chambers and to ensure recording of temperature & humidity of all stability chambers as per the defined frequency. To identify and report to QA for any excursions to the defined storage conditions of the stability chamber. Responsible for reconciliation of stability sample.
17. Responsible for Management of control samples of finished product, raw materials and packaging material.
18. Responsible for Review and release of Calibration before release of instrument for routine use.
19. Responsible for Review of analytical data for process validation and analytical data for market complaint.

AboutCompany:
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & dispensing Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs

Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions.
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation.
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Excellent Verbal and written communication skills

Proficiency in data analysis and ROI Management

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Note: Only candidates from Himachal Pradesh are eligible to apply for this position and have practical working experience in Himachal Pradesh.


Job Description

Accounts Department
Industry: Tourism / Travel / Hospitality
Department: Accounts Finance
Designation: Accounts Executive / Accountant
Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Management


Job Summary
To manage the companys day-to-day accounting, financial transactions, billing, payments, collections, and financial records accurately and on time, while supporting the smooth financial operations of the tourism business.


Key Responsibilities

A. Daily Accounting
Maintain daily accounting entries in Tally/ERP/accounting software.
Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries.
Maintain cash and bank books.
Check and verify invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting documents.
Maintain proper records of company expenses.


B. Tour Travel Accounts
Prepare and verify invoices for tour packages, hotel bookings, transportation, and other travel services.
Maintain customer-wise and booking-wise payment records.
Track advance payments received from customers.
Monitor pending customer payments and outstanding balances.
Verify vendor bills for hotels, transporters, guides, agents, and other service providers.
Maintain vendor-wise outstanding statements.
Reconcile tour package costs with actual expenses.


C. Bank Cash Management
Prepare bank reconciliation statements.
Monitor daily bank transactions.
Maintain petty cash records.
Verify cash receipts and payments.
Ensure all cash and bank transactions are properly documented.


D. Receivables Payables
Follow up on outstanding customer payments.
Maintain accounts receivable and payable reports.
Process vendor payments after proper verification and approval.
Ensure payments are made according to company policy and agreed terms.


E. GST Taxation Support
Maintain GST-related sales and purchase records.
Assist in preparation of GST returns and other statutory reports.
Maintain proper tax invoices and supporting documents.
Coordinate with CA/tax consultants for taxation-related requirements.
Maintain TDS records and assist with TDS compliance wherever applicable.


F. Salary Employee Accounts
Assist in monthly salary preparation.
Maintain employee advances, deductions, incentives, and reimbursements.
Verify employee expense claims and supporting bills.
Maintain records related to full final settlement.


G. Financial Reporting
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports.
Prepare outstanding reports for customers and vendors.
Provide management with revenue, expense, and payment reports.
Assist in monthly closing and preparation of financial statements.


Required Skills
Basic knowledge of accounting principles.
Knowledge of Tally/ERP/accounting software.
Good knowledge of MS Excel.
Basic knowledge of GST, TDS, and taxation.
Good calculation and analytical skills.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to maintain confidential financial information.
Ability to work under deadlines.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / Equivalent accounting qualification.
Experience: 1-4 years in accounts, any company.
Candidates having good accounting knowledge and computer skills, email drafting skills.

Description:
Job Summary
Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the medical devices or orthopaedic implant industry and will be responsible for developing business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving regional sales targets across the assigned territories.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed regional sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clinics, trauma centres, and healthcare institutions.
Schedule product demonstrations, surgeon meetings, training sessions, and provide technical support as required.
Address customer complaints or issues promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.
Analyse market dynamics to identify potential growth opportunities within the assigned territories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Development, and Operations, to align sales strategies with company objectives.
Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
Track sales performance, prepare periodic reports, and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and implement strategies to increase market share throughout the assigned region.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory and company requirements related to sales activities.
Drive customer satisfaction and build long-term business relationships.
Manage distributor and dealer networks within the assigned territories, where applicable.
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3 4 years of proven sales experience in the Medical Devices or Orthopaedic Implant industry (preferred).
Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, particularly Orthopaedics and Trauma Care.
Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Proficiency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of Punjabi is preferred. Familiarity with regional languages is an added advantage.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.
Role Details
AboutCompany:
Ortho Max Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the design and production of orthopedic implants and surgical instruments. Their portfolio includes solutions for orthopedics, neurosurgery, veterinary applications, and cranio-maxillofacial procedures. The company emphasizes innovation, precision engineering, and global market outreach.

Description:
Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Una/Hamirpur-Himachal
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Interested candidate share CV/Resume @ Akshat.Chauhan@brightlifecare.com or 9650023605
