Description:
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering
Experience: 12+Years
Shift: General Shift (Flexibility required for global stakeholder engagements)
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane, The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.
Your future duties and responsibilities
• Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.
• Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.
• Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.
• Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.
• Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.
• Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.
• Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.
• Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.

Job Description
AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant Pharmaceutical Client
Job Title

AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant
Industry Domain

Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences (GxP-regulated Manufacturing)
Experience Required

5-10 years
Employment Type

Full-time
Location

Chennai/Bangalore/Kochi/Coimbatore - Hybrid
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA PI (OSIsoft PI) Engineer with expertise in the Life Sciences/Pharmaceutical industry to design, implement, and support enterprise historian solutions. The candidate will be responsible for integrating manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and automation systems with the AVEVA PI System to enable real-time monitoring, data integrity, regulatory compliance, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

Description:
- Identify and develop new business opportunities for Cytogenetic and Molecular Genetic diagnostic services.

- Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, gynaecologists, oncologists, paediatricians, geneticists, infertility specialists and other relevant healthcare professionals to promote diagnostic services.

- Establish and maintain professional relationships with doctors, consultants, referral centres and healthcare institutions.

- Promote Cytogenetic investigations, including:
- Karyotyping
- FISH (Fluorescence In Situ Hybridisation)
- Prenatal Cytogenetic Testing
- Cancer Cytogenetic Studies
- Other specialised chromosomal investigations.

- Promote Molecular Genetic investigations, including:
- PCR and Real-Time PCR (qPCR)
- DNA/RNA-based Molecular Diagnostics
- Sanger Sequencing and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)
- Genetic Disorder and Carrier Screening

- Hereditary Cancer Testing
- Pharmacogenetic Testing
- Infectious Disease Molecular Diagnostics
- Other specialised molecular investigations.

- Communicate test indications, clinical applications, methodologies, sample requirements and laboratory facilities to healthcare professionals.

- Coordinate with laboratory and sample collection teams to ensure appropriate sample collection, handling, transportation and processing.

- Generate referrals, develop new referral centres and achieve assigned business development and revenue targets.

- Maintain regular field visit reports, referral records and follow-up activities.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities, gather feedback and identify business expansion opportunities.

- Coordinate with laboratory teams for timely communication and resolution of client queries.

- Participate in medical awareness programmes, CME activities, conferences and promotional events.

- Create awareness among healthcare professionals about advancements and clinical applications in Cytogenetics and Molecular Genetics.

Job Title - Pricing & CPQ - Analyst - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 11 - Analyst
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad
Must have skills:PROS Smart Price Optimization

Good to have skills:Pricing Tools
Experience:2-3 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote-to-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams-sales, finance, product, and IT-to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client-s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best-in-class KPIs
Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information
Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Description:
Greetings from Reliance Nippon Life Insurance!!
Inviting applications from smart sales managers to get associated and enhance your career with a leading
brand.
Roles & Responsibilities:
In this role, the ARDM will be responsible for finding people interested in becoming Insurance Agents and
getting them qualified to sell insurance policies. ARDM will also be expected to help them in selling policies
by joint field working and operations support. For this purpose, ARDM will be trained intensely by the
company.
To ensure sell of our insurance products
To ensure quality advisors are being recruited and developed
To communicate changing customer needs to the top management
To expand our reach to untapped customers
Quality advisors recruitment
To meet potential people in the natural market
To persuade them to become advisors for RNLIC by explaining the benefits and remuneration by creating
win-win situation
To grow advisor base perpetually
Development of advisors
To regularly hold the meetings with Branch Manager for training advisors on various fronts
To assist advisors in closing crucial sales call
To work as a coach for the team of advisors
Make daily sales call
To make visits to generate leads for sales on daily basis
To follow up on already generated leads to close them successfully
To make policy renewals
To renew the policys sold in earlier year for maintaining optimum persistency


Pre-requisites:
Age group of 26 to 50 years, who has been a local resident for some time
At least 1 years experience of field sales jobs in any industry.
Team handling experience of more than 6 months would be desirable.
Means to travel locally via owned or reliable public conveyance.
Android based smart-phone with an active connection.
Opportunity to Travels to exciting locations both National and International.

Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities for process improvement, recommend enhancements to business processes and system functionalities

Skills and attributes for success
In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
Ability to work virtually with global teams

To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience preferably in Talent

Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.

Description:
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Associate 66.2- CRM Operations
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
This opportunity is in the global operations teams of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) which is rapidly growing. As our efforts towards building a better working world, GDS operations need to create an evolving framework of CRM Operational excellence framework control in all processes, decision making and activities for GDS operations to enable our business teams across locations.
As an Associate Risk Management Analyst, you will take on a more advanced role in supporting the risk management department. Building on the foundational skills developed at the Associate level, you will have increased responsibilities in managing risk management tools, performing more complex tasks related to client and engagement acceptance, and contributing to the continuous improvement of risk management processes. You will also mentor junior team members and provide more in-depth analysis and reporting.
Your key responsibilities
Manage more complex aspects of risk management tools, including advanced troubleshooting and problem resolution.
Lead the implementation of new features or updates in risk management systems, including coordinating with IT and other relevant teams.
Ensure data integrity within risk management tools, performing regular audits and making necessary corrections.
Conduct detailed reviews of client and engagement documentation, identifying and assessing potential risks.
Assist in developing and refining processes for client and engagement acceptance to improve efficiency and compliance.
Liaise with the onshore team and other departments to resolve any issues related to client and engagement acceptance.
Prepare and analyze complex reports on risk management activities, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
Support the development of compliance frameworks and contribute to internal audits by providing necessary documentation and insights.
Act as a point of contact for more complex queries and issues, both from within the team and from other departments.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of risk management processes, identifying areas for efficiency gains or risk reduction.
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing overall risk management capabilities within the organization.
Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes, and share relevant insights with the team.
Qualification, Skills, and attributes for success
Bachelor s degree in finance, business, risk management, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in risk management, finance, or a related area.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with risk management tools and systems is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
This is a hybrid role.
What we look for
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

AboutCompany:
Ernst & Young (EY) is a global professional services firm and one of the "Big Four" accounting firms. Description:
ob Summary:

We are looking for a skilled and self-driven React Native Developer with a minimum of 23 years of hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and maintaining mobile applications for both Android and iOS platforms.
The ideal candidate should have proven experience in independently handling the complete mobile application development lifecycle, from scratch to live deployment, including requirement analysis, architecture, development, testing, app store releases, and post-launch maintenance.
The candidate must be capable of taking ownership of mobile application development projects and delivering high-quality, scalable, and performance-oriented solutions with minimal supervision.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for Android and iOS.
Independently manage the complete mobile application development lifecycle, from initial concept and development to production release.
Build responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance mobile applications.
Develop reusable components, maintainable code, and scalable application architecture.
Integrate RESTful APIs, third-party libraries, SDKs, and backend services.
Implement authentication, push notifications, and other essential mobile application functionalities.
Handle application debugging, performance optimization, testing, and issue resolution.
Manage Android and iOS builds, signing, configurations, and deployment to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Monitor live applications, troubleshoot production issues, and release updates and enhancements.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
Ensure application security, compatibility, stability, and adherence to platform-specific guidelines.
Stay updated with the latest React Native technologies, mobile development practices, and platform updates.

Required Skills:

Minimum 1-2years of hands-on experience in React Native mobile application development.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
Proven experience developing mobile applications for both Android and iOS platforms.
Demonstrated ability to independently develop and launch mobile applications from scratch to production.
Strong understanding of React Native architecture, component lifecycle, hooks, state management, and navigation.
Experience with REST API integration, JSON, and asynchronous programming.
Hands-on experience with Redux, Context API, Zustand, or other state management solutions.
Familiarity with Git, version control, and collaborative development workflows.
Experience with Android Studio, Xcode, and mobile debugging tools.
Practical knowledge of app signing, build generation, and Play Store / App Store deployment.
Understanding of mobile application performance optimization, security, and responsive UI development.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
ES- Finance: Reporting and Data Analytics
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all
We provide reporting solutions or requirements through finance, markets and operations reporting along with cyclical and critical controlling processes such as Forecasting, Financial Planning, Revenue Planning, Markets Leadership Planning and Cash Reporting to help you take better business decisions. With projects like Mercury, we also support business transformation, and we are continuing to expand our services to support all Regions with their Reporting and Data Analytics needs.
The opportunity
The purpose of this job is to prepare standard reports and study Market/Engagement results, cost analysis and budgets. Analysis to conclude root causes, variances and suggest corrections to management. Design and create complex reports to user specifications. The position will ideally have to handle more complex issues and special projects than a junior financial analyst
Your key responsibilities
Generate standard reports (Sales and Pipeline, Global Revenue reports) on a periodic basis and Identify and solve issues that affect reporting
Knowledge of global reporting and consolidation (Area, Region, Service ling reporting)
Handle complex ad hoc reports from Stakeholders on a timely manner
Proactively take part in the revenue planning as well as financial planning process
Ensure proper review mechanism is in place for the respective teams
Develop new reports as well as enhance existing reports by working on automating the report preparation as much as possible
Mentor, guide, train junior analysts and new recruits
Skills and attributes for success
Possess statistical or data driven and problem solving skills
Have sound understanding of basic accounting concepts
Possess good communication skill
Be strong in MS Excel skill, SQL and Power BI
Understand financial reporting goals and basic process flow
Ability to understand numbers and arrive at inferences
Have strong interpersonal skills with the ability to teach the juniors
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years in reporting and other accounting processes.
Bachelor s degree in Accounting or Finance
Strong MS Excel skill
Knowledge of basic accounting concepts
Good communication skill
Ideally, you ll also have
Exposure to Power BI, SQL or any other visualization tools
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY FA practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations - Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland, Mexico, Sri Lanka and Spain and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced AWS System Support Engineer with a minimum of 3+ years of relevant hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure management, system administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical support.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in managing AWS environments, maintaining system availability, resolving infrastructure-related issues, and ensuring the performance, security, and reliability of cloud-based systems.
The candidate must be capable of independently handling cloud infrastructure support, incident management, and operational activities in a production environment.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Manage, monitor, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure and services.
Provide L1/L2/L3 system and infrastructure support for production environments.
Administer and troubleshoot AWS services, including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, Route 53, and Load Balancers.
Monitor system performance, availability, resource utilization, and infrastructure health.
Troubleshoot server, network, connectivity, application hosting, and cloud infrastructure issues.
Perform Linux and Windows server administration, configuration, patching, and maintenance.
Manage user access, IAM roles, security groups, and access permissions in accordance with security policies.
Handle incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive measures to minimize recurring issues.
Configure and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.
Support cloud infrastructure deployment, configuration, migration, and environment maintenance.
Monitor and optimize AWS resource utilization and cloud infrastructure costs.
Maintain system documentation, operational procedures, and incident reports.
Coordinate with development, networking, security, and application support teams to resolve technical issues.
Ensure compliance with infrastructure security standards, operational procedures, and SLA requirements.
Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities as required.

Required Skills:
Minimum 4+ years of relevant hands-on experience in AWS system support, cloud infrastructure support, or system administration.
Strong practical knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, Route 53, and ELB/ALB.
Experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
Working knowledge of Windows Server administration.
Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, subnets, firewalls, and security groups.
Experience with system monitoring, incident management, and production troubleshooting.
Knowledge of AWS backup, recovery, and disaster recovery practices.
Familiarity with cloud security, access management, and infrastructure hardening.
Experience with shell scripting (Bash) or Python for basic automation.
Understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently handle technical issues and provide timely resolutions.

Description:
SAP Concur Senior 1,2 TechOps (Application Management) Consultant

Job Summary
We are looking for an SAP Concur Senior to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for Concur modules - Expense and Travel across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.


Your Key Responsibilities
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP Concur solutions and designs.
Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (Australia, Asia, Europe and Americas hours)
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Gather and analyze business requirements for travel policies, expense workflows, and approval hierarchies.
Configure Concur Expense, Travel, and Request modules, including audit rules, custom forms, and workflows.
Strong understanding of travel and expense management processes, including per diems, mileage, receipts, and reimbursement cycles.
Hands-on experience with Concur configuration, workflow setup, and integration tools.
Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
Defect resolution and defect analysis related to Concur.
Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements


Ideally, you'll also have
Well versed with travel and expense management processes, including per diems, mileage, receipts, and reimbursement cycles


Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
5-7 years of experience in IT with at least 3 years in SAP Concur implementation/support.

Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced BIM Coordinator to support and lead BIM coordination on large-scale projects in the Middle East. The candidate must have strong technical BIM expertise, excellent English communication skills, and mandatory hands-on experience with Revit and AutoCAD.

Location: Kochi, Kerala
Work Days: Monday to Friday
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Key Responsibilities
Lead BIM coordination across MEP and other disciplines.
Develop, manage, and review BIM models to ensure accuracy and compliance with project standards.
Perform clash detection using Navisworks and lead coordination meetings.
Prepare and maintain BIM Execution Plans (BEP), LOD matrices, and coordination reports.
Ensure BIM deliverables comply with client requirements and Middle East project standards.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and clients across multiple stakeholders.
Manage model updates, version control, and data exchange through CDE platforms.
Support construction teams with BIM-based coordination and technical solutions.
Mentor junior BIM team members and provide technical guidance.
Ensure timely delivery of BIM outputs aligned with project schedules.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Bachelors degree in Engineering, or Construction Management.
713 years of BIM experience, including Middle East project experience.
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) – mandatory
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD – mandatory
Proven experience in BIM coordination and interdisciplinary model management.
Strong understanding of construction drawings, shop drawings, and coordination workflows.

Preferred Skills
Experience with Navisworks Manage for clash detection.
Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC / BIM 360)
Knowledge of ISO 19650 and regional BIM standards.
Experience working on large commercial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

Interested? Please share your resume at recruiter.kochi@capstonees.com

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Description:
Responsibilities:* Client Billing: Prepare, process, and submit monthly Running Account (RA) bills, final bills, and price escalation claims in accordance with contractual terms and MoRTH specifications.
* Government Portal Management: Operate and process project bills through Kerala PWD PRICE and official government e-Billing platforms.
* Measurement & Record Keeping: Verify joint measurements at site, enter/maintain accurate Measurement Books (MB Record), and reconcile site measurement sheets with field staff.
* Subcontractor & PRW Billing: Scrutinize, verify, and certify running and final bills submitted by subcontractors, piece-rate workers (PRW), and equipment vendors against actual on-ground execution.
* BOQ Reconciliation & Quantity Surveying: Monitor bill of quantities (BOQ), prepare item-wise variance statements (deviations/extra items), and reconcile theoretical vs. actual material consumption (cement, bitumen, aggregates, steel).
* Rate Analysis: Formulate rate analysis for extra/substituted items using standard DSR/MoRTH data books and current market rates.
* Client Coordination: Liaise with client representatives, PWD/KIIFB assistant executive engineers (AEE/EE), independent consultants, and site engineers for timely bill certification and payment clearance.
Desired Candidate Profile
* Education: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* Experience: 3 to 6 years of core billing and quantity surveying experience in road, highway, or bridge construction projects (direct experience with Kerala PWD, KIIFB, NHAI, or KSTP projects preferred).
* Technical Skills:
* Hands-on proficiency with Kerala PWD PRICE / e-Billing portals.
* Deep understanding of MoRTH specifications and standard measurement procedures.
* High proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliation sheets) and basic AutoCAD (for quantity extraction).
AboutCompany:
Malabar Plus Constructions Pvt Ltd, an established infrastructure and road contractor executing prestigious PWD and KIIFB highway improvement projects across Kerala, is hiring a competent Billing Engineer to join our project team based in Malappuram

In this role, you will go beyond modeling to oversee electrical workflows, run clash detection tests, and collaborate with architectural, structural, and mechanical teams to ensure a fully coordinated, buildable design before construction begins.

Quality Assurance: Ensure all electrical models adhere to project BIM execution plans (BEP), company standards, and specified Levels of Development (LOD 300/400).

Experience: 3+ years of experience in MEP BIM coordination, with a strong focus on electrical systems.
Software Expertise: Advanced mastery of Autodesk Revit (MEP), Navisworks Manage, and cloud platforms like Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360.
Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of electrical containment routing logic, clearances around switchgear/panels, and standard building codes.
Leadership & Communication: Excellent communication skills to chair clash resolution meetings and coordinate effectively with engineers, architects, and project managers.

Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with ficial systems/tools(SAP/Orcale).

Job Title: SAP ABAP / HANA ABAP / S/4HANA ABAP Consultant
Experience: 3-8 yrs
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli

Design, develop, test, and deploy SAP ABAP applications on SAP HANA platform using CDS views and OData services.

3-8 years of experience in SAP ABAP development with expertise in Core ABAP programming language.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.Tech / B.E.) or Master's degree (MS/M.Sc) from a recognized university.
Strong understanding of SAP HANA architecture, including CDS views and OData services integration.
Proficiency in developing complex reports using RICEFW components such as RFCs, ICDS views, OO ABAP objects etc.

Note: Experience in ISU ABAP, ABAP HR, and MDG ABAP is not considered for this role.

SAP CPI Consultant JD
About the Role
We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.
Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,
Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc
Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years

Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI,CLOUD PLATFORM,INTEGRATION SUITE,IFLOWS,GROOVY SCRIPT,ODATA,ODATA

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
JOB DESCRIPTION
RTL Architect
Experience

15+ years

Location

Hyderabad, bangalore,chennai,kochi,pune
Domain

ASIC / SoC Turnkey Silicon

Employment

Full-time

The Role
Define micro-architecture and lead RTL design and SoC/subsystem integration for complex silicon, owning PPA and design quality through tape-out.

What You Will Do
Define micro-architecture, block partitioning and interface specifications from system requirements.
Own PPA trade-offs and RTL quality: lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis and constraints (SDC, UPF).
Lead subsystem and SoC integration, and drive design and code reviews.
Partner with DV, DFT and PD to close verification, testability, timing and power.
Mentor and technically guide RTL teams; act as the escalation point for design issues.
Support emulation, FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up and root-cause analysis.

What You Bring
15+ years in RTL design and integration, with multiple tape-outs in a lead or architect role.
Expert Verilog / SystemVerilog and strong micro-architecture skills.
Deep experience with AMBA (AXI/AHB/APB), NoC and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB.
Solid grasp of low-power design (UPF), clocking, CDC/RDC and timing-driven RTL.
Proficiency with front-end tools: lint, CDC, synthesis, STA; scripting in Python, Perl or Tcl.
Clear technical communication with customers and cross-functional teams.

Good to Have
ARM or RISC-V subsystem integration
Die-to-die / UCIe and chiplet architectures
Post-silicon debug experience

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Description:
Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1–L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement

Job Summary

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
To design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable multi-cloud infrastructure to support our engineering and operational workloads.

Key Responsibilities
- Infrastructure Design & Delivery: Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance cloud environments across AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP. Build resilient architectures for highly available production workloads.
- Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Standardize and automate infrastructure provisioning using tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
- Cross-Cloud Security: Implement consistent security controls, including IAM policies, encryption, and network security configurations, in adherence to organizational standards.
- Operational Excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues while optimizing performance, availability, and cost across all cloud platforms.
Requirements
- Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or GCP.
- Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
- Strong understanding of Linux and Windows system administration.
- Knowledge of networking concepts, including VPNs, hybrid connectivity, routing, and firewall policies.
- Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity management and network hardening.

Preferred candidate profile:
Experienced Cloud Engineer with a minimum of two years of hands-on experience in design, implementation and maintain secure, scalable multi-cloud infrastructure.

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

The Opportunity

Your Key Responsibilities
Coordinate funding of domestic and international investments, execute capital distributions, and call capital from investors as needed.

CA, CPA, CMA, CFA preferred with major degree in accounting, finance, business.

Proven track record of presenting complex financial data to senior executives.
Providing recommendations for critical managerial decisions.
Strong financial analytics, data interpretations and financial modelling skills.
Knowledge of accounting principles and practices, analysis, and reporting of financial data.
