Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep expertise in Python, modern web application development, AI-assisted software engineering, cloud-native architecture, and platform engineering.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with consulting capabilities, enabling them to engage directly with business stakeholders, understand complex problems, architect scalable solutions, and deliver production-ready applications. This role requires hands-on experience across frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, governance frameworks, and emerging AI technologies.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 6+ years of overall industry experience in software engineering.
Minimum 6+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
Proven experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade applications.
Experience working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile development, DevOps, and cloud-native engineering practices.
Experience operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Design and Develop Backend Services
Design, build, and maintain FastAPI-based services with comprehensive testing strategies, including unit, integration, and contract testing to ensure production-grade reliability and maintainability.
2. Build AI-Assisted Engineering Solutions
Utilize Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and other approved AI tools as core development accelerators to improve engineering quality, productivity, and delivery speed.
3. Engineer CI/CD and Platform Automation
Build and maintain GitHub Actions-based CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated testing, schema validation, quality gates, security scanning, governance checks, and deployment automation.
4. Develop and Deploy Cloud-Native Applications
Design, containerize, deploy, and support applications using Docker and Azure cloud services, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, and Azure App Service.
5. Build Enterprise Integrations and Governance Services
Develop Python services that integrate with GitHub APIs, JFrog REST APIs, identity systems, governance platforms, and enterprise tooling while enforcing RBAC, approval workflows, and audit requirements.
6. Develop Modern User Interfaces
Design and build intuitive React-based user interfaces, dashboards, and administration portals that provide seamless user experiences and integrate with backend services and enterprise platforms.
7. Build AI Governance and Content Classification Pipelines
Implement automated scanning, classification, governance, and compliance frameworks for AI-generated content, software packages, and engineering artifacts.
8. Own End-to-End Solution Delivery
Lead the complete solution lifecycle from discovery and architecture through development, deployment, adoption, and operational support, ensuring measurable business outcomes

Job Description


Overview
Experienced MEPF Cost Estimation Quantity Surveying professional with strong expertise in preparing accurate cost estimates, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, tender documentation, and commercial evaluations for Oil Gas projects. Responsible for end-to-end cost management, benchmarking, value engineering, risk assessment, and procurement support across the full project lifecycle, leveraging CostX, AutoCAD, and industry-standard measurement methodologies to deliver reliable and cost-effective project outcomes.


Your role
Estimation Cost Planning:
Prepare accurate cost estimates for MEPF works across all project stages.
Perform detailed quantity take-offs based on drawings, specifications, and available project information.
Develop bottom-up and top-down cost estimates aligned with project scope and stage.
Prepare rate analysis and build-up for materials, labor, plant, and equipment.
Estimate costs for all MEPF systems including:
HVAC
Electrical and ELV systems
Plumbing drainage
Fire protection systems
Cost Data, Benchmarking Analysis:
Utilize knowledge of market rates, productivity norms, and location factors.
Conduct rate benchmarking against similar projects and historical data.
Validate and assure contractor estimates, including:
Quantities
Rates
Risks and opportunities
Inflation allowances
Indirect costs
Tendering Procurement Support:
Prepare Bill of Quantities (BoQ) in accordance with applicable standards.
Develop tender and contract documents for contractors and consultants.
Identify non-tender items and communicate proactively to clients.
Obtain and evaluate bids from contractors and subcontractors.
Prepare:
Technical and commercial evaluation reports
Bid comparison statements
Support negotiations with contractors and suppliers.
Provide procurement strategy advice to clients.
Technical Review Documentation:
Review drawings and specifications and raise RFIs (Requests for Information) for clarifications.
Develop assumptions and exclusions during early-stage estimates.
Prepare estimation assurance reports highlighting observations and gaps.
Monitor design and construction changes and update cost projections accordingly.
Project Cost Control Change Management:
Track project progress and prepare cost reports and forecasts.
Quantify and manage project variations, including:
Time and cost impact assessment
Supporting documentation and justification
Maintain and update the commercial risk register.
Value Engineering Advisory:
Provide cost optimization and value engineering recommendations.
Advise clients on cost-effective design and construction strategies.
Assess financial and construction risks and propose mitigation strategies.
Lifecycle Costing (Preferred):
Prepare whole life cycle cost analysis (LCCA).
Perform financial evaluations including Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations (preferred/advantageous).


About you
Use estimation software such as:
Experience in Cost-X will be added advantage.
Excel-based cost models.
Experience in Aspen software is required.
Ensure proper documentation and version control of estimates.
Strong knowledge of MEPF systems and services (internal external) for Proven experience working on Oil Gas projects is essential.
High proficiency in cost estimation, rate analysis, and benchmarking
Strong analytical and commercial acumen
Excellent communication and teamwork skills
Ability to manage multiple deadlines in fast-paced environments
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Electrical engineering or related field
Charted membership of RICS (MRICS)/CCP(AACE) will be added advantage.
Experience in full project lifecycle (estimation to closure)
Experience across industrial, commercial, or infrastructure projects preferred
Commercial awareness and risk assessment
Familiarity with international standards and best practices
Proficient in quantity take off using AutoCAD, CostX.
Knowledge of Standard measurement methods like NRM, CESMM, POMI, Uniformat, Master format will be added advantage.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
Join our growing Fiber Engineering team!
We are hiring Fiber Engineers, Expert Fiber Engineers and Fiber Engineering Team Leads with strong expertise in fiber network design and engineering.

Key Responsibilities
Performs all aspects of OSP engineering for fiber projects according to requirements and guidelines.
Designs/draft the fiber network with optimal route by doing feasibility analysis.
Works within customer systems to produce a cost-effective engineering design for the construction team.
Produce quality products to reduce multiple quality checks.
Timely raise the queries and concern related to the project.
Support and timely availability to deliver the client submittals to meet OTP and quality.
Plan fiber/copper cables to poles and place underground cables according to construction requirements.
Take constructive feedback from the QCs/Leads and work to improve efficiency and quality.
Flexible to work in any team/projects as per requirements.
Work with the given timeline to complete the task and adapt quickly changing priorities.
Should be able to think towards new working ways (Automation, process optimization).
Open to take new roles and responsibilities if assigned by the managers as per business needs.
Attentive in all the training/feedback sessions and should be able to explain/recall, if asked by the leads/trainers.

Critical Experience
2-4 year of experience in Fiber network design engineering in ASE, F2, Green Field/DFIB, F1/F3 scope of work.
Preferred experience with AT&T and added advantage if experience of Ziply, LUMEN, Google Fiber etc.
Experience working tools: Aramis, IQGEO, Waldo, QGIS, ArcgGIS, 3GIS, CGIS, SpatialNet, Comscof, NDS, Frogs, AutoCAD, FMS, OCALC, Smallworld, Netwin, WebGIS
B.Tech in any Engineering or equivalent

It sells beauty, wellness and fashion products through its website, mobile app and over 100 physical stores. In 2020, it became the first Indian unicorn startup headed by a woman.
Description:
1 Job Description for CS to Logistics Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Handling all logistics related queries which will be routed from the CS team through mails, chats, and calls.
b. Closing urgent deliveries, POD, disputed cases raised from customers.
c. Closing all the cases for customers within defined TAT.
d. Need to take ownership and close customer queries with a positive response.
e. Enhances organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests.
f. Having a weekly review with courier partners for improvisation on TAT and maintaining a quality of deliveries.
g. Working with the CS team and other team members to improvise the process and enhance the quality of service for customers.
h. Engaging with a cross functional team.

2. Job Description for NDR Agent/Supervisor: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Should be able to manage a team of 10 to 12 people.
b. Outcall and mail to customers and validate the failed delivery remarks from customers.
c. Taking initiative and getting shipments delivered to customers by keeping a close followup with courier partners.
d. Outbound calling for non-delivered shipments.
e. Determines requirements of customers.
f. Answers inquiries by clarifying desired information; researching, locating, and providing information.
g. Resolves problems by clarifying issues; researching and exploring answers and alternative solutions; implementing solutions; escalating unresolved problems.
h. Maintains NDR calling database by entering information.
i. Enhances organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests.

3. Job Description for Billing and COD Reconciliation Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Deal with logistics partners and manage the disputes for marketplace vendors.
b. Logistics cost reconciliations.
c. CN recovery against the Damage and lost shipments.
d. Maintain data of COD-remittance and reconciliation with courier partners.
e. Check and reconcile courier and vendor bill or invoice copy.

4. Job Description for MIS/Data Analytics Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Handling day to day logistics operations and interacting with different teams warehouse, finance, retail stores.
b. Monitor dispatch to deliver TAT and prepare the action plan for further improvement.
c. Conduct Weekly performance meetings with LPs to provide feedback.
d. Proactive actions on the basis of data analysis.
e. Identify the stuck shipments and provide Tat for tail shipments.
f. Dispatch to in transit delays.
g. Manage non delivery related issues.
h. Marketplace operations closure.
i. Shipment cycle closure.
j. Generating SCM reports.
k. Reverse pickups handling and monitoring.
AboutCompany:
FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd, d/b/a Nykaa, is an Indian retail company, headquartered in Mumbai. It sells beauty, wellness and fashion products through its website, mobile app and over 100 physical stores. In 2020, it became the first Indian unicorn startup headed by a woman.

Nykaa sells products which are manufactured in India as well as internationally. In 2015, the company expanded from online-only to an omnichannel model and began selling products apart from beauty. As of 2020, it retails over 2,000 brands and 200,000 products across its platforms.

Description:
The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Grid Integration (HVDC) offers an exciting opportunity to work with advanced High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC) technologies. You will be part of the Services team, supporting the installed base of HVDC systems by ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and customer satisfaction while contributing to the long-term performance and availability of critical power infrastructure.
How You'll Make an Impact
Demonstrate a strong commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards, policies, and guidelines.
Serve as the primary customer interface for the HVDC installed base and maintain strong customer relationships.
Perform troubleshooting and restoration activities for HVDC systems and equipment during failures or outages, in coordination with technical experts.
Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities for HVDC and HVAC equipment.
Monitor installed HVDC assets using Asset Management tools, including performance monitoring and inventory control.
Coordinate with internal teams, customers, vendors, and OEMs to ensure fulfillment of warranty obligations and service requirements.
Manage replacement, installation, and commissioning activities related to failed HVDC/HVAC equipment.
Support Service Project Managers by providing reports, technical inputs, and updates related to warranty, reliability, availability, and Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSA).
Prepare and maintain site documentation, including Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and service reports.
Review technical drawings, engineering documents, protection schemes, and operating procedures to support maintenance and fault resolution.
Participate in outage management, fault investigations, emergency response activities, and root cause analysis.
Ensure timely communication and coordination with technical support teams during critical service events.
Travel domestically and internationally to support customer sites and project requirements.
Uphold Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, teamwork, and customer focus.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your Background
Education Experience
Diploma or bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Additional certifications or training in HVDC, substation systems, control protection, or power system maintenance will be considered an advantage.
5 Years of experience in HVDC/HVAC systems, substations, power transmission, grid integration, or power system maintenance.
Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, maintenance, and operation of electrical equipment in utility, transmission, or industrial environments.
Experience in customer-facing service roles and managing technical support activities.
Exposure to outage management, fault diagnosis, equipment replacement, and commissioning activities.
Experience working with warranty management, LTSA contracts, reliability, and availability monitoring is preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively and work in demanding operational environments.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence

What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.

- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.

 • Demonstrate maturity, poise, and confidence while proactively reporting availability and seeking new opportunities to contribute.
 • Ensure work meets the firms quality standards and adheres to the international regulatory accounting framework.
 The Team

About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:Accenture Strategy & Consulting enables our clients to embrace the change and shape their future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture S&Cs services include those provided by our Capability Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. Be part of a highly specialized team including top notch professionals from leading business schools coupled with experience in working with global industry leaders. Grow your career and experience a stimulating, fast-paced environment working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve significant business challenges. You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working. o Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation. Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year. About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client-serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing, and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help worlds leading companies meet their assurance requirements

Job purpose:
The role of a Trainee/ Consultant is to carry out routine substantive and controls-based testing for the GDS Assurance multinational clients. Clients are primarily based in the various countries of Europe and the US. Key challenges for the role are to provide high quality results to the local team, often to a tight deadline

Locations- Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Kochi, Noida, Pune,Trivandrum

Contract Duration: 3 months

Responsibilities:
Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific procedures as defined by the engagement objectives, onshore teams work step allocation, and planned approach
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues or accounting risks
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the GDS Senior/Manager
Collaborate with GDS and local team members to set goals and responsibilities
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the GDS & local GDS assurance team.
Mandatory Educational requirement:
Part Qualified ACCA(9/13) /CPA(2/4) completed
Article ship completed (For CA candidates)
Should be a Graduate (B.Com, BBA)

Additional skills requirements:
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping
Good written and oral communication skills

Description:
Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
Job Description
What will you work on
Stay attuned to Chandigarh s ever-evolving food scene, from street food stalls to upscale restaurants, and translate these experiences into engaging written content.
Collaborate with the team to develop content strategies that drive engagement and follower growth.
Create and deliver compelling, scripted content that aligns with the pages theme and resonates with the target audience.
Attend food events, tastings, and restaurant openings to gather first-hand information for posts.
Write scripts for engaging reels to captivate our audience on social media.
Conduct research to stay updated on the latest trends and developments in Chandigarh s FB, lifestyle, cultural, and entertainment scene.
Edit and proofread content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to Instagram page style and guidelines.
Monitor and analyze the performance of content initiatives, providing insights and recommendations for optimization.
Assist in managing the content calendar to ensure timely delivery of content. Qualifications
Who are we looking for:
Proven content writing experience, preferably in lifestyle or hospitality industries.
Comfortable being on camera and/or has proven experience as an Anchor, Host, or Presenter, preferably in the FB or lifestyle domain.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with keen attention to detail and grammar.
Passion for exploring and discovering Chandigarh s FB, lifestyle, cultural, and entertainment experiences. Proficiency in content management and social media platforms.
Familiarity with SEO principles and keyword research tools.

Job Introduction:
Job Description of Lady Security Guard
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergency situations, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to Supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorized person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from employer and 12% from Employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 to 35 for fresher and upto 40 for experienced security guards
Physically and Medically fit and look like mature

Description:
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities.
Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives.
Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include participating on sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Assists with managing and developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities.
Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives.
Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Assistant Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 15-20 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 15-20 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

The brand operates across categories such as running, football, training, basketball, and motorsport, and is known for combining performance, innovation, and street style.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Discovery :

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
We are seeking a highly driven, analytical, and results-oriented Senior Manager Fulfillment Center Operations to lead end-to-end fulfillment center operations. The role requires strong operational leadership, commercial acumen, and the ability to drive service excellence while maintaining profitability and operational efficiency.

Role & responsibilities

Ensure consistent achievement of all customer and operational SLAs.
Lead end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, inventory management, order fulfillment, dispatch, returns, and quality control.
Own and manage the fulfillment center P&L, driving cost optimization and productivity improvements.
Develop and execute strategies to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
Drive workforce planning, capacity management, and resource utilization.
Monitor operational KPIs and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives through process optimization, automation, and best practices.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards.
Mentor and develop teams while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and high performance.

Preferred candidate profile

Strong expertise in fulfillment center, warehousing, supply chain, and logistics operations.
Proven ability to consistently deliver operational and customer SLAs.
Strong P&L management and business acumen.
Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder management, influencing, and persuasion skills.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing large teams.
Self-driven, proactive, and highly accountable with an ownership mindset.

Designation : Associate
Mode: Work from Office (6 Days working)
Office address: Industrial Area, Chandigarh
Job Description:
The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat.
Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities:
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts

Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and convey information clearly and concisely.

Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.

Description:
Essential Services : Role & Location Fungibility
At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the program
The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals with "Seva Bhav" - values of humility, adaptability, and a zeal to learn. Focused on relationship management, it emphasizes empathy, professionalism, and providing banking solutions to customers. The program includes extensive residential training, followed by nationwide placements in relationship management (sales) roles.
The Probationary Officer Program will prepare selected applicants for Relationship Manager (RM) job, which is a sales role. This role will involve client interactions and will require travel within and around the assigned location/city.
Selected applicants shall be placed in any location based on the requirements of the Bank and will undergo a rigorous training by ICICI Bank.

Eligibility
Education: Graduates, Engineers, Post-Graduate
Qualification: 60% and above in 10th and Graduation
Role and Location Fungibility: Applicant should be locationally mobile and willing to do sales

Program Structure
Program Duration: 2 Months Classroom Training


Selection Process
Online Aptitude Test: Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
Interview (Face-to-Face): Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in-person interview. Interview details will be shared on your registered email ID.

Description:
Position: Branch Customer Service Manager
Department: Customer Service
Location: Branch Based
Reporting To: Area Customer Service Manager

Role Purpose
To manage end-to-end customer service operations at the branch level, ensuring excellent customer experience, timely resolution of service requests, compliance with regulatory and internal policies, and effective coordination with Sales, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Service & Operations
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries, complaints, and service requests.
Monitor branch-level service quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
Manage activities related to loan servicing, statement requests, NOCs, foreclosure requests, repayment support, and post-disbursement customer servicing.
Drive adherence to customer service SLAs and turnaround times.
Customer Experience
Deliver superior borrower experience across all customer touchpoints.
Handle escalated cases and ensure proactive resolution.
Identify customer pain points and recommend process improvements.
Support customer retention initiatives and relationship management.
Compliance & Process Governance
Ensure adherence to RBI, NHB, company policies, and operational guidelines.
Maintain audit readiness and ensure closure of observations within timelines.
Monitor compliance with documentation, service processes, and branch controls.
Stakeholder Management
Coordinate closely with Sales, Credit, Technical, Legal, Collections, and Central Operations teams.
Act as the primary customer service representative for the branch.
Support branch management in resolving operational and customer-related issues.
Team Management
Lead and coach branch customer service executives.
Monitor individual and team productivity.
Conduct regular reviews and capability-building sessions.
Foster a customer-centric culture within the branch.
MIS & Reporting
Track service-related KPIs and branch performance metrics.
Prepare periodic reports for management review.
Analyze trends in complaints, service requests, and operational issues.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Complaint Resolution TAT
Service Request Closure TAT
Audit & Compliance Scores
Customer Retention Metrics
Branch Service Quality Parameters
Process Adherence and Accuracy

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline.
2-6 years of experience in customer service, branch operations, banking, NBFC, HFC, or financial services.
Strong understanding of home loan servicing and branch operations.
Good knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage teams and drive service excellence.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities
Handling complete accounting operations independently.
Preparation and filing of GST Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns, reconciliation, etc.).
Filing and compliance of TDS Returns along with challans and reconciliation.
Maintaining accurate Books of Accounts and day-to-day bookkeeping.
Preparing and managing Stock Statements and inventory reconciliation.
Handling customer/vendor Billing & Invoicing processes.
Performing Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) regularly.
Managing accounts payable and receivable.
Monitoring outstanding payments and follow-ups.
Preparing MIS reports, financial reports, and data analysis for management.
Maintaining purchase, sales, expense, and journal entries.
Coordination with auditors, CA, banks, and government departments.
Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and taxation laws.
Managing petty cash and expense tracking.
Assisting in monthly and yearly account closing activities.
Knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliances will be preferred.
Maintaining proper documentation and accounting records.

Required Skills:
Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and taxation.
Proficiency in Tally, MS Excel, and accounting software.
Good analytical and reconciliation skills.
Ability to work independently and handle pressure.
Strong communication and coordination abilities.
Attention to detail and accuracy in financial records.


Qualification:
• Bcom or Mcom Relevant Accounting Qualification
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounts and finance.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
• Candidate should be responsible, organized, and capable of handling complete accounts operations independently.
• Manufacturing industry or Plant experience will be an added advantage.

Description:
Job description

Note: This is a field sales role and two wheeler with valid DL is mandatory.

Roles & Responsibilities:
1. Area/ Lane /Geography Mapping:
Responsible for lane to lane/ Area mapping of Area/ Geography at regular intervals with the help of supervisor. Identify new sources in the allocated Area/ Geography and inform the progress to reporting manager during team huddle.
2. Source Relationship Management:
Responsible for managing the relationship with all sources assigned and identified by him in his geography/area.
3. Maintain Reports:
Responsible for maintaining reports related to sales and all his activities in the prescribed format. Should maintain diary on daily basis in the prescribed format of activities.
4. Channel Partner Recruitment:
Responsible for identifying the need for appointment of a channel partner.
5. Team Huddle:
Responsible for attending team huddle on a daily basis as per the set process.
6. Customer Relationship Management:
Responsible for enhancing the customer experience by developing and maintaining relationship with customers.
7. Completion of File:
Responsible for submission of complete application form, documentations and information.
Desired candidate profile:
1. Must be a Graduate from any stream
2. Should have minimum 6 months of experience in sales
3. Candidates with prior experience in BFSI will have an added advantage
4. Open to travel
5. Must have good communication skills.
AboutCompany:
HDFC Sales is a subsidiary of HDFC Bank Ltd. Headquartered in Mumbai, HDFC Sales was formed in January 2004. The company has been floated as a distribution arm with an objective of offering quick and easy service to prospective clients. We offer financial management solutions to individuals for products like Home Loans, Life Insurance, General Insurance, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits and NPS.
At HDFC Sales, our clients are at the heart of all our endeavours. Our proactive customer-centric initiatives have ensured a steady upscale in our business and regularly create paths for expansion and growth. Our employees are our strongest asset. HDFC Sales prides itself in having a transparent, employee-centric and solutions-driven work culture. We believe in empowering our employees and providing a fair and equal place to all.
Our Vision: To be India's most trusted and recommended financial service provider.

Our Mission : To create an environment of possibilities for our customers and employees by implementing effective business processes through commitment to quality, responsiveness and resourcefulness.

Our core values are Employee Focus, Customer Centricity, Integrity, Collaboration, Agility and Social Imapct.

Description:
New Admission:
To attend any new patient (admission) immediately.
To examine take a proper history of the patient (If he is in a position to give it on his own) or from his relative.
Check any previous records, if available.
Charts down all the details in the history sheet.
Inform the respective consultant about the admission follow his orders.
Instruct the nursing staff about the necessary orders to be carried out.
If there s a transfer out of patient from the ICU. Prepare the transfer summary/ clinical notes carefully and act accordingly.
Inform the respective consultants whenever seems significant.
Shift Duty:
To take rounds and examine individual patients at least once in every shift and as when needed. Inform the respective consultant/ Registrars if any new findings.
To put the notes in clinical sheet.
To respond to emergency calls immediately.
To enter the relevant details of each and every patient accordingly.
Attend rounds with the respective consultants and carry out the necessary changes in the order. Enter them in the treatment sheet.
Fill the Medicine Card and Non Drug Order sheet
To instruct the nursing staff about orders and follow them up
To follow up with all the investigations to be seen and trace their results. Note down investigation results in the investigation sheet.
To Document Verbal Orders correctly in clinical notes if given by consultants.
To activate code blue if any medical emergency is encountered beyond your control.
Always contact primary consultant if found necessary at any point of time.
To assist/ perform procedures as per instructions
Discharges/ LAMA/ Death:
Prepare summaries according to the policy
Fill the medical certificate of cause of death after discussing with ICU In-charge/ Primary consultant
Always inform concerned (MLC Nurse/ Casualty In Charge) in case of MLC
Pre Surgical Post Surgical Patients:
To follow pre-operative orders in the treatment sheet. To check whether the consents (Surgical, Anesthesia, etc) for the surgery has been taken from the patient. If not inform the respective person.
To get the PAC done. To carry out all the pre-operative orders.
Inform the consultant over phone during night shift about patient status who are scheduled for surgery next day.
To attend patients complaints. To calm the patients if they are apprehensive. Inform the consultant if needed.
General:
To attend camps according to the policy.
To work as per Policies and procedures of organization.
To get the cross referral form filled and call cross consultants according to the policy.
Use capital letters for medicines (Generic Names/ Salt) and always put sign, name, date and time with every entry you make.
To take care about completeness of records
To act accordingly as per communicated by hospital management team

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Description:
Responsible for the analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory in a given market or cluster.
Position prepares forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections and analyzes the progress of each.
Develops and/or uses analytical tools and systems to maximize revenues and profit.
Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Fice and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data
- Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Analyzes information, identifying current and potential problems and proposing solutions.
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Extracts and analyzes data in order to draw viable/actionable business conclusions.
- Provides revenue analysis functional expertise to general managers, property leadership teams and market sales leaders.
- Prepares forecasts of revenue, profit, demand and occupancy for rooms and function space - three-month and six month, long range and budget.
- Prepares revenue and profit opportunity analysis.
- Manages all revenue, profit and demand data associated with rooms and function space.
Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy
- Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.
- Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.
- Understands and accurately represents individual property needs.
- Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue analysis processes.
- Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.
- Promotes and protects brand equity.
- Prepares sales strategy critique.
Building Successful Relationships
- Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.
- Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.
- Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
Additional Responsibilities
- Informs and/or updates the executives and the peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
