Role & responsibilities

. Job Purpose
To lead Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance activities of the cement plant, ensuring equipment reliability, operational efficiency, minimum breakdowns, energy optimization, and compliance with safety standards.
2. Key Responsibilities
Oversee electrical and instrumentation maintenance across Crusher, Raw Mill, Coal Mill, Kiln, Cooler, Cement Mill, and Packing Plant.
Manage maintenance of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, switchgears, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical distribution systems.
Ensure smooth functioning of PLC, DCS, SCADA, automation systems, and field instrumentation.
Plan and implement preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities.
Monitor equipment performance, analyse breakdowns, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
Lead annual shutdown planning, maintenance budgeting, and spare parts management.
Identify opportunities for energy conservation and electrical cost optimization.
Ensure electrical safety, statutory compliance, LOTO, and permit-to-work procedures.
Lead and develop the E&I team and coordinate with Production, Mechanical, and other departments.
Supervise installation, modification, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation projects.
3. Educational Qualification
- B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
4. Experience Required
1015 years of experience in Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance, preferably in the cement manufacturing industry.
Strong exposure to integrated cement plant operations, particularly Kiln, Mills, Crusher, and Packing Plant.
Hands-on experience in HT/LT systems, PLC, DCS, SCADA, VFDs, and industrial automation.
Experience in team handling, shutdown management, and maintenance planning.
5. Key Skills
Electrical & Instrumentation Maintenance
PLC/DCS/SCADA and Automation
HT/LT Systems and Electrical Distribution
Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
Breakdown Analysis and Troubleshooting
Energy Management
Team Leadership and Project Execution
Safety and Statutory Compliance
6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Equipment availability and reliability.
Reduction in electrical breakdowns and downtime.
Adherence to preventive maintenance schedules.
Electrical energy consumption and cost optimization.
Timely completion of shutdown activities.
Team productivity and safety compliance.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.
Undertake cost-benefit analysis and economic analyses to support investment decisions for resilient infrastructure and risk mitigation measures.
Support preparation and review of financial and economic appraisal documents, models, and justification notes for government review and approval.
Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.
Educational Qualifications:
CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

AboutCompany:
Waaree Energies Limited is a leading Indian renewable energy company and India's largest manufacturer of solar PV modules. Founded in 1989 by Hitesh Doshi and headquartered in Mumbai, the company has grown into a major global player in the solar and green energy sectors.

Key Business Highlights:
Core Offerings: The company manufactures solar modules, solar cells, inverters, and energy storage systems. They also provide comprehensive turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar projects, as well as operations and maintenance.
Manufacturing Scale: Waaree boasts immense manufacturing capabilities, with large-scale plants in Gujarat (including Chikhli, Surat, and Umbergaon) and an expanding international footprint, including a manufacturing facility in the United States.
Vertical Integration: The company operates a vertically integrated business model, expanding backward from solar modules into the manufacturing of solar cells, wafers, and ingots.
Recent Milestones: Waaree Energies successfully went public, listing on the BSE and NSE in October 2024. The company is also actively expanding its portfolio into emerging sustainable technologies like green hydrogen.

Today, Waaree operates in over 20 countries, playing a strategic role in India's renewable energy transition and global solar supply chains

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Title: Sr. Officer-Independent Project
Education: B.B.A. / B.M.S. in Operations, Management, Retail Management
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Business diagnosisProject ownershipProject DocumentationProject PlanningStakeholder Management, NegotiationProject CoordinationProject TrackingProject Analysis, About company, Rongsheng Mobile India Private Limited is the Super Distributor of vivo Smartphones for the North-East region of India. Established on 24 November 2014 and operational since December 2014, the company has consistently played a vital role in strengthening vivo's presence across the region through an extensive distribution network and customer-focused operations.
Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.
Conduct field visits and structured discussions with store owners, promoters, TLs, Sales, Retail and other teams to identify the actual causes of weak performance.

3. Project Planning
Prepare practical 30-day, 60-day or 90-day project plans with targets, activities, owners, deadlines, resources and expected results.
Recommend project-specific interventions involving manpower, stock, product mix, display, training, finance, retailer schemes, local activation, relationship improvement or process correction.

4. Retailer Negotiation and Stakeholder Alignment
Present the business opportunity and proposed solution to store owners, distributors and other external partners.
Negotiate measurable commitments related to sales, stock investment, display space, promoter placement, branding, finance, local activity or other project requirements.

5. Cross Functional Execution
Coordinate with Sales, Retail, GTM, Marketing, Branding, Training, Affordability, Supply Chain and branch teams according to the needs of each project.

6. Fortress Store and Core Store Projects
Support the opening, ramp-up, performance improvement and turnaround of Fortress Stores.
Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

7. Monitoring and Project Closure
Maintain a project tracker covering the baseline, target, actions, owners, deadlines, risks, support required and current status.
Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.
Provide concise management updates focused on results, major risks, unresolved dependencies and decisions required.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.
Four to seven years of relevant experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, telecom, FMCG, retail operations, channel development or field-project execution.
At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.
AboutCompany:
Rongsheng Mobile India Private Limited is the Super Distributor of vivo Smartphones for the North-East region of India. Established on 24 November 2014 and operational since December 2014, the company has consistently played a vital role in strengthening vivo's presence across the region through an extensive distribution network and customer-focused operations.

Over the years, Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. has expanded its business operations across Assam and the North-Eastern States, including Sikkim, creating significant employment opportunities and contributing to the growth of the region's retail and distribution ecosystem.

Our North-East Head Office is strategically located at First Floor, Nikita Pinnacle, Khanapara, Guwahati, Assam, providing a comfortable, collaborative, and professional environment for our employees.

To ensure seamless supply chain operations, our central warehouse is located at Lokhra, Guwahati. Equipped to support efficient inventory management and timely product distribution, the warehouse works in close coordination with our Marketing Distributors (MDs), branch offices, and sales teams across the region.

At Rongsheng, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to fostering a culture of integrity, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning while providing rewarding career opportunities for professionals who aspire to grow in the dynamic mobile and consumer electronics industry.

Join Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. and be a part of a fast-growing organization driving innovation and connectivity across North-East India.

Hospital Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Practical exposure to IPD and OPD billing cycles, multi-tier tariff plans, cash/credit billing audits, and plug of revenue leakages.
TPA & Corporate Insurance Claims: Experience with pre-authorizations, query resolution, handling rejection/deduction patterns, and liaison with insurers/TPAs for outstanding claim realization.
Doctor Payouts & Departmental Accounting: Proficiency in calculating consultant honorariums, fee shares, OPD/IPD procedure split models, and tracking physician revenue contributions.
Cash Flow & Counter Oversight: Supervision of daily collection summaries across billing counters, POS settlements, daily bank reconciliations, and cash limit audits.
Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Ledgers: Verification and clearance of pharmacy, surgical consumables, biomedical equipment vendors, and medical supply invoices with ledger scrutiny.
Budgeting & MIS Assistance: Assisting senior management with OPEX/CAPEX variance tracking, EBITDA drivers, ARPOB metrics, bed turnover data, and monthly departmental packs.


Preferred candidate profile Must have the below Knowledge:-
Hospital Information System (HIS): Working knowledge of specialized hospital ERP modules (e.g., SAP, TallyPrime, Oracle, Meditech, or custom HIS).
Advanced Microsoft Excel: Strong skills in VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, handling large hospital billing data dumps.
Statutory Compliance: Thorough understanding of TDS deductions (specifically 194J on doctor fees, 194C on contractor invoices) and GST applicability in healthcare.
Audit Support: Prior experience in assisting internal audits, statutory financial audits, and insurance regulatory reconciliations

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
Operations Manager - The Vanda Hotel
Position: Operations Manager
Location: The Vanda Hotel
Reporting To: General Manager
Experience Required: 7-10 Years in the Hospitality Industry
Salary Package: 75,000 - 80,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The Vanda Hotel is seeking a dynamic and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day hotel operations, ensure exceptional guest experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and support business growth. The incumbent will work closely with the General Manager and lead all operational departments to maintain high standards of service, profitability, and compliance.
______________
Key Responsibilities
Hotel Operations Management
Oversee daily operations of all hotel departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and Guest Relations.
Ensure smooth functioning of hotel operations while maintaining service excellence.
Monitor occupancy levels, guest satisfaction scores, and operational performance.
Guest Experience & Service Quality
Ensure superior guest service standards and prompt resolution of guest complaints.
Develop and implement service improvement initiatives.
Maintain high hospitality standards aligned with the hotel's brand image.
Team Leadership & People Management
Supervise, mentor, and motivate department heads and operational staff.
Conduct regular staff meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Ensure adequate staffing and efficient workforce utilization.
Financial & Business Performance
Assist the General Manager in achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Monitor departmental budgets, operational costs, and inventory controls.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.


Compliance & Safety
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, statutory regulations, health & safety standards, and hospitality industry guidelines.
Conduct regular inspections and audits of hotel facilities and operations.
Maintain proper documentation and operational records.
Vendor & Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Ensure proper maintenance of hotel infrastructure and equipment.
Monitor procurement activities and stock management.
______________
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, or a related field.
Professional hospitality certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 7-10 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
At least 3-5 years in a managerial or operational leadership role within hotels, resorts, or hospitality establishments.
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Sound knowledge of hotel operations and hospitality standards.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Financial acumen and budget management expertise.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and MS Office.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
______________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Guest Satisfaction Scores
Occupancy and Revenue Performance
Service Quality Standards
Cost Control and Budget Adherence
Employee Productivity and Retention
Compliance and Safety Standards
______________
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly Salary: 75,000 - 80,000

Description:
Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion
Shillong, Meghalaya
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise closely with local banks, Bank Sakhis, and Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve financial delivery networks.
Financial Literacy & Awareness: Conduct structured awareness programs on financial management and promote key government social security schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY).
Enterprise Support & Insurance: Assist SHG members in securing financial access for local enterprises, and support insurance enrollment and claim settlements.
Data & Community Management: Organize bank coordination meetings, foster community engagement, and maintain detailed data and reporting on financial inclusion metrics.
Key Qualifications & Eligibility
Education: Post-graduate degree or diploma in Science, Business Management (Finance), or Commerce from a recognized university or institution.
Age Limit: Below 30 years.
Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.

Job_Description":"
Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements

Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years

Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.
AboutCompany: Bajaj Broking is a 100% subsidiary of Bajaj Finance Limited offering wide spectrum of Capital Market Solutions covering Equities, Mutual funds, corporate deposits, Bonds, Insurance & Loans which are been offered to Corporates, High-net-worth individuals, and Families.

SAP MM (Materials Management)

Functional Locations

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:

FOS : (Feet on street) , A : External hiring (RG Role)
SM will also acquire new clients for the bank to increase CA book and help the servicing the clients and cross-selling Investment & Insurance business.
SM targets : NTB - 48, LI - 6 lakh CBP, HI - 4 lakh, GI - 3 Lakh

Role Description
Candidate is having prior experience of New to bank acquisition of saving accounts through open market lead generation and closure, successful onboarding of Customer for a smooth transition to branch banking team, Sourcing new account.
Your experience will support team/Bank to acquire new client from the open market to bank with us and generate revenue

What well offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that youll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

Acquisition
Increase acquisition of Target clientele across in Advantage Banking segments. Periodically assist Advantage Banking in conducting approved local level sales drive (micro events) for the acquisition. Acquire new accounts from group companies / family of existing customers. Acquire new accounts from referrals from existing customers
Relationship Building / Deepening / Cross Sell / Transition
Ensure consistent growth of the Advantage Banking portfolio. Work closely with the Advantage Banking and team and establish synergies for maximum penetration of Investment & Insurance sales to new customers along with deepening into the book. Build a robust momentum regarding the third-party distribution (insurance, auto loans, mortgages) and fee income to scale up the client portfolio growth, in line with the set targets. Implement customer contact programs to ensure their share of wallet with the bank increases. Ensure smooth transition of customer management to the respective RM post-acquisition
Retention
Ensure top class service delivery to clients to be in line with the best in the industry. Monitor high net worth accounts closely to ensure that customers continue regular use the account and grow balances. Work towards reactivating accounts which have stopped transacting or depleted in balances. Assist in resolving service hurdles to create a delight situation for customers
Risk Management & Governance
Ensure awareness and adherence with the Know Your Customer policy, Anti Money Laundering Policy, Mis-selling Policy, Information Protection Policy, Operational Risk, Code of Conduct and other laid down compliance norms of the bank as stipulated from time to time. Provide regular feedback on the changing customer needs to the SSM. Any suspicious transaction to be immediately reported to the SSM

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

About us and our teams

AboutCompany:
Kraft Heinz, The Company
The Kraft Heinz Company is the fifth largest food and beverage company in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We are a globally trusted producer of delicious foods for 150 years, and we provide high quality, great taste and nutrition for all eating occasions whether at home, in restaurants or on-the-go. The Kraft Heinz Company manufactures and markets food and beverage products in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Australia and throughout Asia-Pacific. Our products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, and other grocery products, as well as infant and nutrition products.
As one of the worlds largest food and beverage companies, we are proud to spark joy around mealtimes with a global portfolio of more than 200 brands. Our iconic brands include Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Planters, Maxwell House, Capri Sun, Ore-Ida, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, Cracker Barrel, Classico, and McCafe, among others. We sell products through our own sales organizations and through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to convenience stores, drug stores, value stores, bakeries, pharmacies, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice distributors, and institutions (e.g., hotels, restaurants, hospitals, health care facilities, and certain government agencies) as well as to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts.
No matter the brand, we are united under one vision: To Be the Best Food Company, Growing a Better World. Bringing this vision to life are our 39,000+ teammates around the world, making food people love. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership and commitment with Rise Against Hunger. And we also stand committed to sustainability, and the health of our planet and its people. Every day, we are transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion -- and are ready to create the future, build on storied legacy, and participate as a conscientious global citizen -- there’s one thing to do: join us.
Our culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration
We’re not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry intern to senior leader -- to own their work. We believe that we share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – and we apply this to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you’re supported to grow and achieve. You’re recognized and rewarded for outstanding performance at every level. You’re given opportunity to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’ll be supported by a thriving group of teammates in over 40 countries around the world, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress every day.

Description:
SAP ABAP S/4 HANA Consultant/Developer

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP S/4HANA Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting SAP ABAP applications in S/4HANA environments.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ABAP Development, RICEF Objects, Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, BAPI, BADI, Enhancements, Reports, Interfaces, and S/4HANA development frameworks. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and enhance SAP ABAP programs based on business requirements.
Design and build RICEF objects including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms.
Develop Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, SAP Scripts, and Interactive Forms.
Create and enhance BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Enhancement Framework objects.
Design and develop ALV Reports, Classical Reports, and Interactive Reports.
Work with Functional Consultants to understand and translate business requirements.
Analyze and optimize existing ABAP programs for performance improvement.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces using IDoc, RFC, Web Services, and APIs.
Support S/4HANA migration and custom code remediation activities.
Prepare Technical Specifications and Design Documents.
Conduct Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Production Support activities.
Resolve production incidents within SLA timelines.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams during project delivery.
Ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.

Qualifications

B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP ABAP and S/4 Hana experience for JL4.
Minimum 5 years of SAP ABAP experience for JL5.
Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture and development lifecycle.

Job Description
Company: CARS24
Locations: Ahmedabad, Pune, Rajkot
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com

What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. Thats the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We're building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.
What will you drive?
Team Leadership: You may get a team (of Builder - Retail Associates) to lead and mentor, ensuring they meet performance targets and provide exceptional customer service.
Dealer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding of dealers, guiding the team in identifying and engaging potential partners on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and others.
Lead Generation and Appointment Booking: Strategically manage the lead generation process and ensure seamless booking of customer appointments through social media outreach.
Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with dealers and customers, fostering sustained collaboration.
Deal Closure: Supervise the team in handling post-inspection processes, including lead allocation, communication, price negotiation, and closing deals.
Target Achievement: Drive the team to achieve daily and monthly targets, with a focus on lead conversions and incentive-based performance.
Who are we looking for?
Proven Leader: Experience in leading and motivating sales teams, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Sales Expertise: Demonstrated success in lead generation, customer engagement, and deal closures.
Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in managing and analyzing data to optimize team performance and decision-making.
Strong Relationship Skills: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation abilities to build trust and win back leads effectively.
Experience: Prior experience in sales, account management, or similar roles, with a track record of achieving and surpassing targets.

Role & responsibilities
Project Role: Assoc Lab Project Svcs Mgr

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Ensures work is conducted in line with standard operating procedures, policies and good practices.
Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.
Experience in successfully leading Phase I-IV clinical trials preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities
Prepare timely and accurate Net Assets Values (NAV) for Mutual Fund and AIF client and other fund accounting output for subsequent review.
Record accurately, and in accordance with the client s policies and procedures, such as accounting records as securities positions, corporate actions related, and journal entries.

Ensure the correct valuation of all asset classes in the portfolio.
Drive Automation in the Fund Accounting system and suggest ways to automate the current process.
Train and guide the team issues faced in the daily process of Fund Accounting
Manage client queries on TDS, NAV and other reporting requirements.
Ensure that all SLA and timelines are met for a client deliverable

Must hold a Bachelor s Degree
Good Business Acumen
Excellent written Oral Communication skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prepare and analyze comprehensive reports as and when required.
Excellent organizational skills.
Eye for detail with excellent Analytical Skills
Passion to drive Change Management
Ability to work on tight timelines

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Description:
The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)
AboutCompany: L&T EduTech is an initiative of the Larsen & Toubro Group focused on bridging the gap between academia and industry. It works with universities, colleges, enterprises, and professionals to deliver industry-aligned learning, skilling, assessments, and certification programs. L&T EduTech leverages the Groups extensive industry expertise to develop practical, future-ready skills and improve employability across engineering, technology, and other professional domains.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company
quality standards before reaching customers.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Raw Material Quality Checks
• Inspect incoming loose staples for quality parameters (moisture, infestation, purity,
grain size, colour, odour, foreign matter).
• Verify supplier quality certificates and conduct sampling/testing.
2. In-Process Quality Control
• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and
hygiene.
• Ensure FEFO/FIFO practices in usage of raw materials and packaging materials.
• Conduct line clearance checks before production runs.
3. Finished Goods Quality
• Inspect packed products for compliance with defined standards (net weight,
labelling, shelf life, seal integrity).
• Retain samples for shelf-life studies.
4. Food Safety & Compliance
• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asia's largest and fastest-growing home interiors and renovation platform. Leveraging its proprietary technology, the company delivers end-to-end home interior and renovation solutions, encompassing modular solutions, furniture, false ceilings, soft furnishings, dcor, civil works, and more. The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

Identifies and highlights discrepancies, missing information and coordination risks in a timely manner.
Takes initiative to research products, manufacturers' information and consultant inputs to support technically sound design decisions.

Confident in setting up and working within multidisciplinary Revit models, including worksets, linked models and coordinated drawing production.

Strong working knowledge of Autodesk tools, with certification preferred.
Working knowledge of Revizto and Navisworks, with awareness of Dynamo and secure AI tools to support presentations and drawing production.

Description:
Job Description for Sales Coordinator at Axis Max Life Insurance:

As a Sales Coordinator at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the sales team to enhance efficiency and drive sales performance. You will be responsible for coordinating sales activities, managing administrative tasks, and providing support to the sales representatives. Your role will involve data management, reporting, and assisting in the development and implementation of sales strategies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in the preparation of sales reports, presentations, and other documentation to support the sales team.
- Coordinate sales activities, including scheduling meetings, managing calendars, and arranging travel plans for sales personnel.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to align sales efforts with promotional campaigns and initiatives.
- Respond to customer inquiries and provide information about products and services.
- Support the training of new sales staff by providing necessary resources and information.
- Monitor sales performance metrics and generate reports to analyze trends and identify areas for improvement.
- Facilitate communication between the sales team and other departments to ensure seamless operations.

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
- Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software and sales tracking tools.
- Attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong analytical skills to interpret sales data and generate actionable insights.
- Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team and foster positive relationships.
- Basic understanding of insurance products and the sales process is a plus.

If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and have a passion for sales support, we invite you to apply for the Sales Coordinator position at Axis Max Life Insurance. Join us in driving sales success and delivering exceptional customer service.

Description:
We are hiring for Assistant Manager -Banking, Revenue & Reconciliation with Dmart Ready.

Location: Powai (Work from Office)

Avenue E-commerce Limited (AEL) is an online extension of Avenue Supermarts Limited flagship brand. Dmart Ready is the mobile application through which our customers order grocery and other utility products. We seek to be a one - stop shopping destination for the entire family, meeting all their daily household needs offering value for money. A wide selection of home utility products is offered at an affordable price, including groceries, foods, toiletries, beauty products, garment, kitchenware, bed and bath linen, home appliances and much more. Currently we are present at Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad and Bangalore locations.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Banking & Payment Gateway Management
Coordinate with banks, Payment Gateway (PG) partners, acquiring banks, and payment service providers for day-to-day operations.
Monitor payment transactions across different channels including cards, UPI, net banking, other digital payment modes.
Follow up with banks/PGs on failed, pending, disputed, or delayed transactions.
Coordinate for refunds, chargebacks, reversals, and other payment-related matters.

2. Revenue & Collection Management
Monitor daily revenue collections across retail stores and digital/payment channels.
Track collections against sales/revenue and identify short collections, pending collections, or discrepancies.
Monitor daily bank credits and ensure collections are received as per agreed settlement timelines.
Prepare and maintain collection trackers and ageing reports.

3. Bank & Payment Gateway Reconciliation
Perform/coordinate daily reconciliation of sales, payment gateway transactions, bank settlements, and accounting records.
Identify and investigate reconciliation differences and unmatched transactions.
Coordinate with Operations, Banks, and PG partners for timely resolution.
Maintain ageing of unreconciled transactions and ensure timely closure.
Support month-end and year-end reconciliation activities.

4. MIS & Reporting
Prepare and circulate regular MIS

Job Title: Software Engineer - DevOps, Azure


Job Summary
Who We Are
Telstra is Australia\'s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we\'re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We\'ve grown quickly since our inception, now with offices in Pune, Hyderabad and Bangalore.


Focus of the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our team supporting a key Telstra initiative. This role demands a strong background in CI/CD tools, containerization, cloud platforms, and infrastructure automation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing and optimizing DevOps pipelines and environments at scale, with a passion for automation, efficiency, and reliability.


What You'll Do
Platform Engineering team - Software Engineering IT develops and maintains Telstra\'s software and IT systems, working on some really cutting-edge technologies.
Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab, Jenkins, and Bamboo.
Build and maintain container images using Docker, Kaniko, and Buildah.
Manage and orchestrate containers using Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, Rancher, and EKS.
Operate and support multi-cloud environments including AWS, Azure (Pivotal Cloud Foundry).
Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet.
Troubleshoot and optimize GitLab environments and pipelines, ensuring system reliability and performance.
Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to ensure best practices and compliance in deployment processes.
If you are looking to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you


About You
Over all 3-5 years of experience in Software Engineering
2+ years of experience in CI/CD tools like GitLab/Bamboo/Jenkins
2+ years of Experience in Container Build tools like Docker/Kaniko/Buildah
2+ years of Experience in Container orchestration tools like Kubernetes/Docker Swarm/Rancher/EKS
2+ years of Experience in cloud computing platforms like AWS/Azure
2+ years of Experience in Infrastructure as code Tools like Terrafrom/ AWS Cloud Formation/Ansible/Chef/Puppet
Shell Script: Strong skills in writing Shell scripts for automation and orchestration tasks.
Python: Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and integration tasks.
Security: Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud and DevOps environments.
Operations and Debugging of Gitlab platform and CI/CD pipelines.

About The Role  :  



About Global Network:

Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.



Global   Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world.For more information visit .
